92168.name: Challenge of Blood
92168.desc: A letter of challenge obtained with Blood Shards. This letter will lead to the location of the Mysterious Being.

92169.name: Queen's Pendant
92169.desc:
Upon use, register "Queen's Pendant" to the Toy Encyclopedia.
(Interact - Toy)

92172.name: Game Voucher
92172.desc:
A voucher required to participate in a marvelous game. Maybe it's an opportunity to earn some real money!
(Can only be used once a day.)

92173.name: Lucky Coin
92173.desc: A coin sold in Yorn that is said to bring the bearer luck.

99003.name: Rebel Recruitment Flier
99003.desc: It contains exaggerated rebel propaganda about how they are going to organize an uprising of farmers in collaboration with the World Harvest.

99005.name: Moss-Covered Page
99005.desc: A piece of an old, mossy journal.

99007.name: Rusty Gunlance
99007.desc: An old gunlance rusted by salty water and ocean wind. Someone in the Lightshade Inn might know who it belongs to.

99009.name: Flich's Orchard Storage Key
99009.desc: The orchard keeper must have dropped it.

99010.name: Cahni's Orchard Storage Key
99010.desc: The orchard keeper must have dropped it.

99011.name: Seamus's Orchard Storage Key
99011.desc: The orchard keeper must have dropped it.

99012.name: Old Pendant
99012.desc: An old necklace that a port rodent had in its mouth. Inside the locket is a worn, unrecognizable picture. It may not be something of high value, but it probably means a lot to someone.

99013.name: Torn Paper
99013.desc: A piece of paper taken from a Contaminated Sting Moth. Someone has written something on it.

99014.name: Torn Paper
99014.desc: A piece of paper taken from a Forest Spider. Someone has written something on it.

99015.name: Adventurer's Guild Token
99015.desc: A token that shows the owner's reputation with the Adventurer's Guild in Rania Village.

99016.name: Torn Paper
99016.desc: A piece of paper taken from a Tainted Kran. Someone has written something on it.

99020.name: Resonating Giant's Heart
99020.desc: It might be helpful in unveiling the secret of Giant's Heart.

99023.name: Morlo's Guild's Invitation
99023.desc:
A store that Arthetine's famous mathematician Morlo made. They purchase perfectly calculated items and sell it at thoroughly planned timings.
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Stern - The Watcher</FONT>
Complete the quest above to perform this one.

99024.name: Vern Royal Merchant Guild's Invitation
99024.desc:
The Royal Market made under Queen Ealyn's blessings. It's known for it's fast mobility and wide trade radius due to it's geographic location.
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Vern Castle - Beyond the Frozen Sea</FONT>
Complete the quest above to perform this one.

99025.name: Bloody Spirit's Memory
99025.desc: A piece of memory found on Moun the Bloody Spirit. Who's the owner? Bring it to Archaeologist Alkke in the temporary Graymoon base.

99026.name: Daybreakers' Invitation
99026.desc:
The Daybreakers have organized this guild with the illegal gains that they seized from the rich and famous of Shushire. All its profits go to the development of Shushire.
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Rigens Village - After the Dawn</FONT>
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Rigens Village - Once Upon a Time</FONT>
Complete the quest above to perform this one.

99027.name: Shiverwave Merchant Guild's Invitation
99027.desc:
Rohendel's royal guild based near Lake Shiverwave. It's been expanding its commercial territory with Queen Azena's unconditional support.
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Rothun - Ratik</FONT>
Complete the quest above to perform this one.

99028.name: Elzowin's Blessed Letter
99028.desc:
A guild organized by the members of Rohendel's Dawnkeep to procure research materials and supplement research funds.
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Lake Shiverwave - Tower of Thanks</FONT>
Complete the quest above to perform this one.

99029.name: Mederiel's Letter
99029.desc:
Mederiel, now a full-fledged businessman, has called <FONT color='#FFFFAC'><$PCname/></FONT> to <FONT color='#D4FF88'>Atropos</FONT>.
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Rothun - Music Resounding in Elzowin</FONT>
Complete the quest above to perform this one.

99030.name: Umar Cosmetics' Invitation
99030.desc:
Even though Umar Cosmetics is now a corporate giant whose innovative products are being sold everywhere across Arkesia, its researchers continue to wander around the world in search of new cosmetic wonders.
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Great Castle - Bulletproof Cream Hits the Market</FONT>
Complete the quest above to perform this one.

99031.name: Great Ashen Forge's Invitation
99031.desc:
When the forge that has been collecting dust is reactivated under King Kaysarr, Umar's technical prowess will shine and the forge will return to its former glory!
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Great Castle - The Legend Sings</FONT>
Complete the quest above to perform this one.

99032.name: Levi's Letter
99032.desc:
<$PCname/>! Could you come to see me when you're in Kalaja? I've got good news to share.

From Levi.

[Quest] Kalaja - The Last Melody of a Requiem Complete the quest above to perform this one.

99034.name: Invitation from the Lailai Merchant's Association
99034.desc:
The Lailai Merchant's Association in Punika has dispatched its members across Arkesia to promote the success of the festival.
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Nia Village - Honorary Punikan</FONT>
Complete the quest above to perform this one.

99042.name: Watcher's Strange Spores
99042.desc: What really are these gigantic Watchers?

99052.name: Melody of the Sea: Brahms
99052.desc: Use to obtain Brahms, the Melody of the Sea.

99053.name: Predator of the Sea: Tragon
99053.desc: Use to obtain Tragon, the Predator of the Sea.

99059.name: Beautifully Folded Letter
99059.desc:
<$PCname/>, do you hear the winds calling you? If you're ready, come to the Whispering Islet.

- Sidereal Nineveh -

[Quest] Truth, Lies, and Choices You may start this quest after completing the prerequisite quest.

99065.name: Delta Merchant's Referral
99065.desc: A letter of referral that proves the owner is a Delta Merchant. It's a gift that senior Delta Merchants give to rookies in celebration of their joining the organization. Sell it to the shop.

99066.name: Lynnis Commemorative Coin
99066.desc: A commemorative coin that Delta makes in honor of Lynnis. Throw it into the fountain at the center of Atropos and make a wish.

99067.name: Soft Construct Fragment
99067.desc: A soft construct fragment. There's something solid inside it. Can it be something useful?

99068.name: Melted Fragment of Magmadon
99068.desc: A soft fragment of Magmadon. See if it has anything valuable inside it.

99070.name: Suspicious Device
99070.desc: A strange, completely unfamiliar device. Activating it produces a mechanical noise, as if it's trying to find the right frequency.

99071.name: Guidebook
99071.desc: A guidebook for adventurers who have just arrived on the Feiton continent. It provides information about songs, maps, mounts, and other necessities that they need for their adventures. Highly recommended to new adventurers of Arkesia.

99072.name: Pirate Star: Astray
99072.desc: Generates the Pirate Star Astray materials, which can be combined into an Astray through Ship Carpenter Belrod in Blackfang's Den.

99073.name: Worn Necklace
99073.desc: A necklace left behind by a defeated Mayhem Legion soldier.

99074.name: Fast Sailing Sprint: Eurus
99074.desc: Marine Knight Badada has sent a special gift along with his letter.

99075.name: Ghost Ship: Eibern's Wound
99075.desc: A ghost ship that's been wandering the sea shrouded in pitch-black darkness. This glass bottle was found while investigating the ship.

99076.name: Paradise's Knight License
99076.desc:
The small but brave Mokoko sailors, who have faced storms with high seas more times than they can remember, have been waiting for the day that they can dominate the sea with the fastest ship that they know: the Paradise's Knight. Prove your worth to <FONT COLOR='#D4FF88'>Knight Badada</FONT> on the <FONT COLOR="#00B0FA">Peyto</FONT> and send your name carried on the wind.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFAC'>"The knight who loves the sea, come to the Peyto.
Through perseverance and concentration, you shall earn this ship that can travel faster than the wind itself."</FONT>

99077.name: Reinvigorated Giant's Heart
99077.desc: The resonating sound of a giant's heart echoes from above.

99078.name: Greatest Masterpiece of a Lifetime
99078.desc: An art masterpiece that's highly sought after among art aficionados. The Vediches searched for this piece for generations.

99079.name: Someone's Letter
99079.desc: A letter from an unknown sender. Probably worth checking out.

99080.name: Candaria Trade Company's Invitation
99080.desc:
A trade company associated with the senate of South Vern. The senate has announced portions of the trade company's profits will be used for humanitarian aid and improving the quality of life of those in need.
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] South Vern - Into the Chaos</FONT>
Complete the quest above to perform this one.

99081.name: Sidereal: Galatur's Will
99081.desc:
Balthorr of the Great Castle made a new resolution.<FONT COLOR='#FFFFAC'>This item can be obtained by clearing Gate 4 on Normal or Hard difficulty. </FONT>
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Rothun - Ratik</FONT>
Complete the preceding quest to proceed.

99082.name: Shattered Star Fragments
99082.desc:
Small fragments glowing with subtle starlight. They sparkle when exposed to light.

<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Breaking the Cage</FONT>
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Whispering Star</FONT>

Complete the preceding quest to proceed.

99083.name: Vediche's Invitation
99083.desc: An invitation from the Great City of Art, Pleccia. The historic family insignia is especially noticeable.

99084.name: Hanna's Business Card
99084.desc:
You can check in with Hanna again when you're curious about how she's doing.

<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] I Was Hurting By Myself</FONT>
You may start this quest after completing the prerequisite quest.

*Only available to characters who completed the following quests.
- <FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Justice Never Dies</FONT>
 - <FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Festival Adventure</FONT>

99085.name: Shadowmoon Market Photo
99085.desc:
You can check in with Hanna again when you're curious about how she's doing.

<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Follows Like a Shadow</FONT>
You may start this quest after completing the prerequisite quest.

*Only available to characters who completed the following quests.
- <FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Justice Never Dies</FONT>
 - <FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Festival Adventure</FONT>

99086.name: Sunflower Island Photo
99086.desc:
You can check in with Hanna again when you're curious about how she's doing.

<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] In the End, Memories</FONT>
You may start this quest after completing the prerequisite quest.

*Only available to characters who completed the following quests.
- <FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Justice Never Dies</FONT>
 - <FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] Festival Adventure</FONT>

99087.name: Suspicious Paper Envelope
99087.desc:
A suspicious paper bag that was buried underground. Someone must have buried it to exchange secret information.

<FONT color="#FFD200">[Quest] An Invasion of Chaos</FONT>
<FONT color="#FFD200">[Una's Task Reputation] Music Box Keeper Level 1</FONT>
You may start this quest after completing preceding quests and achieving a reputation.

99088.name: Exquisite Tablet
99088.desc:
An extravagant stone tablet that was found using excavating technology in South Vern.
I wonder what will happen if I gather the remaining fragments and complete the stone tablet?

99089.name: Untreated Leather
99089.desc: A leather rarely obtained when hunting rabbits. It is full of life energy, making it suitable for Transmuting. Perhaps something good will happen when it is used in a Transmutation.

99090.name: Reinforced Treated Leather
99090.desc:
This leather has been Transmuted.
It falls just shy of perfection.

99091.name: Rainbow Bait
99091.desc: The bait, illuminated by light, radiates rainbow hues. Could there be fish that are attracted to such dazzling and vibrant bait?

99092.name: Secret Map Piece
99092.desc: This secret map exudes a strange aura. It's unreadable with the naked eye. Perhaps it can be deciphered using Alchemy.

99093.name: Lost Letter
99093.desc: A forsaken letter located in the devastated lands of Vesper. Enclosed in the envelope is a singed letter.

99094.name: Smoky Action Lure
99094.desc: A realistic lure used by ancient master anglers to catch volcanic fish. Its strong scent and multi-jointed wiggling attract fish.

99095.name: Shana's Letter
99095.desc: Shana's letter to <FONT color='#FFFFAC'><$PCname/></FONT>. The envelope is decorated with dried flower petals and inside is Shana's carefully crafted handwritten letter.

99096.name: Bloodclaw's Telescope
99096.desc: A specialized telescope to look at the stars. You can navigate by the stars so you don't get lost on a dark night.

99097.name: Torn Letter
99097.desc: A letter found in an old herbalist's bag. Judging by the tears along with the bag, it seems the owner was attacked by something.

99098.name: Restored Old Tome
99098.desc:
An ancient book restored by an alchemist in Rimeria. It bears the marks of age.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>The pages are filled with mysterious passages.</FONT>

99099.name: Record of Pulsating Life
99099.desc:
An ancient record that lay dormant deep underground. Though it looks as if it's ready to crumble at any moment, a pulsing Life Energy can be felt within.

<FONT color="#FFD200">The knowledge to sprout new life must be contained within...</FONT>

99100.name: Completed Adventure Record
99100.desc:
A book containing all 50 Adventures.
Filled with stories of the vast sea.

101001.name: Flash Grenade
101001.desc:
Throws a grenade, inflicting <$MACRO dam @1:32001/> Holy Damage and stunning the target for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32000/>s.
Stagger: Mid-high

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Grenade</FONT>

101011.name: Flame Grenade
101011.desc:
Throws a grenade that inflicts <$MACRO dam @1:32011/> Fire Damage. Creates a wide field of flames that lasts for <FONT COLOR='ffff99'>10s</FONT>. Foes in the area take <$MACRO dam @1:32015/> Fire Damage every <FONT COLOR='#ffff99'>0.5s</FONT>.
Stagger: Mid-high

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Grenade</FONT>

101015.name: Panacea
101015.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$TABLE_SKILLEFFECT ValueE 32111/>%</FONT> chance to remove all harmful debuffs.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Potion</FONT>

101021.desc:
Throws a grenade that inflicts <$MACRO dam @1:32021/> Water Damage and freezes the target for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32020/>s.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Grenade</FONT>

101031.desc:

Stagger: Mid-high

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Grenade</FONT>

101042.name: Flare
101042.desc: Displays the location of raid monsters on the minimap for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32040/>s.

101052.name: Taunting Scarecrow
101052.desc: Set up a scarecrow. After <FONT COLOR='#ffff99'>1</FONT>s, and every <FONT COLOR='#ffff99'>10</FONT>s, object taunts foes a total of <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'>3</FONT> times for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32051/>s. This effect lasts for <FONT COLOR='#ffff99'>30</FONT>s.

101061.name: HP Potion
101061.desc:
Recovers <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$CALC <$TABLE_SKILLEFFECT ValueD 32060/>/100/>%</FONT> HP.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>HP Potion</FONT>

101062.name: Major HP Potion
101062.desc:
Recovers <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$CALC <$TABLE_SKILLEFFECT ValueD 32061/>/100/>%</FONT> HP.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>HP Potion</FONT>

101063.name: Elemental HP Potion
101063.desc:
Grants Elemental Blessing and recovers <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$CALC <$TABLE_SKILLEFFECT ValueD 32063/>/100/>%</FONT> HP.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>HP Potion</FONT>

101072.name: Stimulant
101072.desc:
Recovers Specialty Meter by <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$TABLE_SKILLEFFECT ValueB 32071/>%</FONT>.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Potion</FONT>

101081.name: Campfire
101081.desc: Set up a campfire that recovers HP and MP for you and your party. This effect lasts for <FONT COLOR='#ffff99'>30</FONT>s.

101101.name: Marching Flag
101101.desc:
Lifts the Marching Flag and Party Move Speed +<FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$MACRO buffstat0_100 @1:32101/>%</FONT> for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32100/>s. (Encumbered Speed does not increase.)

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Flag</FONT>

101122.name: Camouflage Robe
101122.desc:
While disguised, wearer is incognito among monsters for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32121/>s.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Robe</FONT>

101151.name: Dark Grenade
101151.desc:
Throws a grenade that inflicts <$MACRO dam @1:32241/> Dark Damage, decreasing all the target's defenses by <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$MACRO buffstat0_100 @1:32240/>%</FONT> for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32240/>s.
Stagger: Low

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Grenade</FONT>

101171.name: Corrosive Bomb
101171.desc:
Throws Corrosive Bomb. Weak Point Damage <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'>+1</FONT> Lv. for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32260/>s.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Bomb</FONT>

101181.name: Protective Potion
101181.desc:
On use, creates a shield <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$CALC <$TABLE_SKILLBUFF ValueC 32270/>/100/>%</FONT> of Max HP for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32270/>s.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Potion</FONT>

101191.name: Sacred Charm
101191.desc:
Deletes <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'>1</FONT> random debuff from nearby party members.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Charm</FONT>

101203.name: Thunder Potion
101203.desc:
Call forth lightning to strike a random nearby area every <FONT COLOR='#ffff99'><$CALC <$TABLE_SKILLBUFF Interval 32402/>/1000/></FONT>s to inflict <$MACRO dam @1:100123012/> Damage. This effect lasts for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32402/>s.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Potion</FONT>

101211.name: Sprinter's Robe
101211.desc:
Move Speed +<FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$MACRO buffstat0_100 @1:32300/>%</FONT> for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32300/>s.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Robe</FONT>

101221.name: Whirlwind Grenade
101221.desc:
Throws a grenade that inflicts <$MACRO dam @1:32311/> Damage. Foes are launched into the air.
Stagger: High

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Grenade</FONT>

101231.name: Clay Grenade
101231.desc:
Throws a grenade that inflicts <$MACRO dam @1:32321/> Earth Damage. Atk./Move Speed - <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$MACRO buffstat0_100 @1:32320/>%</FONT> for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32320/>s.
Stagger: High

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Grenade</FONT>

101261.name: Sleep Bomb
101261.desc:
Throws a bomb at a foe that puts them to sleep for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32350/>s. Incapacitates the foe for a long duration but expires when the foe is dealt Damage.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Bomb</FONT>

101271.name: Sacred Bomb
101271.desc:
Throws a bomb that removes incapacitating Status Ailments on party members.
Freeze/ Petrification/ Stun/ Sleep/ Earthquake/ Electrocution/ Disease/ Fear are examples.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Bomb</FONT>

101291.name: Atropine Potion
101291.desc:
HP -<FONT COLOR='#ff9999'>25%</FONT> but Atk. Power +<FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$MACRO buffstat0_100 @1:32380/>%</FONT> for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32380/>s. Move/Atk. Speed +<FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$MACRO buffstat1_100 @1:32380/>%</FONT>.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Potion</FONT>

101301.name: Luterra's Horn
101301.desc:
Summons Luterran Soldiers that fight alongside allies for <FONT COLOR='#ffff99'>30</FONT>s.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Horn</FONT>

101912.name: Destruction Bomb
101912.desc:
Throws an explosive bomb that inflicts <$MACRO dam @1:32141/> Damage.
Weak Point: Lv. 3

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Bomb</FONT>

101914.name: Repair Shop Portal Scroll
101914.desc:
Use the scroll to go back to the Start Point. Using a portal will bring you to the Return Point. Consumed before tradable items.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Scroll</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Can only be used in a Guardian Raid.</FONT>

101915.name: Time Stop Potion
101915.desc:
Use to temporarily become invincible. Does not shield you from wipeout skills from some powerful monsters.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Potion</FONT>

101916.name: Pheromone Essence
101916.desc:
Applies a pheromone to a Guardian monster for <$MACRO bufftime @1:33201/>s and sends a signal that lures it to return to the current location when moving zones.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Can only be used in a Guardian Raid.</FONT>

101917.name: Splendid Elemental HP Potion
101917.desc:
Grants Elemental Blessing and recovers <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$CALC <$TABLE_SKILLEFFECT ValueD 32063/>/100/>%</FONT> HP. Equippable limit +2 in certain areas.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>HP Potion</FONT>

101918.desc:

<FONT COLOR='#99ff99'><$TABLE_SKILLEFFECT ValueE 32111/>%</FONT> chance to remove all harmful debuffs, and grants immunity to debuffs for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32112/>s.

101932.desc:
While in disguise, wearer is incognito among monsters for <$MACRO bufftime @1:32122/>s and cannot collide with non-adventurer foes.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Robe</FONT>

300006.desc: Yudia nomads made this ice snack in a cold cave. It's seasoned with Yudian salt. It may not look pretty but it's tasty!

300007.name: Yudia Natural Salt
300007.desc: The salt desert of Yudia, also known as the Mirror of Arkesia, is a rich repository of edible salt. People all around the world consider Yudian salt as the best of its kind, and it makes the salt a spice of great value.

300008.name: Golden Salt
300008.desc: It is the rarest Yudian salt that top notch chefs use in their main courses.

300009.name: Encavian Relic
300009.desc: Archaeologists and historians have a great interest in studying the relics of the old Encavia, which makes for great business for some merchants.

300010.name: Zagoras Wild Ginseng
300010.desc: A wild ginseng rarely found in Mount Zagoras is effective in promoting yang energy inside the body. It is known that lean people have more to benefit from it.

300011.desc: A fine cut of sirloin from Lakebar. It makes a great gift on special occasions because of its amazing quality. Use quickly, or it will go bad.

300012.desc: A bird cage made for messenger pigeons in Mount Zagoras. Rich people in Lakebar who have pet birds also buy these at high prices for their simple but sturdy quality.

300013.name: Nahun's Introduction to Architecture
300013.desc: An architecture book written by Nahun, who was, among many things, a highly praised architect. In addition to construction engineering, Nahun faithfully introduces how architecture has advanced within the flow of history and the techniques with which various architectural works were built.

300014.name: Dyorika Straw Hat
300014.desc: A hat the farmers in Dyorika Plain wear to avoid the blazing sun. Its unique design made it a popular souvenir for those visiting Luterra.

300015.name: Luterran Records
300015.desc: A compiled life story of the great king of Luterra. It is considered a must-read in Luterra, but people outside the country criticize it for its overly idolizing tone of writing.

300016.desc: This replica of the sword that Luterra used in his younger days is a popular souvenir among visitors, especially those in their youth or knights that look up to the great king.

300017.desc: A record of Chain War published by Termia Library that has more than fourteen editions.

300018.name: Wavestrand Telescope
300018.desc: A widely popular device made in Wavestrand Port that is high in quality and low in price. It's a perfect gift for people who like adventure.

300019.desc: The transparent pearls of Wavestrand Port were used as a currency among those that didn't have the actual money. Now that the pearls are rare, most are used to craft accessories for rich people.

300020.desc: This item was mass-produced by a toy company that expected it to be a hot seller. Soon, however, the company started to struggle with the massively piled-up inventory, and eventually ended up going broke. It's hard to say that it's likable.

300021.name: Blackfang's Wanted Poster
300021.desc: As much as Blackfang is a notorious pirate, she is quite a popular figure among men of different ages. Even her wanted posters are bought and sold for collection.

300022.name: Mokoko Juice
300022.desc: A rising popular juice in Mokoko Village made of Cashew fruits blended with other organic plants. Its portioned well enough for Mokokos, but for people from other races...

300023.name: Oversized Ladybug Doll
300023.desc: A triple extra size doll of a ladybug made in Mokoko Village. Kids will love it.

300024.name: Poured Strawberry Cake
300024.desc:
Strawberry cake flavored with fresh strawberry powder and special cheese from the Mokokos. Anybody would love it,
but it's not suitable for anybody other than a Mokoko.

300025.name: Heart Clover
300025.desc: The clovers growing in Tortoyk area are called the heart clovers due to their heart-like shape. Three-leafed, four-leafed, whatever. It means nothing to these non-superstitious people anyway.

300026.name: Changhun Talisman
300026.desc: A charm known to protect the wearer from bad luck. It would make a great present for superstitious people.

300027.name: Copy of Tournament Entrance Certificate
300027.desc: A certificate of participation in the Changhun Tournament of Anikka, a world-famous testing ground of combat skills. Many certificates like this are likely to have been forged since only a very limited number of people are accepted into the tournament.

300028.desc: A certificate of participation in the Changhun Tournament of Anikka, a world-famous testing ground of combat skills. Some participants in the Changhun tournament put their certificates up for auction, where merchants make a bid for them to resell them at higher prices. Many young men crave to get their hands on this piece of paper.

300029.name: Prisma Valley Dye
300029.desc: The dyes produced in Prisma Valley are revered by all those in the fashion business for their beautiful color. The deeper someone is into fashion, the higher the chance that he or she would covet it.

300030.desc: A lute made in Anikka with the clearest sound in the world. It's a little bit expensive, but it would fetch a great amount of affection if given to a real romanticist.

300031.name: Delphi Perfume
300031.desc: A fine perfume made in Delphi Township. Yahara, a role model of many women, is one of the most famous wearer of it.

300032.name: Lion Mask
300032.desc: It's a gift mask based on the Battle of the Lions. Popular in Changhun.

300033.name: Machine Repair Set
300033.desc: A must-buy machine repair set made in Stern. It comes in handy when you have an Arthetinean machine at home.

300034.desc: A 1/8 size replica of a gun made in Arthetine. Silver is the most popular color.

300035.desc: A portable gramophone created by the Cykins. Arthetine's technology has enabled it to reproduce crystal clear sounds.

300036.desc: A piece of scrap metal processed in Stern. Though not as hard as the steel from Yorn which is every blacksmith's dream, its benefit is reasonable pricing made possible through mass production in Stern.

300037.desc: The 289th issue of Hoyte created a huge stir with its fierce criticism of Stern Times, but it soon became a rare find for an unknown, but obvious reason.

300038.name: Steweizen
300038.desc: One of the three best beer products in the world. Along with Fargar of Yorn and the Iceberg Beer of Shushire, it is the most popular, exceding the other two in production volume. It also has the highest alcohol content among the three beers.

300039.desc: An ice flower growing in Shushire. Though it melts quickly, there still are many people who would appreciate its beauty while it lasts. If you want to give this to someone as a present, you'd better hurry before it starts melting.

300040.desc: An Icewing brooch, hand-made in Rigens Village. It was originally made for the noblemen visiting Red Curtain Arena, but it became more popular among common people.

300041.desc: A beautiful, straight horn of a reindeer. The thinner and sharper, the rarer and more expensive it is.

300042.desc: A special beer only found in the Shushire area. It was made with iceberg water from Shushire that is high in oxygen, so it has a cool, refreshing quality that is second to none. It is best served with bits of the iceberg still floating on the surface.

300043.name: Warden's Whistle
300043.desc: A whistle used by the guards of Red Curtain Arena. It brings nothing but fear to the people of Shushire but oddly enough, many tourists buy this unpleasant thing as a souvenir.

300044.name: Bright Yellow Ribbon
300044.desc: A ribbon that might look better worn in warm and sunny areas than in cold, dark regions.

300045.name: Berna Rose
300045.desc: It's not as beautiful as those from Liebeheim, but it still could fascinate the minds of many young women.

300046.desc: Sylvains in Vern often fabricate their clothes into magical clothing materials that are known to have beautiful colors and otherworldly smoothness, along with a piece of relief from the magical protection they provide.

300047.desc: A goblet deigned by Linderte, a renowned wine expert in Vern. Its simple but delicate design makes it a very popular product among the people in and outside of Vern.

300048.name: Luck-filled Bag
300048.desc: A bag that the wandering merchants bring to sell in Peyto, where a lot of people move in and out of the island. Its efficiently designed compartments make it a popular item among novice adventurers.

300049.desc: A cute, stuffed doll of Rakuni, an animal character popular among kids.

300050.desc: A nautical map made for the education of youngsters. The scale of the map is inaccurate, so it's more decoration than of real use to sailors.

300051.desc: A photo of a ghost taken from a manor on the Metus Islands. The photographer that took this picture sold it, saying that it was lucky that he survived, but no one believes that this is an authentic photo of a ghost.

300052.desc: A special lobster dish only made in Peyto. It's highly praised by gourmets from all aver the world. They do take-outs, but it won't taste the same unless it's delivered quickly.

300053.desc: The ultimate gift. There is no heart that this beautiful crystal cannot impress. Even a Demon will be your bff if you give this to it.

300054.name: Luterra Travel Guide
300054.desc: A guidebook for tourists of Luterra. It has a detailed list of Luterran landmarks, making it popular among the adventurers.

300055.desc: An exquisite statue of a knight whose sword and shield look almost real. It is a great gift for both collectors and kids who admire knights.

300056.name: Rethramis Holy Water
300056.desc: An item only found in the monastery in Rethramis. You can cast evil away just by spraying it or more simply, just carrying it around.

300057.name: Ankumo Flower
300057.desc: A wildflower that blooms on Ankumo Mountain. It symbolizes purity. Young girls collect it in bunches and make them into a bracelet or a coronet.

300058.name: Small Plaster Cast
300058.desc: A relief sculpture crafted by stonemasons in Loghill. It is popular among travelers passing by the area.

300059.name: Poison Bottle
300059.desc: A deadly poison that Toxiclaw Robbers made from poisonous spores. A drop of it will make the pain go away, two will take away your control over your body, and three will take away your life. As it has a numbing effect, psychiatrists use it to treat depressed patients.

300060.name: Prideholme Egg
300060.desc: An egg laid by a chicken in Prideholme. Its huge size and the unique flavor it has makes it a popular ingredient for chefs and gourmets.

300061.name: Rethramis Wheat Bread
300061.desc: A piece of colorless, odorless and flavorless wheat bread used in priesthood ordinations in Rethramis. It has its value not in its taste but in the way it is used.

300062.name: Stonemason's Hammer
300062.desc: A hammer of stonemasons from Loghill. It is perfectly balanced and has the durability to last for days of continuous work.

300063.name: Aquilok's Scale
300063.desc: A scale from a snake once called "The Calamity of Rethramis." It imbues resistive properties to poison, so adventurers carry this instead of a talisman.

300064.desc: If you wind and open the box, it plays a song of the ancient bards.

300065.desc: A fabric emblazoned with traditional Yudian patterns. It's handmade so it takes a lot of effort into making one. These beautiful patterns represent health and love.

300066.name: Chubby Bug
300066.desc: A small bug that won't stop wriggling. Some would find it too gross to eat, but it is considered as a special Yudian treat, served wholly fried.

300067.name: Hawk Claws
300067.desc: A sharp claw of a hawk. Yudians are famous for their craft in taming hawks. They take the claws of their companion hawks as a charm when they die.

300068.desc: A collectible piece of naturally shaped rock salt. It's sold at a high price to collectors. It needs to be kept with care, however, as there were more than a few reported cases where fools licked it for its weird sweet flavor and destroyed its value as a collectible.

300069.desc: A liquid solution containing Mungka oil, salttree seed, and solar salt. It is what Yudians use to protect their skin from burning under the blazing sun, so a lot of women consult Yudian merchants to get hold of this.

300070.desc: A bow with a symbol of a critical shot engraved on it. Nomads of Yudia are born archers, and people say their arrows could penetrate armor made of steel.

300071.name: Hunting Knife
300071.desc: A knife that the hunters in the rugged Mount Zagoras use to skin animals. Its blade is sharp and sturdy, so travelers always buy it as a gift when traveling to West Luterra.

300072.name: Lynnis's Lessons
300072.desc:
How did the legendary Lynnis become the hero that he's known to be?
An introductory book to commerce, a must-read for peddlers written by Lynnis himself.

300073.name: Firefly Lantern
300073.desc: A lantern made with fireflies from Bilbrin Forest. The light casts out the darkness before you. Fascinated by the mystic color or its light, rich women often buy several of these to use in their banquets.

300074.desc: Holy water blessed by Gustaven, the legendary Archbishop of Rethramis, himself. It has the power to prevent misfortunes and cure diseases.

300075.desc: Snow taken from the peak of Mount Zagoras. Please keep in mind that this is heat-resistant, not heat-proof.

300076.name: Silvery Leaf
300076.desc: A leaf with a faint scent of mint. It refreshes the body and invigorates you when taken as tea. It works great for those who get sick frequently.

300077.name: Luterran Guardian Stone
300077.desc: A stone that has a mild warmth lingering on it. It is known to prevent injuries and diseases.

300078.desc: A fragrant wine made by the priests in Medrick Monastery. Especially the bottles of wine made a hundred years ago are very rare and valuable as the drought prevented the priests from making them in large numbers.

300079.name: Lakebar Tomato Juice
300079.desc: A juice made of fresh-picked tomatoes with clean water from Iron Lake. It's very refreshing.

300080.desc: A chestnut, which is said to come from Bilbrin Forest. The archers in Bilbrin Forest are known to use these nuts to practice their shooting skills.

300081.name: Salica Grass Whistle
300081.desc: The wide leaf of Salica that grows in an open field makes a beautiful sound when you put your lips together and blow into it. The soldiers of Luterra use these tunes to appease their homesick hearts with it during the war.

300082.name: Sunflower
300082.desc: A sunflower commonly found in Sunbright Hill in Luterra. Many bards have written songs and poems about it. It definitely has a color that appeals to emotion.

300083.name: Pigerett Meat
300083.desc: A meat of a Pigerett that is popular for its flavor-rich and nutritious quality. Its proper balance of muscle and fat make its texture a joy to your mouth.

300084.name: Puruu Leaf
300084.desc: A strange leaf that grows on the heads of Puruus. Puruus pick and offer the leaves to close ones as a token of friendship.

300085.name: Flowering Pear Wine
300085.desc: A sweet fruit wine made from pears that only grow in Flowering Orchard. Be careful not to mistake it for soy sauce as the two look very similar.

300086.desc: A brooch that exudes the beauty of Azenaporium in East Luterra. Though it's expensive, it's very popular among noblewomen for its radiant colors and delicate craftsmanship.

300087.desc: An abnormally dark-colored rose. The rose first appeared after a priest planted the seeds in order to prevent the spread of a contagious disease in East Luterra. It withers quickly unless it's picked with care.

300088.name: Roseberry
300088.desc: A sweet, red fruit known as the staple food of Mokokos. Those of other races will gain significant weight if they eat it. It's popular among people who want to put on some weight.

300089.name: Naruni Egg Shell
300089.desc: A piece of an eggshell that a Naruni broke out of. People in Tortoyk have the tradition where they read the cracks on the shell to predict the future.

300090.desc: A piece of glass rounded by the waves on the shore. It glitters like a gemstone in the sun. Mokokos find it very fascinating.

300091.desc: A breathing stone that is said to have fallen off from a giant's body. Like any other living thing, they say that it moves around when you put enough time, love and effort into taking care of it. It's so rare that it doesn't have a standard price.

300092.name: Chuckle Mushroom
300092.desc: A mushroom that will make you laugh until you cry. The peculiar effect of this mushroom makes it a perfect cure for depression.

300093.desc: Pollen taken from a Shy Wind Flower only found in Mokoko Village. Its unique color that can't be produced with science makes it something every painter in this world craves to get hold of.

300094.name: Gonggi Pebble
300094.desc: A small, round stone used in the game of marbles. It's quite something to see small kids throw the stones in the air and grab them all with a single snap.

300095.name: Teasing Clam
300095.desc: A cute clam that always keeps its tongue out. If you're lucky enough, you could find a pearl hiding inside the shell.

300096.name: Dandelion Spore
300096.desc: A dandelion spore with a strange power. When the season comes where the wind blows from the Northeast, Mokoko adventurers hold on to this and fly all the way to the Skyreach Steppe.

300097.name: Mokoko Carrot
300097.desc: A small, but nutritious carrot. The Mokokos only need a couple of carrots to make soup that would last them a whole year. This carrot, still wet with morning dew, smells fresh and delicious.

300098.name: Changhun Freshwater Fish
300098.desc: This fish is caught all across Arkesia, but no one knew how to cook it properly until someone from Changhun found the perfect recipe. It's small but with its edible bones, and it makes a great fritter.

300099.desc: A fishing pole believed to have been used by a legendary angler of Anikka. It radiates special, almost solemn, energy.

300100.name: Anikka Martial Arts Guide
300100.desc: Many tourists visiting Changhun buy this book filled with martial arts moves, fascinated by Anikka style of fighting. There are no master-level techniques, but constant practice of the moves can make a person fit and healthy.

300101.name: Cherry Blossom Wine
300101.desc: A liquor only made in spring with cherry blossoms. It has a very appealing color. The sweet scent reminds you of your first love.

300102.name: Gourd Bottle
300102.desc: A gourd bottle made by Hao, one of the greatest gourd bottle master craftsmans in Twilight Mists. In addition to its durability, the unique alcohol-fermenting effect that the gourd has makes it every thirsty soul's dream.

300103.name: Manpo Dumpling
300103.desc: A dumpling made by Manpo, one of the best cooks in Changhun, Anikka. Its rich stuffing is made with a bunch of secret ingredients, and the deep flavor it has, makes it hard to resist.

300104.desc: A special herbal concoction made in the herbal clinic in Changhun. The hundred-year-old wild ginseng in the medicine has the power to bring the dead back to life.

300105.desc: A bolt of beautiful silk with a complicated pattern stitched with gold thread. As only a limited number of craftsmen can produce such a high quality textile, its use is confined to special occasions such as weddings.

300106.name: Anikka Beef Jerky
300106.desc: A beef jerky with a fantastic chewy texture. It's a popular Anikka snack for people of all ages.

300107.name: Lucky Bag
300107.desc: A pouch full of treats given to kids early in the first month of the year to wish them good luck.

300108.name: Clean Master Brush
300108.desc: A brush made with a piece of winter bamboo from Melody Forest and the soft hair from the tail of a deer. It's able to make the most delicate expressions on the canvas.

300109.desc: A beautiful decorative hairpin in a shape of a butterfly. Wearing it would make a girl feel as beautiful as a flower.

300110.name: Cotton Wool
300110.desc: A bale of cotton wool produced in the winter in Anikka. Anikka cotton is known for its quality and is used primarily to make clothes.

300111.name: Plump Hair Ball
300111.desc: A plump mass of hair obtained through hunting. You'll lose track of time while you're fiddling with it.

300112.desc: A mushroom with a distinctive luster on its cap. It can be processed into a valuable medicine that calms the troubled body and soul, filling the empty bowl.

300113.name: Raw Jade
300113.desc: Very lustrous rough jade. It is used to craft quality rings and necklaces. Especially popular in Anikka.

300114.desc: A rare peach from Twilight Mists that takes more than a hundred years to fruit. Its sweet, fresh smell travels very far.

300115.name: Red Bean
300115.desc: A red bean that is known to cast out evil. People in Anikka eat red bean porridge twice a year to keep evil spirits away.

300116.name: Smelt
300116.desc: A smelt caught from beneath the ice. It's best to eat it raw after dipping in soy sauce from Anikka.

300117.desc: A quality Bruug meat that melts in your mouth. The flavor changes depending on how you cook it, but a true gourmet would eat it raw, slightly frozen.

300118.name: Shushire Hard Liquor
300118.desc: A strong liquor people drink to survive the cold. It burns your throat as you swallow it. Too much of it will make you go blind, so drink with discretion.

300119.desc: An expensive liquor containing gold dust that millionaires in Shushire like to drink. A bottle of this is worth dozens of prisoners.

300120.name: Shushire Random Stew
300120.desc: A stew that the poor people of Shushire made to survive. They put whatever they could eat into the pot to fill the empty stomachs. It's made to warm the body, not to satisfy the appetite. Due to its indecisive recipe, the stew tastes different every time it is made.

300121.name: Ice Candy
300121.desc: A candy-shaped mass of ice made by a conman in Shushire. It has very little sugar in it. Only the people from outside of the area buy these, and end up spitting them out.

300122.desc: A beautiful gem that is as transparent as ice and as blue as the ocean. It's only found on the steep cliff side of Icewing Heights. You will have to put your life on the line to get hold of this.

300123.name: Thin Fabric
300123.desc: A thin fabric from Yudia. It's a cheap fabric used for wrapping but people in Shushire will use anything to make clothes.

300124.name: Gray Wolf Tooth
300124.desc: A tooth of a gray wolf. It is a symbol of unyielding bravery. It's also something that the members of Graymoon carry as a charm.

300125.desc: The holy book of Sirius, the God of Ice. The priests of Sirius always carry this book around with them everywhere they go until they die.

300126.name: Raccoontaurus Milk
300126.desc: Fine quality milk of Raccoontaurus that lives in the Island of Ice Maze. The strong sweet scent tickles your palate.

300127.desc: Wild Bruug fur of the highest quality. The smoothness is beyond comparison with the fur of those from the farm. It is water-resistant and exceptional for keeping warm.

300128.name: Arthetine Canteen
300128.desc: A water bottle made of quality steel from Arthetine. Sturdy and reliable, all decent adventurers carry one of these on their journey.

300129.name: Tigran Oil
300129.desc: Your augmented arm does not work properly? Your newly built leg makes a squeaking noise every step? Here's a perfect solution to all your lubricative needs! Just a single spray will make all annoyance go away!

300130.name: Stern Longsword
300130.desc: A longsword made in Stern, the city of cutting edge technology and science. Unexpectedly, a lot of Cykins prefer to use a longsword.

300131.name: Bolchi's Leg
300131.desc: A Bolchi leg found near Totrich. The meat is used for a fried dish. If you don't mind where the meat came from, the texture is similar to crab meat and it tastes amazing.

300132.name: Scrap Paper Bundle
300132.desc: A years-worth collection of Arthetine daily newspapers. It's very helpful to find out what happened in Arthetine across a year, but the paper quality is awful due to careless storage.

300133.name: Portable Hood
300133.desc: A portable hood you can carry around folded. Cykins in Arthetine carry multiples of these to keep them safe from the blazing sun.

300134.name: Bolchi Egg
300134.desc: Believe it or not, the Bolchi egg often found in the desert of Arthetine is known to be tasty. There are times when some of these eggs are found half-hatched, and they fetch high prices due to their medicinal effect.

300135.desc: An old bone from somewhere in Arkesia. There is a theory that it belonged to a guardian that died in Chain War, but it's not very likely to be verified.

300136.desc: A potion that is known to boost the energy inside the drinker. Formulated by the chemists in Arthetine, it was released after years of clinical trials. Although the effect it brings is unquestionable, its ambiguous indication of ingredients and foul smell make it hard to gulp down.

300137.name: Epic Novel - Himmel
300137.desc: A best-seller that sold over tens of thousands of copies in Arthetine. It tells a story of evolving into Cykins, Human's journey to realize the paradise on earth. It's also a book that has a tragic background, unfinished due to the writer's murder.

300138.desc: A bookmark produced in celebration of Hoyte News' centenary. The history of the company is written on the surface of it.

300139.name: Magick Core Brooch
300139.desc: A brooch that looks like flowing energy. It glitters at night due to its light-absorbing nature.

300140.desc: The most popular seasonal menu in Peyto! It's made with layers of rare fruits from near the ocean.  The special syrup in the dish lingers in your mouth, telling you the reason why Peyto is called paradise.

300141.desc: A bottle of vodka produced by a master distiller in Peyto. Made with orange peels, you can smell the distinctive sweet orange scent when you drink it.

300142.name: Ylang-ylang Mushroom
300142.desc: A mushroom with a very pleasant smell and excellent texture. It makes a great complement to any ingredient, but can cause stomachaches if eaten raw.

300143.desc: A mysterious butterfly that emits light only at night. It's famous for the dance it does when good music is played, as if recognizing the sweetness of the melody.

300144.desc: The jaws of a fish. The rest of this fish has never been caught. No one knows why the fish casts off its jaws or what it looks like whole.

300145.name: Mysterious Metal Powder
300145.desc: This interesting powder can stick to metals. It's used as a research material in Arthetine and for spells in Yudia.

300146.name: Perfect Beer Stein
300146.desc: A super-size beer stein for pirates! Only those able to drink beer out of this in a competitive manner are considered to be real pirates.

300147.name: Recall Potion
300147.desc: A potion made with Fog of Reminiscence. A small intake is effective in treating insomnia, but a whole bottle of it will make the drinker suffer from the painful memories of the past.

300148.name: Promise Ring
300148.desc: A ring given to one's betrothed as a pledge of eternal love. Set in the middle of the ring is a red ruby, symbolizing the heart of its giver.

300149.desc: A chewy steak skewer popular among pirates. It is not only a great accompaniment to a drink but a quality meal that will keep you going. The only bad thing is that these sell so well that you cannot have enough of them.

300150.name: Top-Grade Bait
300150.desc: A bug with ten eyes and countless legs. Although it looks horrible, it's the finest quality fish bait that basically sells itself to fishing enthusiasts.

300151.name: Crystallized Magick
300151.desc: Crystallized magick found in the Balankar Mountains in Vern. After special processing, it emits bright light and provides a good substitute for a torch. The energy stored in it makes it useful for magical experiments, too.

300152.name: Exquisite Music Box
300152.desc: An ornamental music box with flamboyant colors popular among the noblemen in Vern. If you wind it, the doll inside dances to a beautiful waltz.

300153.desc: A coin created in celebration of Vern's establishment five hundred years ago. Now, it's so rare that it's only traded to the highest bidder. It's imprinted with Vern's founding principles, exchange and harmony, on it.

300154.name: Magical Scroll
300154.desc: A roll of paper imbued by a Mage with a spell. The spell is cast when the owner unfolds the paper and says the trigger word. It is exclusively made in Vern, where they believe in the practical magick.

300155.name: Meat Stew
300155.desc: A stew usually made and had by the adventurers in Vern. It contains tomatoes slow-cooked with meat from whatever they could find nearby. It warms your body when you have a sip.

300156.desc: A written form of application to the Queen's Knights, also known as the Spear of Vern. For many years, the knights have encouraged worthy warriors to join them by sending a letter of recommendation with this form enclosed. Warriors in Vern take great pride in receiving it.

300157.name: Goblin Yam
300157.desc: A yam grown by the Goblins in Parna Forest. It has red pulp and develops a clear ring in the center when cooked. It's all the more delicious when eaten with salt.

300158.name: Troll Skin
300158.desc: A piece of Troll skin covered in boils. Due to its rejuvenating effect, it is an expensive medicinal ingredient.

300159.name: Collected Stories of Knights
300159.desc: A book of heroic tales by knights who accomplished legendary achievements. Every knight owns a copy, but few finish reading it due to its long and complicated writing style.

300160.desc: A rose occasionally found on Liebeheim Island. Its sweet scent is known to have the power to move the heart of the recipient. This rose withers quickly when picked, so don't delay if you want to give it to someone as a gift!

300161.name: Blessings of the Lazeniths
300161.desc: Holy water of the ancient Lazeniths blessed by Regulus. Sprinkling it over one's head is believed to ward off disaster and misfortune.

300162.desc: A drop of water taken from the petals of Millennium Lotus in Rohendel, which is known to form only once in decades. Its highly condensed energy makes it a valuable material used in advanced sorcery.

300167.desc: A toast with honey and butter on top, a Wavestrand Port exclusive. People travel from far away to have a bite of this toast after it was given the highest score by Food Connoisseurs of Luterra.

300169.desc: This gourd bottle crafted by the master craftsman Hao in Anikka has infinite space for liquor. As its crafting involves the spells of Sir Druden, Hao wasn't able to craft more than a few.

300182.desc:
Powder of a blue butterfly collected from where it flew by.
It shines even brighter under the moonlight.
Sold for a very high price, it's mostly used in face painting.

300183.desc:
Storage the mages in Dawnkeep created after years of painstaking research.
There still are many ongoing studies to utilize the energy contained in the stone.

300184.desc:
A soft feather that emits a soft light.
It's said Elemental tail and wing feathers can keep the entire house warm when hung on the door.

300185.desc:
An ore commonly found in Yorn mines.
It's beautiful, but too brittle to have any value.
Often mistaken for a much more valuable mineral, Arkesium, and used by swindlers.

300186.desc:
A mysterious mushroom believed to work similarly to truth serums.
Anyone who eats this mushroom shall be compelled to speak nothing but the truth.

300187.desc:
One of the three best beers in the world,
brewed by the greatest Umar brewer, Fargar himself.
Thick-headed with a rich aroma of coffee, this beer prides itself on its deep flavors.

349001.name: Withered Liebeheim Rose
349001.desc: A rare rose found in Liebeheim Island. Too bad it has withered.

349002.name: Cold Lobster Dish
349002.desc: An old lobster dish that's lost its flavor. No one is interested in it.

349003.name: Flavorless Sirloin
349003.desc: Old meat that's lost its flavor. No one cares for it.

349004.name: Melted Ice Flower
349004.desc: An ice flower that melted and lost its beauty. No one would be interested in it.

349005.name: Melted Snowball
349005.desc: A half-melted clump of snow that no longer is good for anything. No one would be interested in it.

400001.name: Stimulant
400001.desc: This special potion of Veda will pump you up like crazy!

400002.name: Master-crafted Lyre
400002.desc: An exquisite lyre crafted by a master.

400003.name: Chamomile
400003.desc: A chamomile with a strong calming scent. It makes one of the most popular teas.

400004.name: Book of Demons
400004.desc: A book for Demons that Naphta the Demon Merchant is selling. It's written in an ancient language.

400005.name: Exploration Hook Rope
400005.desc: A multi-purpose hook for professional treasure hunters. Made in Anikka!

400006.name: Exploration Compass
400006.desc: A waterproof compass for professional treasure hunters. Made in Anikka!

400007.name: Changhun Lucky Bag
400007.desc: A small pouch with beautiful patterns embroidered on it.

400008.name: Frost Breath
400008.desc: A fruit wine made from wildberries that only grow on Icewing Heights. The more it's aged, the tastier and more valuable it becomes. People in Shushire serve it when entertaining very important guests.

400009.name: Frost Wolf's Dream
400009.desc: Treasure Hunter Sylus said he had a dream about running across a snowfield as a Frost Wolf when he drank this. The person who named this wine must have had the same experience as Sylus.

400010.name: Red Tikatika Flower Crown
400010.desc: A fragrant flower crown made of red Tikatika flowers.

400011.name: Yellow Tikatika Flower Crown
400011.desc: A fragrant flower crown made of yellow Tikatika flowers.

400012.name: Blue Tikatika Flower Crown
400012.desc: A fragrant flower crown made of blue Tikatika flowers.

400013.name: Pink Tikatika Flower Crown
400013.desc: A fragrant flower crown made of pink Tikatika flowers.

401001.name: Special Nalrick-Style Lobster
401001.desc:
Nalrick's special lobster dish. The savory taste will make your day.
Strength/Dexterity/Intelligence +<FONT COLOR='#99ff99'>5</FONT> for <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'>10m</FONT>.

401002.name: Sweet Blueberry Juice
401002.desc:
A freshly squeezed blueberry juice. Its sweetness is one of a kind.
Increases Crit Rate by <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'>2%</FONT> for <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'>10m</FONT>.

401003.name: Smoked Crow
401003.desc:
Too much of this will make your memory fade.
Increases Crit Damage by <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'>5%</FONT> for <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'>10m</FONT>.

401004.name: Special Smoked Crow
401004.desc:
A special dish with perfect seasoning.
Increases Accuracy by <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'>2%</FONT> for <FONT COLOR='#99ff99'>10m</FONT>.

401005.name: Soft Copper Ingot
401005.desc: An ingot of copper. It's of such inferior quality that you can dent it by pressing your finger on it.

401006.name: Well Refined Alloy
401006.desc:
A fine material with the touch of a master.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Talk to Mayna, a blacksmith in Lakebar.</FONT>

401007.name: Red Cashew Juice
401007.desc: A special juice that makes you become tiny.

401008.name: Lion Mask
401008.desc:
Upon use, register this item to the Toy Encyclopedia.
(Interact - Toy)

401009.name: Joytide Firecracker
401009.desc: Use to set off a Joytide firecracker.

401010.name: Big Snowkin Transformation Tool
401010.desc: An item that transforms the user into a large Snowkin.

401011.name: Small Snowkin Transformation Tool
401011.desc: An item that transforms the user into a small Snowkin.

401012.name: Margo's Special Fortune Cookie
401012.desc: It's surprisingly addictive. Though there's some dirt in it.

401013.name: Radiant Zagoras Crystals
401013.desc: A rare gem that can only be found on top of Mount Zagoras where the wind cuts like blades. It's characterized by the subtle light emitted by the ice cap.

401014.name: 2nd Anniversary Celebration Firecracker
401014.desc:
A firecracker made to celebrate the 2nd Anniversary of Lost Ark.
Use it to see the 2nd anniversary celebratory fireworks.

402001.name: Sour Blueberry
402001.desc: A sour-tasting, unripe blueberry. A little more time will make it taste amazing, but it's not so bad as-is.

402002.name: Crow Meat
402002.desc: It goes bad quickly if it's not cooked.

402003.name: Key Swallowed by Mimic
402003.desc: Mimics are not picky eaters, I suppose.

402005.name: Voice of the Forest
402005.desc: A pipe that sounds like a forest breeze.

402008.name: Wonder Drug
402008.desc: A strange medicine that is supposed to cure all diseases.

402009.name: Sizzling Festival Entrance Ticket
402009.desc: The owner of this piece of paper is in for the festival.

402010.name: Collected Information
402010.desc:
A piece of paper detailing hearsay information.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>This item can be used to help Nison.</FONT>

402011.name: Chaos Sliver
402011.desc:
A black stone exuding chaotic energy.
It might be able to bestow special powers upon someone.

402014.name: Anchor of the Tempest
402014.desc:
A token required to become the captain of Tragon, the Predator of the Sea and Master of the Tempest.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>This is an item you must have to become the captain of Tragon.</FONT>

403001.name: Ancient Gold Coin
403001.desc:
A gold coin that was widely used in ancient times. Popular among collectors.
<FONT COLOR='#FFFFAC'>Use to obtain 1000 Silver.</FONT>

403002.name: Ancient Silver Coin
403002.desc:
A silver coin widely used in the ancient times. It's quite common but still popular with collectors.
<FONT COLOR='#FFFFAC'>Use to obtain 100 Silver.</FONT>

403003.name: Ancient Platinum Coin
403003.desc:
A platinum coin that was very rare even in the time it was used as a currency. It's very valuable if sold to merchants.
<FONT COLOR='#FFFFAC'>Use to obtain 20,000 Silver.</FONT>

403004.name: Ancient Silver Coin
403004.desc: A silver coin that was widely used in ancient times. Use to obtain a small amount of Silver.

403005.name: Ancient Gold Coin
403005.desc: A gold coin that was widely used in ancient times. Use to obtain a handsome amount of Silver.

403006.name: Ancient Platinum Coin
403006.desc: A platinum coin that was very valuable in ancient times. Use to obtain a large amount of Silver.

403007.desc: Contains a handsome amount of Silver.

403009.desc: A chest that grants 100,000 Silver upon use.

403010.desc: Contains a handsome amount of Silver.

A shiny golden coin of great value.

403022.name: Great Pirate's Treasure Chest
403022.desc:
The treasure chest of a notorious pirate captain.
Whoever acquires the chest shall gain enormous wealth.

404001.name: The North Wind and the Sun
404001.desc: This book will help you gain Rapport with all the kids in the world.

404002.name: Encavian Secret Treasure
404002.desc: It can open a new path if taken to the island known for Encavia's legacy.

404003.name: Mind's Eye Compass
404003.desc: A strong spell cast on the compass leads you to Chaos Gate.

404004.name: Luterra Royal Token
404004.desc: The allies of Luterra will give you valuable items and information when you show this to them.

404005.name: Nautilus the Miraculous
404005.desc: A token that will make you the owner of the legendary ship, Nautilus.

404006.name: Guardian's Weapon
404006.desc: A weapon of Guardians forged with the power of both light and darkness. Its power inspires awe in people.

404018.name: Roar of Courage
404018.desc: A token that will make you the owner of Justice, a ship that proved its worth in the legendary naval battle.

404019.name: Drained Crystallized Magick
404019.desc:
Its energy is gradually fading, along with the secret it keeps inside. You need more experience to claim the hidden reward.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Reach Lv. 50 to obtain its true reward.</FONT>

404020.name: Lynnis's Token
404020.desc: A token left by the legendary peddler Lynnis. They say wandering merchants always carry something special to exchange for it.

404022.name: Mokoko's Skillet
404022.desc:
Upon use, register this item to the Toy Encyclopedia.
(Interact - Toy)

404025.name: Rainbow Island Entrance Permit
404025.desc: A ticket required to enter Rainbow Island, a mysterious island that appears on the sea every once in a while.

404026.name: Protection of Dawn Chest
404026.desc:
Contains Protection of Dawn gear.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Use to obtain Lv. 450 weapon and armor.</FONT>

404027.name: Touch of Frost Chest
404027.desc:
Contains Touch of Frost gear.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Use to obtain Lv. 510 weapon and armor.</FONT>

404028.name: Emblem of Eternity Chest
404028.desc:
Contains Emblem of Eternity Gear Set.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Use to obtain an Item Level 555 weapon and armor.</FONT>

404029.name: Splendid Blessings of Eternity Chest
404029.desc:
Contains Splendid Blessings of Eternity gear.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Use to obtain Lv. 680 weapon and armor.</FONT>

407001.name: Useless Map Piece
407001.desc: A useless piece of a map.

407002.name: Beginner's Pirate Manual
407002.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFFF'>A guide for the cadets of the mysterious pirates that sailed away in search of an island with treasure. Only a thorough reader of this book is able to </FONT><FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>tell which one is the navigator</FONT> among the many in identical uniforms.
<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFFF'>The rookies must have been under a lot of stress considering the circumstances where it was almost impossible to know who their superior was.</FONT>

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>This item will be consumed when you locate the target.</FONT>

407003.name: Advanced Pirate Manual
407003.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFFF'>A guide for the officers of the mysterious pirates that sailed away in search of an island with treasure. Only a thorough reader of this book is able to </FONT><FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>tell which one is the captain</FONT> among the many in identical uniforms.
<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFFF'>Whoever owned this book must have been very close to the top secrets of Pirate Alliance, meaning the strong fellowship of the pirates could have been brought down by his or her ill-willed action. Setting somebody up, for example... Judging from the evidence, it's probably what happened.</FONT>

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>This item will be consumed when you locate the target.</FONT>

407004.name: Sea-soaked Pouch
407004.desc: An old pouch soaked in sea water. It's waterproofed, so the content should be undamaged. There is something heavy inside it.

407005.name: Mariner's Gold Coin Sack
407005.desc: A pouch of gold taken from the mariner. The lower part of it is soggy with blood.

407006.name: Captain's Leather Bag
407006.desc: A pouch of gold taken from the captain. There is something extraordinary inside it.

407007.name: Flowing Fog Reward Chest
407007.desc:
A chest containing Flowing Fog equipment.

Contains one random type of a Flowing Fog equipment suitable for your class.

407008.name: Rift Engraving Recipe Bag
407008.desc: A chest which may contain an Epic Class Engraving Recipe.

408001.name: Powerless Messenger's Demon Spear
408001.desc: It has lost its power and can no longer be used.

408002.name: Messenger's Demon Spear
408002.desc: A weapon used by the Messenger. Mount can be used as ammunition for the Demon Stingers.

409003.name: Star's Breath
409003.desc: A mysterious crystal that captures the breath of the everlasting star.

420001.name: Cannonball
420001.desc:
It's needed to use the cannons in the Fortress Battle.
It contains powerful gunpowder, so it can inflict devastating damage to a wide range of enemies.

420002.name: Cannonball
420002.desc:
A prop that clowns use for their juggling acts.
It actually has real gunpowder inside for some reason.

420003.name: Harpoon
420003.desc:
It's a ghastly weapon for killing.
Where it came from remains unknown.

421003.name: Divine Healing Potion Chest
421003.desc: An exchangeable chest containing ten Divine Healing Potions.

421007.name: Protection Healing Potion Chest
421007.desc: An exchangeable chest containing ten Divine Healing Potions.

480001.name: Song of Return
480001.desc: A song left by the Lazeniths, the first civilization of Arkesia. It enables you to move to designated points across continents.

480002.name: Song of Resonance
480002.desc:
This song of the fallen giants has the power to resonate with earth, revealing hidden spaces and invisible things.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>"The secrets of its resonance are hidden in Erasmo's Island and Lullaby Island."</FONT>

480003.name: Song of Escape
480003.desc: The words of an ancient language in this song have the power to bend space and time, making the singer disappear from the current location.

480004.name: Song of Valor
480004.desc: It is the national anthem of Luterra, the country of knights, which has the power to fill a heart with courage even in the deepest despairs.

480006.name: Song of Trixion
480006.desc: A song left by the Lazeniths, the first civilization of Arkesia. It sends you to Trixion, the sacred ground of light known to exist at the world's end.

480007.name: Heart's Melody
480007.desc: A song left by the Lazeniths, the first civilization of Arkesia. It has the power to move people's hearts.

480008.name: Song of Temptation
480008.desc: A sweet, gentle melody passed down through generations in the ocean's end. It has the power to capture the soul of its listener.

480009.name: Song of Spring
480009.desc: A melody to breathe life into the heart and soul.

480010.name: Serenade of Love
480010.desc: A romantic serenade passed down among the bards of Arkesia. It has been played for the beloved ones for ages.

480011.name: Forest's Minuet
480011.desc: This song of the forest, passed down among Sylvains, has the power to communicate with nature.

480012.name: Requiem of Twilight
480012.desc: A song of the guides of roaming souls. It has the power to appease the souls of the dead.

480013.name: Song of Reminiscence
480013.desc: An ancient song written by the Lazeniths, the first civilization of Arkesia. It has the power to replay the memory of the past for a short time.

480014.name: Song of Starlight
480014.desc: It's a beautiful song passed on from the Starkeeper.

480015.name: Heavenly Harmony
480015.desc: A beautiful song with harmonious melodies.

480016.name: Elegy of Serenity
480016.desc: A quiet song composed in Cracked Glacier Island.

480017.name: Song of Hearth and Home
480017.desc: A song that holds the calm energy of the earth. It moves you to your Stronghold.

480018.name: Festival Overture
480018.desc:
A song that marks the beginning of the holy festival. Cheerful bells and chimes brings joy to people's hearts.
<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>※ Can be transferred to another character by placing it in your Roster Storage, but binds to character when used.</FONT>

480019.name: Song of Eternity
480019.desc: A song handed down to Sylvains through the generations. They say it was originally created with a powerful and unique spell.

480020.name: Romantic Weapon
480020.desc: A song popularized by the master crafters of Yorn. It is full of the romantic spirit of the cheerful Umars.

480021.name: Soulful Requiem
480021.desc: A requiem to comfort the souls of Delains. It is lonely and dreary.

480022.name: Song of Harmony
480022.desc: A song of harmony and peace that has long been passed down in Punika. It embodies the blessings of the Goddess.

480023.name: Hymn of the Sun
480023.desc: A song that has been passed down for generations among the knights of the Solar Knights. It sings the praises of knightly creeds.

480024.name: Song of Wolves
480024.desc: A song passed down between Rowen Nomads.

480025.name: Song of the Lazeniths
480025.desc: A song that has been transmitted to the Lazeniths. It is said to carry the energy of the Ancient Elgic Language.

480026.name: Song of the Heavens
480026.desc: A song bringing a pleasant wind. Calls forth Guardian Albion.

480027.name: Song of Great Memories
480027.desc: Moves you to Music Box of Memories.

490001.name: Yeonran's Artisanal Cologne
490001.desc: A perfume evocative of love and romance. It is widely used by ladies in Anikka.

490002.name: Beoria's Tear
490002.desc: It's something you can never forget seeing.

490004.name: Ekhorn Delta L
490004.desc: A gun made by a hitman who also was an expert weapon engineer. There are some parts that need to be perfected.

490005.name: Ekhorn Delta R
490005.desc: The last handgun that Fabian made for a friend. The trigger does not work.

490006.name: Liora's Remedy
490006.desc: A mysterious herb that has a power to cast out evil.

490007.name: Arcane Cube
490007.desc:
A cube built with a system that can't be analyzed with present-day knowledge. It's impossible to figure out what it's for.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Although a vision was obtained from the cube long ago, it has exhausted its powers and can no longer be used. Sell it to any merchant.</FONT>

490008.name: Tournament Champion's Plate
490008.desc: A Victory Crest given to the champion of the tournament. It looks quite valuable.

490009.name: Lobster Dish Order Ticket
490009.desc:
A ticket to claim Peyto's special lobster meal.
The item cannot be used. You can sell it at the shop in exchange for Silver.

490010.name: Shadow's Wish
490010.desc:
A black flower found at the Shadespire.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Talk to Jenkrix on Floor 1 of the Shadow Island to exchange this item for a Shadow's Wish Exchange Chest.</FONT>

490011.name: Shadow's Belief
490011.desc:
An ancient relic found at the Shadespire.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Talk to Jenkrix on Floor 1 of the Shadow Island to exchange this item for a Shadow's Belief Exchange Chest.</FONT>

490012.name: Shadow's Mark
490012.desc:
The tip of a black arrow found at Fatespire.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Talk to Jenkrix on Floor 1 of the Island of Shadows to exchange this item for an Island Soul.</FONT>

500001.desc:
A shard that has the energy of the islands stored within it.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>This item is used to refine sailing-related gear</FONT>.

500002.desc:

500221.name: Bloodclaw's Shimmering Coin
500221.desc:
The great pirate Bloodclaw's coin.

500222.desc:
A coin that was most precious to the Great Pirate Bloodclaw.

500223.name: Bloodclaw's Coin
500223.desc:

519815.desc: A perfume the prevents you from forgetting memories. Works even more effectively on special memories.

519818.desc: A perfume that was made by analyzing an artist's inspiration. A magnificent painting will suddenly come to mind upon using it.

519819.desc: A perfume that was made by analyzing a writer's inspiration. The user's imagination will run wild, allowing them to write a moving story.

519820.desc: A perfume that was made by analyzing a mathematician's inspiration. Improves calculation skills, making difficult calculations easy.
