911904.name: Fabulous Saucer
911904.desc:
A saucer whose decorative edge is slightly chipped away.
South Vern, where the climate is warm and the soil is rich, is famous for its sweet, aromatic tea. The people in the region drink tea more often than they drink water.
The nobility of Vern use a saucer with the handle-less tea cup to cool the tea a bit before drinking.

"I can't burn my noble hand while drinking hot tea. I would rather let it cool completely on a saucer before drinking. It is the noble way of drinking tea here."
- Nobleman Del Loche

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

911905.name: Solar Stone
911905.desc:
A Demon Stone that was first discovered by the Sylvain who set foot in South Vern in the past.
When the Sylvain succeeded in condensing ancient demonic powers to suppress the powers of chaos, they used this stone to purify South Vern.
However, these stones are on a short supply, the Sylvain in the upper echelon use the pendants made out of Solar Stones instead.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

911906.name: Solar Knights Token
911906.desc:
The Solar Knights used to be one of Vern's major orders along with the Lunar Knights led by Avele.

A hundred years ago, when Knight Commander Thar was killed fighting Necromancer Sigmund, most of the knights followed him to an early grave. Those who survived the incident disbanded the order. Before they were disbanded, they made an oath on the token of their knight commander.

"There will be no more Solar Knights after today. However, if Vern is in danger, we will draw our swords again. The oath of the Sun written in blood is never forgotten. For Vern!"

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

911907.name: Crumpled Letter
911907.desc:
The Senate was originally formed by the royal family to unite the races.
Today, the Senate is nothing more than an interest group controlling the commerce of South Vern.
If what I am suspecting turns out to be true, there will be a bloodbath on the continent.
I've already found out Satra and Haiger's plans. If I fail, the rest will be up to you.

(The rest of the letter is unreadable because it is smeared with blood.)

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912101.name: Paper Boat
912101.desc:
A paper boat designed to float on water.
The Yoz of Rimeria, surrounded by many lakes, have enjoyed making and floating boats as a childhood pastime. They rely solely on paper, without using illusions.

"Sometimes, when we wish to make a prayer or hope for good fortune, we set paper boats afloat on Akasha Lake. We send them off with a wish for the boats to stay afloat and travel far.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912102.name: Warding Glass Bell
912102.desc:
A glass bell crafted in the image of a terrifying monster's face.

Crafted to celebrate the day Heanu was sealed within Narr's Door, these bells are shaped like the beast's face. The Yoz of Rimeria hang them in tainted areas or carry them in parades, celebrating the triumph. Finally, the bells are burned as a ritual to ward off misfortune and pray that Heanu never returns.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912103.name: Basic Guide to Illusion Magick, Volume 1
912103.desc:
A beginner's guide to illusion magick for young Yoz, written in simple terms to be accessible to children. It is said to have been personally compiled by former elder Yornujan. Remember well : there is no limit to the variations of illusion magick. This textbook may not chart new paths for you, but I hope it serves as a foundation for your next steps.

- Yornujan

 Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.

912104.name: Illusion Pinwheel
912104.desc:
A pinwheel modeled after the windmills of Rimeria. Enchanted with illusion magick, it scatters beautiful illusions into the air as it spins.

"As long as I have this pinwheel and the wind, I can travel anywhere."
- Illusion Master Sihu

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912105.name: Rimeria Pear Flower Wine
912105.desc:
Crafted with premium grains, natural yeast, and the pristine waters of Akasha Lake. Each Yoz family uses its own unique brewing method, resulting in a wide variety of flavors. While pear flower wine is made on other continents, the Rimerian variety is regarded as the finest.
 
"Sweet, smooth, delicate, clear, and refreshing."

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912106.name: Broken Blue Lamp
912106.desc:
A lantern crafted by the Yoz elders to contain the Fallen.

The Fallen are those who gazed beyond the rifts and succumbed to corruption. The Fallen were once Yoz, loved as family and friends. For this reason, the Yoz do not kill the Fallen recklessly but instead seal them within the blue lamps, vowing to find a way to restore them someday...

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912107.name: Illusion Glass Umbrella
912107.desc:
This glass umbrella, a Rimerian specialty, incorporates illusion magick to achieve a lightweight, shatterproof design.

The mechanism for opening and folding is similar to a fabric umbrella, demonstrating superior craftsmanship. The tightly woven umbrella frame and the highly compressed, ultra-thin glass exemplify a level of artistry that is nearly impossible to replicate.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912401.name: Eliyabeck Tattoo
912401.desc:
A symbol that represents the Eliyabeck Agreement and the Neutral Territory Eliyabeck. The symbol depicts the meaning of the Agreement and all that it represents, and it is said that the beauty of the pattern alone is highly regarded.

Factions that enter the Rowen continent must respect the Eliyabeck Agreement, make an oath to protect the neutral territory, and hang a flag bearing the symbol in front of their territory. Those who belong to a faction that has made the oath may carry around a piece of cloth or kerchief with the symbol, which may be used during a conflict in Eliyabeck to prove one's identity and receive help for resolving the conflict.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912402.name: Tarunian Charm
912402.desc:
A charm known to contain the wishes of Tarunians.
Each Tarunian Warrior makes their own charm using their own meaningful objects and clothes when they become an adult. It is completed in a variety of ways, representing each Warriror's unique characteristic and values.

Warriors who have completed their charms hang them on the Holy Tree whenever they leave the village to hunt or battle. The remaining villagers and the families of the warriors pray for their well-being and safe return until they come back to take back the charms themselves. In case an unfortunate accident causes a warrior not to come home, the charm hanging on the tree is used to commemorate them.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912403.name: Silver Tentacle
912403.desc:
A peculiar silver currency issued by the Violetblade Pirates.
Created by melting down looted items.

It is of low quality and not widely used, but anyone who dares to protest its usage receives a shower of bullets and is dumped into the sea. The Violetblade Pirates strongly recommend using this currency, but they themselves prefer to barter for goods.

<FONT COLOR='#AAAAAA'>"Why an octopus? 'Twas a monster I met on the sea! I thought my time had come!"</FONT>

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912404.name: Eve's Magick Paper
912404.desc:
A thick book containing the details of the magick research conducted at the Waning Moonkeep.

Waning Moonkeep Sylvains researched powerful and destructive magick, and the research proved to be a success.

Countless Sylvains underwent mental contamination while gaining powerful strength, however, resulting in side-effects such as eccentric physical polymorphs.
Some mages from the Waning Moonkeep closely observed the crisis and finally discovered a unique means of casting spells, but the research had to be stopped due to its danger and cruelty. The Old Moon Grimoire, in which this research had been recorded, was locked away in the deepest corners of the Waning Moonkeep.
However, a few mages made copies, and they are being secretly traded.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912405.name: Mellemar's Molar
912405.desc:
The molar of a Mellemar, a beast residing in the northern mountains of Rowen. The beast prides itself on its fierce intelligence and ability to bite any object into pieces.

In the early phase of Rowen settlement, it was difficult to gather Sylmael, but an Inspector who had been carrying a molar like a charm succeeded where others had failed.
Ever since, Mellemar molars have sold for a high price, as they're used to create tools to gather Sylmael. The Mellemars themselves have been significantly reduced due to overhunting. These days, seeing one is a rare event.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912406.name: Dueogsini Stone
912406.desc:
A stone with a mysterious color, obtained from Treasure Hunter Sylus.

Found in Guyenne, this stone is able to suppress the ominous energy from ancient relics and ruins. Famous loot hunters always prefer to carry these stones when investigating a location.
However, should the stone be cracked or broken, one must never look into the stone.

<FONT COLOR='#AAAAAA'>"Our minds cannot comprehend Guyenne's fiends. This stone is the same way. Depending on how you use it, it can protect you or drive you to your death."</FONT>

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912407.name: Vessel of the Final Breath
912407.desc:
A vessel containing the last breath of a dying person.

The nomadic Tarunians have a tradition, as they draw nearer to death, to create the vessel that will contain their own dying breath.
On their deathbed, the vessel is turned over to a trusted friend. The duty of the one who receives the vessel is to safeguard it until they come to a place with good wind, where they unseal the vessel to release the final breath.
Among the Tarunians, it is said that if the person has their last breath taken away by the wind, their soul shall freely wander the Rowen continent for all eternity in peace.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912501.name: Under Ear Patch
912501.desc: An excellent medicine for motion sickness. It is a must for sages who suffer symptoms while climbing up and down the 123-story Sage's Tower. This item is conveniently attached beneath the ear. It also prevents seasickness and is the best-selling product in Taio's general store. (The Medical Affairs Institute certification mark is on it.) Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.

912502.name: Ripe Durinut
912502.desc:
A fruit known for its tough, stone-shattering skin and odd, pointed shape. It is theorized that this fruit evolved thorns and its imposing point in order to protect it from birds with strong beaks.
You can use a sturdy tool to crack open a ripe durinut to reach the fruit's pale yellow flesh and clear sap. Unlike the outer skin, the pulp has a soft texture that melts in your mouth, so many find that they may love it or hate it. There are many shops that prohibit bringing in durinut drinks, so be careful if you buy one on the street!

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912503.name: Sage and Guardian Card Pack
912503.desc: Paper doll cards that are popular with children. All across Kalinar, young fans gather together to play Guardians and Sages with these colorful, artistic cards. "Okay, I'll be a sage!" "Oh, I want to be the sage this time! I was the only Guardian last time!" Everyone's favorite product from the markets near Macaboa Port is the [Sage and Guardian Card Pack], but if you happen upon a child who opens a pack with the words [Meet your sage!], you might hear their ecstatic cheer shortly after. "Yes, it's Great Sage Zeherade!" Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.

912504.name: Very Small Vanglus
912504.desc:
Few sages mold masterpieces in their first attempt to create a homunculus. The Vanglus serves as a simple model of homunculus crafted by beginners as a sample upon entry into the Sage's Tower. As it is modeled after the giant snails that feed on the Great Rainforest, Vanglus moves at a slow pace on its garbage disposal route.
The core goal of the Vanglus involved a minimal design for locomotion that focused instead on accurate garbage detection, plotting an appropriate route to the target, and the relocation or disassembly of trash.
If you stroll through the Kalinar Market District during off-peak hours, you're likely to see several varieties of Vanglus roaming the floor in garbage disposal groups. These Vangluses are very small, and seem to be used to dispose of paper scraps on desks.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912505.name: Adento's Research Journal
912505.desc: Adento's journal detailing how to create a homunculus. It is considered a must-read for any aspiring alchemist, and is credited as the first book that lifted Human engineering to the creation of life. "... In addition to the above method, this journal lacks the requisite number of pages to explain the ultimate process of creation via organic interlocking between a vast life force and a core." Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.

912506.name: Burnt Coin
912506.desc: A commemorative Sacrian coin engraved on both sides with the face of Termer I. These coins were burned and defaced on one side during the Great Fire of Rasamoa. After settling in Voldis, many scholars discarded their coins at the first opportunity. "If Regulus' care is like luck, then we won't leave our fate to chance." Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.

912507.name: Sage's Knot
912507.desc:
A knot traditionally worn by sages of the Sage's Tower. The color denotes the rank of the sage, with red, silver, and gold representing lesser, mid, and high-ranking sages, respectively. When a member of the Sage's Tower dies, one's own knot is gifted to the deceased as a rite of mourning and respect. It is said that when the Great Sage Adento met his death, the most numerous and colorful knots were laid upon the last path he walked.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912601.name: Worry Doll
912601.desc:
A doll made from colorful threads imported from Punika.
It is said that if you tell it your worries or concerns before going to bed and place it under your pillow, the doll will make those anxieties go away.
This doll is currently very popular among the Allied Forces.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912602.name: Broken Radio
912602.desc:
This radio was supplied to the Allied Forces by Arthetine.
It was created by Mari Paulenz, a scientist who joined the Allied Forces.
It can cover distances up to about the size of a city and is easy to carry.
However, it cannot communicate over longer distances or in cases of signal interference.
Its Potenstone battery lasts only a few hours.
Therefore, it is primarily used for surveillance around Elnead.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912603.name: Torn Sacrian Flag
912603.desc:
Pieces of the Sacrian flag torn by those who harbor resentment toward Sacria.
Efforts are being made to find the culprits, but they take advantage of moments when no one is around, making it difficult to catch them.

"It wasn't us Sylvains. But compared to what they've done in the past, this revenge seems rather tame."
"It wasn't us Assar, either. Still... they had it coming."
"It wasn't us sages, either. Whether they judge the demons or betray us remains to be seen..."

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912604.name: Demon Drum
912604.desc:
A drum made by stitching together the skin of the living.
The Vinus Delains beat it loudly before going into battle.
It produces a dreadful sound, resembling the screams of the victims used to make it.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912605.name: Battleship Pluto Model
912605.desc:
A miniature replica of Arthetine's new battleship, Pluto.
Created with great effort by Arthetine for the Kurzan Great War, it faithfully reproduces the massive airborne battleship.
It operates on liquefied energy derived from significant quantities of Potenstones extracted from the desert, enabling it to remain afloat for extended periods.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912606.name: Bottle of Ominous Mist
912606.desc:
A bottle that contains a mysterious dark blue mist that began to spread across Kurzan.
Being near it prompts feelings of dread and negative thoughts.

<FONT COLOR='#DC0000'>Warnings</FONT>: Whispers encouraging you to open the bottle are hallucinatory. Do not open it.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

912607.name: Polyhedral Fragment
912607.desc:
A polyhedral fragment. A rare discovery in the old ruins of Kurzan.
It is engraved with unknown patterns. Archaeologists speculate that it was left behind by the Haals.

<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

920101.name: Dawntree Sprout
920101.desc:
A life-filled Solar Tree sprout found in Rethramis Border.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Dawntree Sprout Cider.</FONT>

920102.name: Giant Wheat Sack
920102.desc:
A sack of wheat commonly found in Prideholme.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Regria Wheat Bread.</FONT>

920103.name: Disgorged Lump
920103.desc:
A lump of vomit that White Birds in Loghill feed their babies.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Protein-Packed White Bird Stew.</FONT>

920201.name: Sweet-o-sweet Honey
920201.desc:
Sweet honey sold at Mokoko Village.
It will taste amazing if mixed with hot water.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Pow Pow Honey Health Tonic.</FONT>

920202.name: Cashew Fruit
920202.desc:
A fruit from a Cashew Tree sold at Mokoko Village.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in a Cashew Cashew Smoothie.</FONT>

920203.name: Rough Cashew Powder
920203.desc:
Ground Cashew Fruits used in different recipes.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in a Cashew Cashew Smoothie.</FONT>

920204.name: Fine Cashew Powder
920204.desc:
An item rarely obtained while making Rough Cashew Powder.
Finely ground Cashew Fruits are used in gourmet desserts.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in a Cashew Cashew Smoothie.</FONT>

920205.name: Boiled Mokoko Egg
920205.desc:
A boiled egg sold at Mokoko Village.
It becomes a Soft-Boiled Egg when left resting for a while. 

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>This item will change when the duration ends.</FONT>

920206.name: Honeycomb
920206.desc:
A beehive found inside Seaswept Woods.
There could be valuable royal jelly inside the hive.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Sweet Sweet Royal Jelly.</FONT>

920207.name: Egg of Creation Shell
920207.desc:
The shell of an Egg of Creation found Inside of Tortoyk.
What could have hatched from the glittering shell?

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Crunch Crunch Fried Shell.</FONT>

920208.name: Shattered Dip and Pour Bowl
920208.desc:
The legendary harmonious bowl from Tortoyk. Caspiel sat on it and it broke into pieces.
Having lost their precious bowl, Cook Supisu was extremely troubled.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>This a core ingredient of the harmonious dip-or-pour cooking.</FONT>

920301.name: Sealed Special Sauce
920301.desc:
A jar of marinade found in Yeon's Barrier.
Maybe this jar was why the Yeon Family created the barrier?

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Secret Yeon-Style Marinated Special.</FONT>

920302.name: 100-Year-Old Centipede
920302.desc:
A centipede obtained in Changhun.
It's a highly expensive cooking ingredient since the centipede is older than any Humans alive.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Manpo's Mystery Meat Dumpling.</FONT>

920303.name: Old Dumpling
920303.desc:
An old dumpling that can be obtained in Changhun.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Manpo's Mystery Meat Dumpling.</FONT>

920304.name: Deer Hind Hoof
920304.desc:
A hoof of a deer found in Wolf Valley at Rattan Hill.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Deer Hoof Stew.</FONT>

920305.name: Shattered Sugar Sculpture
920305.desc:
The result of failed attempts to make the perfect sugar sculpture.

Someone passing by comments on it quietly.
"Wow, that one's all thumbs."

920306.name: Legendary Secret Recipe
920306.desc:
A secret recipe found at Bleak Edge.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in the Soup of Transcendence</FONT>.

920401.name: Vacuum-Dried Powder X-1
920401.desc:
A small bottle of dry powder found in Scraplands.
What it was before it was ground is unknown.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Cykin Combat Ration Type C.</FONT>

920402.name: Vacuum-Dried Powder X-3
920402.desc:
Another bottle of powder found in Scraplands.
What it was before it was ground is unknown.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Cykin Combat Ration Type C.</FONT>

920403.name: Sceptrum Prescription
920403.desc:
A prescription found in the Heart of Sceptrum.
It's for the Cooking Master, not the pharmacist, in Stern.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Sceptrumpam 3mg.</FONT>

920404.name: Adrenaline Boost Fluid
920404.desc:
Injection fluid that wandering merchants in Arthetine sell.
It will provide energy, but it definitely won't taste good.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Boosting Fluid Soup.</FONT>

920405.name: Unknown Crystallized Bauble
920405.desc:
A crystal that the Cooking Ingredient Merchant in Stern sells.
Taking it outside Arthetine is prohibited by law.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Unknown Liquid XD-6353.</FONT>

920406.name: IX-IX1X1I12123X1
920406.desc:
The Unknown Crystallized Bauble was ground into fine powder.
Its name is extremely complicated. Try not to get confused!

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Unknown Liquid XD-6353.</FONT>

920428.desc:
The Unknown Crystallized Bauble was ground into fine powder.
Its name is extremely complicated. Try not to get confused!

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Unknown Liquid XD-6353.</FONT>

920601.name: Special Fish Sauce
920601.desc: It's a sauce that goes very well with fish.

920602.name: Giant Ice Fragment
920602.desc:
A giant ice fragment shaved and made smaller.
On its own, it's not enough to make Snowflake Shaved Ice.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in a Shushire Snowflake Shaved Ice.</FONT>

920603.name: Shattered Ice Fragment
920603.desc:
A Shattered Ice Fragment obtained in Shushire. It has a bittersweet aftertaste.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in a Shushire Snowflake Shaved Ice.</FONT>

920604.name: Crushed Ice Fragment
920604.desc:
A piece of ice occasionally obtained when shaving Giant Ice Fragments.
It's the perfect ingredient for a delicious iced dessert.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Shushire Snowflake Shaved Ice.</FONT>

920701.name: Back Alley Rum
920701.desc:
Special rum made by an artisan in the back alley.
It's said to revive dead hair roots. 

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Wonderful Rum.</FONT>

920702.name: Old Boots
920702.desc:
Its smell hits your nose even from a distance.
Whoever owns it must not be the cleanest Umar in the world.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Coolkur Beer.</FONT>

920703.name: Craft Beer
920703.desc:
Fresh beer brewed by the master brewer Coolkur himself at Wonderful Brewery.
You must drink it out of the right beer stein to taste its flavor at its best.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Coolkur Beer.
You must go to the General Merchant of the Great Castle to obtain the ingredient: Craft Beer once again.</FONT>

920704.name: Full Mine Car Ham Set
920704.desc:
A collection of various hams to go inside the Mine Car Lunchbox.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Mine Car Lunchbox.</FONT>

920705.name: Smelly Cheese Chest
920705.desc:
A chest that contains smelly cheese.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>When used, there is a chance that it will transform into a different cheese.</FONT>

920706.name: Fermenting Cheese
920706.desc:
A piece of cheese fermented inside the chest. It's still edible.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Neria's Cheese Snack.</FONT>

920707.name: Over-fermented Cheese
920707.desc:
A piece of cheese that has been overly fermented inside the chest. It smells like feet.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Neria's Cheese Snack.</FONT>

920708.name: Smelly Boots Chest
920708.desc:
A chest that contains smelly boots.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>When used, there is a chance that it will transform into different boots.</FONT>

920709.name: Funny-smelling Boots
920709.desc:
A pair of boots worn by a young Umar man who likes to run around.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Neria's Cheese Snack.</FONT>

920710.name: Stinky Boots
920710.desc:
A pair of boots that stinks like hell. Whose boots are these?

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Neria's Cheese Snack.</FONT>

920711.name: Ruined Neria's Cheese Snack
920711.desc:
It smells so awful that no one dares to take a bite.
This is not what you would call a snack.
Throw it out immediately.

920712.name: Fresh Worm Head
920712.desc:
The head of a freshly butchered worm.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Worm Head Jelly.</FONT>

920713.name: Prepped Worm Head
920713.desc:
Likely to be acquired while handling the head of the freshly-caught worm.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Worm Head Jelly.</FONT>

920714.name: Prepped Worm Skin
920714.desc:
May be acquired while handling the head of the freshly-caught worm.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Worm Head Jelly.</FONT>

920715.name: Stale Uncooked Mushroom
920715.desc:
A mushroom that smells quite stale.
Only grows in Unfinished Garden.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Top-Grade Stir-fried Mushroom.</FONT>

920716.name: Sour Uncooked Mushroom
920716.desc:
A mushroom that smells quite acidic.
Only grows in Unfinished Garden.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Top-Grade Stir-fried Mushroom.</FONT>

920717.name: Sweet Uncooked Mushroom
920717.desc:
A mushroom that smells quite sweet.
Only grows in Unfinished Garden.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Top-Grade Stir-fried Mushroom.</FONT>

920718.name: Pink Mushroom Stir-fry Sauce
920718.desc:
A pink sauce made with unknown ingredients.
It is used to intensify the aroma of a flavorful dish.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Top-Grade Stir-fried Mushroom.</FONT>

920719.name: Quality Imported Seafood
920719.desc:
This is high quality seafood imported from a different continent.
Somewhere in <FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Yorn's Cradle</FONT>, if you put ingredients into a <FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Magick Cauldron</FONT>, it'll transform into another ingredient.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of the Great Stew.</FONT>

920720.name: Quality Imported Produce
920720.desc:
This is a high quality agricultural product imported from a different continent.
Somewhere in <FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Black Anvil Mine</FONT>, if you put ingredients into a <FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Magick Cauldron</FONT>, it'll transform into another ingredient.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of the Great Stew.</FONT>

920721.name: Quality Imported Meat
920721.desc:
This is a high quality livestock product imported from a different continent.
Somewhere in the <FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Hall of Promise</FONT>, if you put ingredients into a <FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Magick Cauldron</FONT>, it'll transform into another ingredient.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of the Great Stew.</FONT>

920722.name: Thick Seafood Stew
920722.desc:
The unusual power of the magick cauldron in Yorn's Cradle has given rise to an enriched seafood stew with a mysterious aroma. 

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of the Great Stew.</FONT>

920723.name: Thick Harvest Stew
920723.desc:
The special magick power of the Magick Cauldron in Black Anvil Mine has given rise to an enriched harvested products stew with a mysterious aroma.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'> Key ingredient of the Great Stew.</FONT>

920724.name: Thick Meat Stew
920724.desc:
The special magick power of the Magick Cauldron in the Hall of Promise has given rise to an enriched livestock stew with a mysterious aroma.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'> Key ingredient of the great stew.</FONT>

920725.name: Empty Rum Bottle
920725.desc:
An empty bottle of Wonderful Rum.
Bring it to a cook in Yorn to refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Wonderful Rum</font> is used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Wonderful Rum.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the bottle be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the General Merchant in the Great Castle.</FONT>

920726.name: Emptied Kulkrazan
920726.desc:
An empty stein of Coolkur Beer.
Bring it to a cook in Yorn to refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Coolkur Beer</font> is used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Coolkur Beer.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the stein be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the General Merchant in the Great Castle.</FONT>

920727.name: Food Chest for Trade
920727.desc:
Use to obtain various high-quality ingredients.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Great Stew.</FONT>

Drop rates regarding crafting Adventurer's Tome Specialty can be viewed at
<font color='#ffd200'>Lost Ark Shop > Drop Rates</font>.

920728.name: Ruined Thick Stew
920728.desc:
The magick cauldron must be broken. It does not look like a stew at all.
Throw it out immediately.

920801.name: Sweet Mojito
920801.desc:
Discovered a sweet-scented liquor hidden in an old barrel.

Drinking it might put me <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>in the right state of mind</font> allowing me to find a <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden area</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of a Starsand Cocktail.</FONT>

920802.name: Punika Gin
920802.desc:
A drink buried in a pile of sand while someone plans for the future.

Drinking it might put me <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>in the right state of mind</font> allowing me to find a <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden area</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of a Starsand Cocktail.</FONT>

920803.name: Raw Boar Meat
920803.desc:
Thick slices of raw boar's meat.
It won't be easy to eat the meat without getting the smell all over you.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Kaloa Boar BBQ.</FONT>

920804.name: Banana Leaf
920804.desc:
Commonly seen huge leaf in Punika. Great for getting rid of smell of meat.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Kaloa Boar BBQ.</FONT>

920805.name: Savory-looking Flower
920805.desc:
Savory flower for eating. Mainly used as a salad ingredient.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Flower Salad.</FONT>

920806.name: Sour-looking Flower
920806.desc:
Sour-flavored flower for eating. Mainly used as a salad ingredient.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Flower Salad.</FONT>

920807.name: Sweet-looking Flower
920807.desc:
Sweet-flavored flower for eating. Mainly used as a salad ingredient.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Flower Salad.</FONT>

920809.name: Ripe Banana
920809.desc:
Well ripened banana. Sweet scent touches your nose.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Roasted Banana Powder.</FONT>

920810.name: Roasted Banana Powder
920810.desc:
After roasting ripe bananas in a stove, dry them sufficiently in a sunny place to make powder.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Use them to make "Fermenting Banana Bread Dough."</FONT>

920811.name: Ripening Banana Bread Dough
920811.desc:
A dough made with banana powder.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Requires a certain amount of aging.</FONT>

920812.name: Failed Dough
920812.desc:
The tragic result of inexperienced hands.
It would be best to throw it away.

920813.name: Well-fermented dough
920813.desc:
The well-made dough is fully fermented.
Let's make banana-shaped bread with the fermented dough.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Wild Banana Bread.</FONT>

920814.name: Papu Crab
920814.desc:
Big Papu Crab only found in Punika.
Can acquire it at low chance by defeating Moake.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Steamed Papu Crab.</FONT>

920815.name: Tunia Herb
920815.desc:
Commonly found herb in Punika.
Helps to enhance the flavor of cooked dishes.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Punika Festival Dish.</FONT>

920816.name: Wine Bottle Hidden by Someone
920816.desc:
Sweet tropical fruit that can be found in Seashore.
Monsters hid them to eat them in secret.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Punika Festival Dish.</FONT>

920817.name: Sweet Tropical Fruit
920817.desc:
Sweet tropical fruit that can be found in Punika.
Monsters hid them to eat them in secret.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Punika Festival Dish.</FONT>

920818.name: Thick Lean Meat
920818.desc:
A thick chunk of meat that is suited to be used in festive dishes.
Let's collect them and bring them to Nias.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Punika Festival Dish.</FONT>

920819.name: Emptied Starsand Cocktail
920819.desc:
An empty Starsand Cocktail glass.
Bring it to a chef in Punika to refill it at a reasonable price.
The <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Starsand Cocktail</font> is used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft another Starsand Cocktail.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the glass be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the General Merchant in Nia Village.</FONT>

920820.name: Empty Sweet Mojito
920820.desc:
An empty Sweet Mojito bottle.
The chef in Punika can refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Sweet Mojito</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Sweet Mojito</FONT>.

920821.name: Empty Punika Gin
920821.desc:
An empty Punika Gin bottle.
The chef in Punika can refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Punika Gin</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Punika Gin</FONT>.

920901.name: Chew Jelly
920901.desc:
Jellies made with Moldy-mold Spores occasionally found around Lake Shiverwave. Young Sylvains must have hidden them to eat later.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Jelly Chew.</FONT>

920902.name: Chew Chew Jelly
920902.desc:
Jellies made with Moldy-mold Spores occasionally found around Lake Shiverwave. Young Sylvains must have hidden them to eat later.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Jelly Chew.</FONT>

920903.name: Chew Chew Chew Jelly
920903.desc:
Jellies made with Moldy-mold Spores occasionally found around Lake Shiverwave. Young Sylvains must have hidden them to eat later.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Jelly Chew.</FONT>

920904.name: Honey Butter
920904.desc:
The mixture of honey and butter made by magick.
It's essentially a slab of butter that smells like honey. Used in certain recipes.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient of Honey Butter Beer.</FONT>

920905.name: Beer
920905.desc:
Beer sold in Rohendel is known for its strong fizziness.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient of Honey Butter Beer.</FONT>

920906.name: Captured Tooki's Tears
920906.desc:
A drop of Tooki's tear. Tookies shed tears when they run away from danger.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>This item can be obtained from Lost Tookies.
A key ingredient in Tooki Tooki Soup.</FONT>

920907.name: Purified Lotus Flower Water
920907.desc:
Water purified by the magical lotus flower in Glass Lotus Lake.
Its effect of cleansing corruption makes it a popular material sought after by many people in different fields.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Sparkling Elemental Food.</FONT>

920908.name: 1st Contaminated Elemental Food
920908.desc:
When Xeneela was destroyed, the foods that elementals consumed became contaminated as well. This item can be obtained near Destroyed Xeneela.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Sparkling Elemental Food.</FONT>

920909.name: 2nd Contaminated Elemental Food
920909.desc:
When Xeneela was destroyed, the foods that Elementals consumed became contaminated as well. This item can be obtained from Elite monsters.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Sparkling Elemental Food.</FONT>

920910.name: 3rd Contaminated Elemental Food
920910.desc:
When Xeneela was destroyed, the foods that elementals consumed became contaminated as well. Magmadon has a low chance of dropping this item upon death.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>This item can be obtained when Magmadon resurrects.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Sparkling Elemental Food.</FONT>

920911.name: Sparkling Elemental Food
920911.desc:
Food for the Elementals purified through the use of Lotus Flower Water.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>This item has a high chance to turn into Zechbas when used.</FONT>

920912.name: Ruined Elemental Food
920912.desc:
They say it almost never fails, but yet it did.
No one would call this food anymore.
Throw it out immediately.

920913.name: Magick Snail
920913.desc:
A magick snail that inhabits different areas in Elzowin's Shade.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Snail Roll Cake.</FONT>

920914.name: Magick Albino Snail
920914.desc:
It looks like a regular magick snail, but it glows and turns white under the moonlight.
It's a rare kind that does not get caught more than once in 100 years.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Snail Roll Cake.</FONT>

920915.name: Honey Butter Beer
920915.desc:
It's sweet, but the flavor isn't just perfect yet.
What's missing here? Try making it again.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>There is a slight chance that you produce Sweet Honey Butter Beer when crafting Honey Butter Beer.</FONT>

920916.name: Azure Energy Concentrate
920916.desc:
A blue energy commonly found all over Rohendel.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Ether Essence.</FONT>

920917.name: Magical Fermentation Boost
920917.desc:
Powder made from a flower growing in Rohendel.
It boosts the fermentation of liquor.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Ether Essence.</FONT>

920918.name: Magical Soup
920918.desc:
A soup with enhanced absorption abilities, using the power of magick.
This can be used in various Rohendel dishes.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient of Tooki Tooki soup.</FONT>

920919.name: Secret Cake Recipe
920919.desc:
A note that has recipes written by a master cakemaker.
It's sealed with magick and cannot be read.
Bring it to a cook in Rohendel.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Snail Roll Cake.</FONT>

920920.name: Empty Beer Stein
920920.desc:
An empty stein of Sweet Honey Butter Beer.
Bring it to a cook in Rohendel to refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Sweet Honey Butter Beer</font> is used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Sweet Honey Butter Beer.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the stein be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the General Merchant in Rothun.</FONT>

920921.name: Empty Ether Bottle
920921.desc:
An empty bottle of Ether Essence.
Bring it to a cook in Rohendel to refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Ether Essence</font> is used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Ether Essence.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the bottle be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the General Merchant in Rothun.</FONT>

921001.name: Lean Meat Chunk
921001.desc:
A lump of lean meat carved from hunted animals in the Wailing Swamp region

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Avesta's Smoked Beef Jerky.</FONT>

921002.name: Fatty Part
921002.desc:
A lump of fat carved from hunted animals in Wailing Swamp region

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Avesta's Smoked Beef Jerky.</FONT>

921003.name: Joint Part Meat
921003.desc:
A lump of cartilage meat carved from hunted animals in Wailing Swamp region

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Avesta's Smoked Beef Jerky.</FONT>

921004.name: Blood Pudding Chunk
921004.desc:
A high-quality chunk of clotted blood sold by Feiton Wandering Merchants.
The gamey smell has been removed via master craftsman techniques.
Useful things are said to be hard to find.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Feiton Blood Sausage.</FONT>

921005.name: Feiton Eel Meat
921005.desc:
Freshly caught Feiton Eel meat.
Even after filleting, the lean meat gives off the smell of muddy water.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Eel Herb Kholodets.</FONT>

921006.name: Cooking Herb
921006.desc:
A cooking herb found in Wailing Swamp region.
It's subtle but its aroma is unique.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Eel Herb Kholodets.</FONT>

921007.name: Ryucrokota Fatty Tissue
921007.desc:
A fatty tissue carved after hunting Ryucrokota.
It's too much to just eat it raw.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Ryucrokota Salo.</FONT>

921008.name: Feiton Azure Salt
921008.desc:
Blue salt that is deep in between the cracks in the carapace of the Blue Insecta's body.
The amount from one bug is small but because it is so salty, an adult Delain can make it last for an entire week.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Ryucrokota Salo.</FONT>

921009.name: Not Fully Fermented Ryucrokota Salo
921009.desc:
A dish made by fermenting Ryucrokota fatty tissue whole.
It is giving off a gamey smell because it needs more time to ferment.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's probably not a good idea to eat it now.</FONT>

921010.name: Unknown Intestine
921010.desc:
The innards of a freshly caught Krakan.
It's completely impossible to identify what this is, unless it was the person who caught the Krakan.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Krakan Intestine Cream Soup.</FONT>

921011.name: Intestine that may be used for cooking
921011.desc:
Often gathered from Krakan innards.
It looks and smells like it might be edible.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Krakan Intestine Cream Soup.</FONT>

921012.name: Fine Intestine
921012.desc:
Sometimes gathered from Krakan innards.
It looks and smells quite edible.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Krakan Intestine Cream Soup.</FONT>

921013.name: Wood Blood
921013.desc:
A very potent Feiton distilled liquor made by distilling tree fruit wine.
The strong woody aroma and red color appeal to one's senses.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be refined into a Bloody Fist.</FONT>

921014.name: Shoddy Booze
921014.desc:
A failed batch of Wood Blood that was brewed too quickly.
According to the Delains, drinking it can make you go blind.

Drinking it might put me <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>in the right state of mind</font> allowing me to find a <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden area</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Its distillation has failed. Throw it away.</FONT>

921015.name: Somewhat Complete Distilled Beverage
921015.desc:
A somewhat complete distilled spirit.
It still smells too rough and pungent to be enjoyable.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be refined into a Bloody Fist.</FONT>

921016.name: Almost Complete Distilled Beverage
921016.desc:
A near-perfect distilled spirit. You're almost there.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be refined into a Bloody Fist.</FONT>

921017.name: Eel Caviar
921017.desc:
Flavorful caviar made with Feiton eel roe.
Maybe Feiton eels store all their nutrients in their roe.
Sometimes obtaining by defeating Ancheladus.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>An essential ingredient for Eel Caviar Salad.</FONT>

921018.name: Plainweed
921018.desc:
The poisonous plants growing in Feiton make delicious food once their poison is removed.
Especially, the rare red-colored Plainweed is rich with beta-carotene.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>An essential ingredient for Eel Caviar Salad.</FONT>

921019.name: Swamp Moss
921019.desc:
The poisonous plants growing in Feiton make for delicious food... once their poison is removed.
Especially, the white-colored moss found in marshes is rich with allicin.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>An essential ingredient for Eel Caviar Salad.</FONT>

921020.name: Vine Needle Grass
921020.desc:
The poisonous plants growing in Feiton make for delicious food... once their poison is removed.
Especially, the green-colored parasitic plant, Vineneedles, is rich with chlorophyll.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>An essential ingredient for Eel Caviar Salad.</FONT>

921021.name: Emptied Bloody Fist
921021.desc:
An empty bottle of Bloody Fist.
Bring it to a cook in Feiton to refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Bloody Fist</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Bloody Fist.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the bottle be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the General Merchant in Kalaja.</FONT>

921031.name: Fresh Vegetable Supply
921031.desc: When used, various fresh vegetable ingredients come out.

921101.name: Vine
921101.desc:
A vine found in the vine grove at Parna Forest.
It's extremely tough. It's amazing that it's actually used as a cooking ingredient.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Balankar Ranger's Salad.</FONT>

921102.name: Proxima Stem
921102.desc:
A part of Proxima stem sold at Rania Village.
It has been detoxified. 

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Proxima Course Meal.</FONT>

921103.name: Proxima Root
921103.desc:
The root of Proxima sold at Rania Village.
It has been detoxified. 

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Proxima Course Meal.</FONT>

921104.name: Fesnar Poison Mushroom
921104.desc:
A poisonous mushroom found in Fesnar Highland.
People use this as a cooking ingredient after neutralizing its toxin.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Fesnar Poison Mushroom Stew.</FONT>

921105.name: Natural Proxima Skin
921105.desc:
The outer skin of Proxima that has a distinctive smell.
It's a valuable food ingredient, but contains deadly poison.
Make sure to have a professional Proxima chef neutralize its toxin.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Proxima Course Meal.</FONT>

921201.name: Sky Bean Pod
921201.desc:
A pod that grows from Sky Bean Trees.
You can open the pod to harvest the beans inside.
Some of them contain a treasure trove waiting to be found.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient for a Bowl of Sky Beans.</FONT>

921202.name: Sky Bean
921202.desc:
A blue bean that is commonly found in Elgacia.
One bean won't fill you up.
In Elgacia, people gather lots of Sky Beans, add wine, and boil it over the brazier.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient for a Bowl of Sky Beans.</FONT>

921203.name: Bowl of Cold Sky Beans
921203.desc:
A hot bowl of Sky Beans that has gone cold after it was left alone for a long time.
It feels like you'll be cursed with bad luck if you eat it.

921204.name: Grape Extract
921204.desc:
Grape juice that is easily purchased from ordinary ingredient merchants in Elgacia.
It is often used to add flavor to various dishes, or it can be fermented and made into wine.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient for Vino Malbec.</FONT>

921205.name: Berry Flavored Wine
921205.desc:
After the grape juice was fermented, it now smells of berries.
It might be better to wait until it's more fermented to eat.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient for Vino Malbec.</FONT>

921206.name: Berry and Chocolate Flavored Wine
921206.desc:
The grape juice was further fermented, and it now gives off a chocolatey aroma on top of the berry fragrance.
Ferment it just a little more and it'll transform into wine with a rich, elegant scent.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient for Vino Malbec.</FONT>

921207.name: Crystal Turtle Essence
921207.desc: Among the Crystal Turtles that live in Elgacia, the shape or number of crystals that grow on their shells are sometimes poor. However, there are some turtles that grow shimmering essences within their bodies. One dessert merchant in Elgacia performed a series of processes to extract this essence and was able to offer a new, never before seen dessert to his customers. That dessert is now all the rage in Elgacia. "This feels like the creation of gorgeous art. It's just like trying to memorize a secret number, 4 seconds... Um... I can't remember." A key ingredient for Sunset Cloud Cotton Candy. I should collect four Crystal Turtle Essences to try the cotton candy draw.

921208.name: Redberry
921208.desc:
A red fruit that can be picked from the trees on the Garden Sentinels.
It shines red and has the perfect balance of sweet and tangy.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient for Beriberi Salad.</FONT>

921209.name: Blueberry
921209.desc:
A blue fruit that can be picked from the trees on the Garden Sentinels.
It gives off a strange blue light, but the inside is extremely sweet.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient for Beriberi Salad.</FONT>

921210.name: Blackberry
921210.desc:
A dark blue fruit that can be picked from the trees on the Garden Sentinels.
It has a bittersweet taste.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient for Beriberi Salad.</FONT>

921211.name: Golden Apple
921211.desc: An apple that gives off a shimmering golden light. You don't even have to peel it. The fresh apple smell and rich honey flavor will have you coming back for more. These golden apples are rare even in Elgacia, and only a lucky few have tried them. Rumors say that a single apple will fill you up when you're starving, and yet there's always room in your stomach for one even after a big dinner. "All my years of trying to find this golden apple have finally paid off! I must have this apple! Agh! That hurt! Where did this snake come from?" A key ingredient for Golden Apple Pie.

921212.name: Bitten Golden Apple
921212.desc:
Unable to resist my curiosity, I took a bite out of the golden apple. Too late, I came to my senses.
I can't use this in a dish now.
Why don't I just turn it slightly...?

921213.name: Lightweight Golden Apple
921213.desc: An apple that gives off a shimmering golden light. You don't even have to peel it. The fresh apple smell and rich honey flavor will have you coming back for more. These golden apples are rare even in Elgacia, and only a lucky few have tried them. Rumors say that a single apple will fill you up when you're starving, and yet there's always room in your stomach for one even after a big dinner. It feels a bit lighter. "Perfection!" A key ingredient for Golden Apple Pie.

921220.name: Empty Vino Malbec
921220.desc:
An empty bottle of Vino Malbec.
Bring it to a cook in Elgacia to refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Vino Malbec</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Vino Malbec.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the bottle be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the Cooking Ingredient Shop called Delicate Wood in Ereonnor.</FONT>

921221.name: Empty Orpenectar
921221.desc:
An empty Orpenectar stein.
Bring it to a cook in Elgacia to refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Orpenectar</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Orpenectar.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the stein be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the Cooking Ingredient Shop called Delicate Wood in Ereonnor.</FONT>

921301.name: Kurzan Halite Powder
921301.desc:
Rock salt found throughout Kurzan.
A slight lick reveals a faint salty taste.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Wishful Cookie.</FONT>

921302.name: Hardened Sacrian Stone Bread
921302.desc:
Bread distributed by Sacria to the priests in Kurzan.
It looks too tough to be eaten in this condition.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in making Sacrian Stone Bread.</FONT>

921303.name: Poisonous Stem
921303.desc:
Stems cut from plants native to Kurzan.
They appear to be inedible in their current state, contaminated with Miasma.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Withered Stem.</FONT>

921304.name: Poison-Free Stem
921304.desc:
Stripping away the coarse skin of the plant stem reveals its inner layer.
Sun-drying has somewhat neutralized the Miasma, but it appears not yet fit for consumption.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Withered Stem.</FONT>

921305.name: Withering Stem
921305.desc:
After removing the outer layer and Miasma, the plant stem goes through several cycles of steaming and drying.
This process makes it increasingly thick and dense.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Withered Stem.</FONT>

921308.name: Kurzan Halite
921308.desc:
Chunk of rock salt found throughout Kurzan.
A slight lick reveals a faint salty taste.
The elements within the rock salt reportedly transform into unusual colors upon exposure to fire.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Millennium Soup.</FONT>

921309.name: Mysterious Material Sack
921309.desc:
A cooking ingredient used by Assar Delains to make combat rations.
It's said that no one but the master chef Delain should ever open it.
Occasionally, there's a rustling noise coming from within the sack.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Mysterious Black Jelly.</FONT>

921310.name: Mildly Polluted Water
921310.desc:
Water tainted with Miasma.
It isn't instantly lethal when drunk, but it is polluted.
In Kurzan, even water of this quality is rare and challenging to acquire.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient for a Glass of Purified Water.</FONT>

921311.name: Simple Purifier
921311.desc:
A depurant for water that has been contaminated with Miasma.
The effectiveness of this purifier doesn't seem very impressive.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient for a Glass of Purified Water.</FONT>

921312.name: Quality Purifier
921312.desc:
A depurant for water that has been contaminated with Miasma.
Its purification efficiency is better than that of Simple Depurant.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient for a Glass of Purified Water.</FONT>

921313.name: Military Purifier
921313.desc:
Purification devices that were provided to Sacrian priests in Kurzan to ensure a healthy water supply.
These Sacrian priests often gifted them to the Delains they would associate with.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient for a Glass of Purified Water.</FONT>

921315.name: Empty Millennium Soup
921315.desc:
The Millennium Soup was completely emptied, leaving only an empty pot behind.
The chef in South Kurzan can refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Millennium Soup</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden spaces</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Millennium Soup.</FONT>

921401.name: Tightly Covered Rum
921401.desc:
A bottle of rum found in Grayhammer Mine. It seems it's sealed dead tight
and looks stale.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Miner's Rum.</FONT>

921402.name: Special Egg Rice Recipe
921402.desc:
A recipe for an egg rice that someone dropped under a chair in Medrick Monastery.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Efferin's Egg Rice.</FONT>

921403.name: Maneating Bear's Gall Bladder
921403.desc:
A gallbladder of a bear found lying around between two giant rocks in Bilbrin Forest.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Bear Gallbladder Skewer.</FONT>

921404.name: Rovlen's Tentacle
921404.desc:
A small tentacle obtained from Rovlen in Bilbrin Forest. It's still wriggling.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>This item will turn into a Wriggling Raw Tentacle when the duration ends.</FONT>

921405.name: Hairplant
921405.desc:
A herb sold by Wandering Merchants in West Luterra.
Its name was coined from its resemblance to Human hair. Popularly used as a hair growth remedy in the west.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>An essential ingredient for Medrick Hair Loss Solution.</FONT>

921501.name: Luterran Courtesies
921501.desc:
An item sold somewhere in Luterra Castle.
The book has all the dining etiquettes one has to learn to eat properly.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Luterran Course Meal.</FONT>

921502.name: Sirloin
921502.desc:
Meat that wandering merchants in East Luterra sell.
It's a special cut that nobles like to eat.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Luterran Course Meal.</FONT>

921503.name: Rock Cave Shellfish
921503.desc:
A shellfish found under a waterfall inside the rocky cave at Croconys Seashore.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Gourmet Seafood Stew.</FONT>

921504.name: Rock Cave Shrimp
921504.desc:
A shrimp found under a waterfall inside the rocky cave at Croconys Seashore.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Gourmet Seafood Stew.</FONT>

921505.name: Spoiled Dough
921505.desc:
A ball of dough left from failed attempts to make the perfect donut.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a failure. Throw it away.</FONT>

921701.name: Salt Worm Droppings
921701.desc:
Feces of salt worms inhabiting Saland Hill. Strange things are stuck inside the surface.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Worm-Filtered Coffee.</FONT>

921702.name: Hidden Encavian Liquor Bottle
921702.desc:
A liquor bottle from the Encavian age found in Sapira Cave.
Encavians must have forgotten that they kept it there.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Age-old Encavian Wine.</FONT>

921703.name: Old Encavian Food Chest
921703.desc:
An old food chest from the Encavian age found in Ozhorn Hill.
It is known that Encavians preserved meat in salt to store it for a long time.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Salted Food Box.</FONT>

921704.name: Ritual Food Ingredient
921704.desc:
A chest containing various ingredients needed for the rainmaking ritual.
Talk to Hella in Saland Hill.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Rainmaking Ritual Food.</FONT>

921705.name: Crystallized Salt
921705.desc:
Crystallized salt formed over a long time.
It's an ingredient in Salt Crackers,
which are extremely difficult to make.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>There is a small chance that this item will turn into a Salt Cracker when used.</FONT>

921707.name: Broken Cracker
921707.desc:
This ugly salt cracker is a complete failure.
It doesn't look pretty or edible. Throw it away.

921901.name: Fresh Oyster
921901.desc:
Fresh oysters, best when steamed.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Steamed Oyster with White Wine.</FONT>

921902.name: Candarian Cold Lager Recipe, Part One
921902.desc:
On Candarian Cold Lager #1
Unlike Rohendel, where beer has become trendy only recently, in Vern, the history of beer goes all the way back to times of the foundation of the kingdom. Vern in its early days drew all the races of the world, and among them were Umars of Yorn, who introduced beer to the kingdom.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Candarian Lager.</FONT>

921903.name: Candarian Cold Lager Recipe, Part Two
921903.desc:
On Candarian Cold Lager #2
Not long after Umars first introduced beer in Vern, this golden, foamy liquid grew popular among the other races. The Humans of South Vern, in particular, showed unusual passion for this drink.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Candarian Lager.</FONT>

921904.name: Candarian Cold Lager Recipe, Part Three
921904.desc:
On Candarian Cold Lager #3
The drink would hit the spot after a long day's work with its bitter and fresh taste. It was very affordable. In the earliest days of the kingdom of Vern, the laborers would espouse the virtue of this magical drink. They were destined to consume beer like there is no tomorrow.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Candarian Lager.</FONT>

921905.name: Candarian Cold Lager Recipe, Part Four
921905.desc:
On Candarian Cold Lager #4
Beer had soon spread across all of South Vern, thanks to the first Human brewers. What is most astounding is that each brewer began branching out with their own unique twists on the drink, each granting unique properties.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Candarian Lager.</FONT>

921906.name: Candarian Cold Lager Recipe, Part Five
921906.desc:
On Candarian Cold Lager #5
The most popular among Human-brewed drink was Candarian Cold Lager. With its extreme freshness and peerless affordability, Candarian Cold Lager would soon become the most loved drink in South Vern.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Candarian Lager.</FONT>

921907.name: Candarian Cold Lager Recipe, Part Six
921907.desc:
On Candarian Cold Lager #6
The secrets of the success were the cold storage with the help of some magick and mass production to reduce cost. It was Human brewers who first combined the technologies of Sylvains and Umars. However, due to its production process, the beer doesn't have much flavor, which made it unpopular among beer aficionados.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Candarian Lager.</FONT>

921908.name: Chicken Wings
921908.desc:
Easily one the most iconic parts of a chicken.
The chewy and fatty wings, far superior to the legs, are the best ingredient for Bellion Wings.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Bellion Wings.</FONT>

921909.name: Ingredient: Meat
921909.desc:
A sack containing all sorts of meat.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Vernilaya.</FONT>

921910.name: Ingredient: Seafood
921910.desc:
A sack containing all sorts of seafood.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Vernilaya.</FONT>

921911.name: Gray Bait Material
921911.desc:
A paste bait in gray.
Mix it with Red Paste Bait and Orange Bait in the ratio of 7:7:7 to create the Golden Bait of the right scent, color, and texture.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Mix them well to create the Golden Bait for Crayfish.</FONT>

921912.name: Red Bait Material
921912.desc:
A paste bait in red.
Mix it with Red Paste Bait and Orange Bait in the ratio of 7:7:7 to create the Golden Bait of the right scent, color, and texture.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Mix them well to create the Golden Bait for Crayfish.</FONT>

921913.name: Orange Bait Material
921913.desc:
A paste bait in orange.
Mix it with Red Paste Bait and Gray Bait in the ratio of 7:7:7 to create the Golden Bait of the right scent, color, and texture.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Mix them well to create the Golden Bait for Crayfish.</FONT>

921914.name: Bait for Crayfish
921914.desc:
Golden Bait (Unused)

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Crayfish and Vegetable.</FONT>

921915.name: Crayfish
921915.desc:
Crayfish Caught with Golden Bait.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Crayfish and Vegetable.</FONT>

921916.name: Uncommon Brisket
921916.desc:
The high quality brisket of the cows raised from the highlands of South Vern.
The cheap meat has less flavor than other parts, but when it comes to brisket, it's the best.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Vernese Brisket.</FONT>

921917.name: Brisket Dry Rub
921917.desc:
The rub used as an ingredient of a brisket dish.
The meat is flavorful with all kinds of spices, salt, pepper, and dried vegetable.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Vernese Brisket.</FONT>

921918.name: Brisket Being Cooked
921918.desc:
A not yet done brisket.
Cook it 2 more hours and coat it with the rub again.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's still far from done.</FONT>

921919.name: Brisket, Ready for Dry Rub
921919.desc:
It's time to coat the brisket with rub.
If you don't coat it with the rub now, you may ruin the dish.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Use the item to coat the brisket with the rub.</FONT>

921920.name: Brisket Being Cooked Again
921920.desc:
A not yet done brisket.
Cook it 2 more hours and coat it with the rub again.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It looks half done.</FONT>

921921.name: Brisket, Ready for Dry Rub
921921.desc:
It's time to coat the brisket with rub.
If you don't coat it with the rub now, you may ruin the dish.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Use the item to coat the brisket with the rub.</FONT>

921922.name: Reheated Brisket
921922.desc:
A not yet done brisket.
Cook it 2 more hours and coat it with the rub again.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>One coating of rub and it will be done.</FONT>

921923.name: Brisket, Ready for Dry Rub
921923.desc:
It's time to coat the brisket with rub.
If you don't coat it with the rub now, you may ruin the dish.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Use the item to coat the brisket with the rub.</FONT>

921924.name: Nearly Cooked Brisket
921924.desc:
A not yet done brisket.
Cook it 2 more hours and the perfect brisket will be ready.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Soon, it will be done!</FONT>

921925.name: Ruined Brisket
921925.desc:
A lump of ruined brisket.
It looks okay, but the inside is burnt.
Try it again.

921926.name: Empty Candarian Cold Lager Bottle
921926.desc:
An empty Candarian Cold Lager stein.
Bring it to a cook in South Vern to refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Candarian Cold Lager</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Candarian Cold Lager.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the stein be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the General Merchant in the Bellion Ruins.</FONT>

921927.name: Empty Magical Vernese Brandy Bottle
921927.desc:
An empty bottle of Magical Vernese Brandy.
Bring it to a cook in South Vern to refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Magical Vernese Brandy</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Magical Vernese Brandy.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the bottle be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the General Merchant in the Bellion Ruins.</FONT>

922101.name: Sliced Deer Meat
922101.desc:
Thinly sliced venison.
Venison from Rimeria is renowned for its quality, making it a favorite among the burly Yoz of the North Island.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Chargrilled Neobianyi.</FONT>

922102.name: Questionable Fish
922102.desc:
An ordinary freshwater fish.
The fish's exact condition is unclear, so a closer inspection might be necessary.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Salt-Grilled Freshwater Fish.</FONT>

922103.name: Good Quality Fish
922103.desc:
The meat is firm, and the flesh is in fresh condition.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Salt-Grilled Freshwater Fish.</FONT>

922104.name: Low Quality Fish
922104.desc:
The flesh is mushy, and the fish appears to be in poor condition.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Nevertheless, it's a key ingredient of Salt-Grilled Freshwater Fish.</FONT>

922105.name: Mediocre Salt-Grilled Freshwater Fish
922105.desc:
Skewered freshwater fish from Akasha Lake, generously seasoned with coarse salt and grilled over an open flame, delivers a bold, primal flavor.

The key to this dish lies in how well the salt is applied. A strong, swift sprinkle ensures the salt penetrates the crevices of the prepared fish, resulting in a grilled fish with a rich umami flavor.

On the other hand, if the salt is improperly applied or the fish isn't fresh, the flesh can lose its shape and fall apart. Such fish aren't discarded but are pieced together on a skewer and grilled. Despite losing quite a bit of its meat, it still passes as a fish skewer.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Should I... try it?</FONT>

922106.name: Edible Flower
922106.desc:
Fragrant flowers cultivated for consumption.
In Rimeria, it is said that gifting decorative flowers often leads to receiving edible flowers in return.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Candied Fruit Flower.</FONT>

922107.name: Faded Golden Apple
922107.desc:
The rare golden apple, seldom seen on the surface.
It was obtained by a wandering merchant, originally brought by the Lazeniths of Elgacia to promote harmony with the surface-dwelling races.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Corn Tea and Toast With Golden Apple Jam.</FONT>

922108.name: Curiously Lightweight Faded Golden Apple
922108.desc:
The golden apple, seldom seen on the surface.
It was obtained by a wandering merchant, originally brought by the Lazeniths of Elgacia to promote harmony with the surface-dwelling races.
For some reason...
it feels a bit light.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Corn Tea and Toast With Golden Apple Jam.</FONT>

922109.name: Dried Corn
922109.desc:
Corn that has been carefully dried in a sunny spot after harvest.
The dried corn is mainly used for brewing tea.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Corn Tea and Toast With Golden Apple Jam.</FONT>

922110.name: Ordinary Acorn
922110.desc:
Acorns easily spotted on Yan's Path.
They are scattered around and can be readily found anywhere.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Smoked Acorn Mushroom Noodles.</FONT>

922111.name: Smooth Acorn
922111.desc:
Acorns that can often be found along Yan's Path.
Smooth and in good condition, it's a small delight each time you pick it up.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Smoked Acorn Mushroom Noodles.</FONT>

922112.name: Shiny Acorn
922112.desc:
Acorns that can rarely be found along Yan's Path.
Its glossy surface makes it almost too precious to cook.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Smoked Acorn Mushroom Noodles.</FONT>

922113.name: Shimmering Acorn
922113.desc:
Acorns that are extremely rare to find along Yan's Path.
Infused with the earth's energy, its glossy surface gleams so brightly it sparkles like a jewel.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Smoked Acorn Mushroom Noodles.</FONT>

922114.name: Thousand Year Root
922114.desc:
A rare wild ginseng that has absorbed the mystical energy of the land over a thousand years.
Legend has it that only those chosen by the mountain spirit can find it.
Brewing medicinal herb liquor with this thousand-year ginseng is said to produce a flavor and fragrance unmatched by any other.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Thousand Year Root Liquor.</FONT>

922115.name: Empty Thousand Year Root Liquor
922115.desc:
An emptied Thousand Year Root Liquor bottle.
The chef in Shae, located in South Rimeria, can refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Thousand Year Root Liquor</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden spaces</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Thousand Year Root Liquor.</FONT>

922401.name: Rye Strand
922401.desc:
Rye obtained from Rowen's wilderness.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A crucial component of the Reindeer Cheese Meal.</FONT>

922402.name: Rye Bread
922402.desc:
A rye bread baked with the chef's own rye.
Although it's tough, the more you chew it, the more the savory taste comes out.
Eating this with milk or yogurt can further boost the flavor.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A crucial component of the Reindeer Cheese Meal.</FONT>

922403.name: Reindeer Milk
922403.desc:
Reindeer milk, which is smoother and creamier than normal cow milk.
It's sweet without adding anything extra, and it tastes clean, so it can be drunk as-is.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A crucial component of the Reindeer Cheese Meal.</FONT>

922404.name: Reindeer Milk Yoghurt
922404.desc:
A yogurt made by periodically stirring and fermenting reindeer milk.
It still contains the reindeer milk's characteristic sweet flavor, but it has a yogurt's sourness too.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A crucial component of the Reindeer Cheese Meal.</FONT>

922405.name: Reindeer Yuju
922405.desc:
A dish that couldn't be made into yogurt because the chef forgot to stir it.
It smells almost like a fermented drink. 

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Let's try it out!</FONT>

922406.name: Captured Forest Rabbit
922406.desc:
A pouch with a captured forest rabbit inside.
S-stop moving!

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A crucial component of Forest Rabbit BBQ.</FONT>

922407.name: Boar Meat
922407.desc:
The raw rib of a wild boar.
It smells too gamey, so it needs to be seasoned before eating.
Ask a professional chef to do the job. 

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A crucial component of Schertstenbalt.</FONT>

922408.name: Herring
922408.desc:
An ordinary herring caught in Rowen's sea.
Although its beady eyes look pretty cute, its fate is already sealed.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A crucial component of the Sour Herring dish.</FONT>

922409.name: Round Wooden Barrel
922409.desc:
A wooden barrel made to hold something.
Although it may not look like it, it's watertight.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A crucial component of the Sour Herring Dish.</FONT>

922410.name: Herring in Wooden Barrel
922410.desc:
A wooden barrel containing herring.
Let's add some sea water and ferment it.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A crucial component of the Sour Herring Dish.</FONT>

922411.name: Fermented Herring
922411.desc:
Herring that's being fermented with sea water.
I don't feel good about this.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A crucial component of the Sour Herring dish.</FONT>

922420.name: Empty Reindeer Bottle
922420.desc:
An emptied Reindeer Yuju glass.
The Chef in Rowen can refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Reindeer Yuju</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden spaces</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Reindeer Yuju.</FONT>

922421.name: Empty Rowen-style Schnapps
922421.desc:
An empty Rowen-Style Schnapps stein.
Bring it to a cook in Rowen to refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Rowen-Style Schnapps</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Rowen-Style Schnapps.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the stein be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the General Merchant in Fang River.</FONT>

922501.name: Quanda Fruit
922501.desc:
The fruit of quanda tree, a native tree of the Voldis Great Rainforest.
It has a faint, sweet fragrance.
Its thin skin makes it vulnerable to scratches, and once injured, it ferments within a few days.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It is the main ingredient for Raiyan Liqueur.</FONT>

922503.name: Salted Meat
922503.desc:
A processed meat made by preserving high quality meat with salt for a long time.
It has a deep flavor and smell.
It is most commonly consumed as Salted Meat.
However, because it packs a lot of flavor even in small quantities, it is also widely used as an ingredient for alchemy dishes.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It is the main ingredient for Salted Meat Roll.</FONT>

922504.name: Failed Salted Meat Roll
922504.desc:
It doesn't look like the Salted Meat Roll is made right.
But let's be polite and try it.

922505.name: First Voldisian Soup Base Clue
922505.desc:
One of the various spices that can be found all across Voldis.
These rich spices are blended together to create their own unique secret soup.
This is the first clue for Squid Sausage Platter.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It is a key ingredient for Squid Sausage Platter.</FONT>

922506.name: Second Voldisian Soup Base Clue
922506.desc:
Another one of the various spices that can be found all across Voldis.
These rich spices are blended together to create their own unique secret soup.
This is the second clue for Squid Sausage Platter.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It is a key ingredient for Squid Sausage Platter.</FONT>

922507.name: Squid
922507.desc:
It cannot be caught in the warm waters off the Voldis coast and can only be obtained, rarely, through Wandering Merchants.
There aren't many who are able to clean and gut it, but when properly blanched, it boasts a heavenly texture and taste.
The secret to maintaining a great texture is to pour plenty of over-distilled Voldisian Spirits into the blanching water.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It is a key ingredient for Squid Sausage Platter.</FONT>

922508.name: Low-grade Voldisian Gelatin
922508.desc:
A material process from starch extracted from Voldisian rice and substance extracted from animal skin.
It was originally used for medical purposes, such as quickly healing wounds.
While researching its disinfectant properties, its odorless, tasteless, colorless, and material absorption properties drew attention.
Currently, it is widely used as a basic ingredient in advanced alchemy cooking.

Only the <FONT COLOR='#8DF901'>Low-Grade</FONT> Gelatins were collected.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It is the main ingredient for Jella Caviar.</FONT>

922509.name: High-grade Voldisian Gelatin
922509.desc:
A material process from starch extracted from Voldisian rice and substance extracted from animal skin.
It was originally used for medical purposes, such as quickly healing wounds.
While researching its disinfectant properties, its odorless, tasteless, colorless, and material absorption properties drew attention.
Currently, it is widely used as a basic ingredient in advanced alchemy cooking.

Only the <FONT COLOR='#00B0FA'>High-Grade</FONT> Gelatins were collected.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It is the main ingredient for Jella Caviar.</FONT>

922510.name: Top-grade Voldisian Gelatin
922510.desc:
A material process from starch extracted from Voldisian rice and substance extracted from animal skin.
It was originally used for medical purposes, such as quickly healing wounds.
While researching its disinfectant properties, its odorless, tasteless, colorless, and material absorption properties drew attention.
Currently, it is widely used as a basic ingredient in advanced alchemy cooking.

Only the <FONT COLOR='#BA00F9'>Top-Grade</FONT> Gelatins were collected.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It is the main ingredient for Jella Caviar.</FONT>

922511.name: Aromatic Life Force Fragment
922511.desc:
A fragment of life energy that can be found all across Voldis.
The scattered fragments gives off a faintly aromatic smell.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It is the main ingredient for Voldisian Spirits.</FONT>

922512.name: Fermenting Voldisian Spirits
922512.desc:
Fermenting Voldisian Spirits.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It is the main ingredient for Voldisian Spirits.</FONT>

922513.name: Milky Voldisian Gelatin
922513.desc:
The finest Voldisian Gelatin that has undergone special processing.
It retains its soft texture at room temperature but melts immediately in the mouth.
Chefs who use alchemy in their cooking add various flavors to this gelatin to surprise the taste buds.
The finished dish is valued more when it is closer to being a pure milky white color.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It is the main ingredient for Milky Crystal.</FONT>

922514.name: Empty Voldisian Spirits
922514.desc:
An empty Voldisian Spirit bottle.
Bring it to a cook in Voldis to refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Voldisian Spirit</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Voldisian Spirit.</FONT>
<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Should the bottle be broken due to Butter Fingers, pay a visit to the General Merchant in Kalinar.</FONT>

922515.name: Salted Meat Roll Plate
922515.desc:
A plate of freshly cooked Salted Meat Rolls.
Remove the lid right away!

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's the main ingredient for a Salted Meat Roll Plate.</FONT>

922601.name: Volcanic Ash Mushroom Pickle
922601.desc:
Carefully picked volcanic ash mushrooms marinated with rock salt.
The rock salt and water transform the mushroom into a special cooking ingredient
that no longer disperses and has a crunchy texture.

922602.name: Flameberry
922602.desc:
