The fruit of a small plant that grows in relatively uncontaminated areas.
They're bright red and round, and when chewed, they have a sweet and sour flavor with a hint of spiciness.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Flameberry Slime Pickle.</FONT>

922603.name: Ooze Fluid
922603.desc:
Fluid from the Oozes that live in the damp locations of Kurzan.
It stings to the touch.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Flameberry Slime Pickle.</FONT>

922604.name: Ashwind Herb
922604.desc:
A plant that can sometimes be found in low plains.
Looking withered and dead, its name, Ashwind Herb, comes from the way it looks as its leaves detach from the stem and scatter in the wind when someone blows on it.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Ashwind Herb Tea.</FONT>

922605.name: Sneeze Prevention Medicine
922605.desc:
A medicine that stops you from sneezing even if your nose tickles.
It's shaped into a ball, but its ingredients are a mystery.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Ashwind Herb Tea.</FONT>

922606.name: Clumpy Lump of Meat
922606.desc:
Edible bits of meat cut from
the beasts that inhabit Kurzan.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Assar-style Smoked Jerky.</FONT>

922607.name: Smoking Kit
922607.desc:
A kit used to smoke ingredients like meat.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Assar-style Smoked Jerky.</FONT>

922608.name: Sevek Atun Lava
922608.desc:
A specially designed container that holds the lava that Sevek Atun puked.
It is said to contain something special that makes it different from ordinary lava.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Soul of Magma.</FONT>

922609.name: Suspicious Map
922609.desc:
An unidentified and suspicious map.
The terrain of North Kurzan has been haphazardly drawn.
The map has markings that seem to indicate the location of something.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Flame Pudding.</FONT>

922610.name: Sai Flower
922610.desc:
A plant that is only occasionally found in locations where hot and cold energies coexist.
Its flowers are characterized by a reddish color around the petals, as if living fire had blossomed. It is said you can find them using maps from Wandering Merchants.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Flame Pudding.</FONT>

922611.name: Vaora Grass
922611.desc:
This plant's stem is dried up, but its roots hold a great deal of life. It's not easily recognizable, and little is known of its origins.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Steamed Vaora Root.</FONT>

922612.name: Lava Grape
922612.desc:
A plant that grows in North Kurzan.
The leaves and stems are poisonous, and only the small berries are harvested.
They have a salty, sharp taste.

You can only collect them if you have Lava Energy.
Try to find them using Lava Energy stored in your inventory. 

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Steamed Vaora Root.</FONT>

922613.name: Lava Energy
922613.desc:
Lava energy captured in a special orb.
If processed properly, it can greatly increase cold energy.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Key ingredient of Steamed Vaora Root.</FONT>

922614.name: Empty Soul of Magma
922614.desc:
An empty Soul of Magma bottle.
The chef in South Kurzan Elnead can refill it for a small fee.
<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Soul of Magma</font> can be used to find <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Can be used to craft more Soul of Magma</FONT>.

930101.name: Veda's Prideholme-style Home Food
930101.desc:
A hearty meal that Veda made herself.
Not the best-tasting food in the world, but folks come here more to see the smile on Veda's face.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930102.name: Regria Flower Oil
930102.desc:
Regria Flower Oil has been used for many ages.
Guards of Rethramis would use a drop of this oil as a quick fix for their wounds.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930103.name: Dawntree Sprout Cider
930103.desc:
Cider made from Dawntree Sprouts.
An alcoholic drink strong enough to knock down most drinkers with a single shot.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930104.name: Regria Wheat Bread
930104.desc:
Wheat bread made in Regria Monastery.
Baked with no artificial ingredients, it is famous for its flavor and texture.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930105.name: Protein-Packed White Bird Stew
930105.desc:
A high-protein stew made with white bird meal.
Rumor has it that what's inside the stew is not the white bird meat but what the birds spit up.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930106.name: 499-Year-Old Mera Wine
930106.desc:
A bottle of Mera Snake wine aged for 499 years.
It's seconds away from being a 500-year-old Mera Snake Wine. 

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Be patient and wait for a little while.</FONT>

930107.name: 500-Year-Old Mera Wine
930107.desc:
A 500-year-old bottle of wine made with a Mera Snake.
It's good for... umm... men.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>This item must be used while its effect lasts.</FONT>

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930108.name: Special Potato
930108.desc:
A potato exuding holy energy. Take a bite before anyone comes.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>This item will become an Adventurer's Tome Specialty when used.</FONT>

930109.name: Holy Potato with Teeth Marks
930109.desc:
A potato that became famous for resembling the face of Regulus.
Some crazy narcissist took a bite of it, however, leaving big, ugly teeth marks on it.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930201.name: Pow Pow Honey Health Tonic
930201.desc:
A drink made with Hybee Honey sold in Mokoko Village.
It's a mood booster that restores lost vitality.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930202.name: Plenty Plenty Mokoko Gift Package
930202.desc:
A pack of gifts that Mokokos would present to their friends.
Various fruits that Mokokos love are packed inside the box.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930203.name: Cashew Cashew Smoothie
930203.desc:
A smoothie made by grinding Cashew Fruit with ice.
It's quite intoxicating to non-Mokokos, so one must drink with caution.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930204.name: Eggy Eggy Soft-Boiled Egg
930204.desc:
A soft-boiled egg commonly found in Mokoko Village.
Mokokos love soil-boiled eggs, and to them, eggs lose meaning when they are hard-boiled.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Warning! This item will turn into a hard-boiled egg when the duration ends.</FONT>

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930205.name: Yucky Yucky Hard-Boiled Egg
930205.desc:
A hard-boiled egg almost never found in Mokoko Village.
For Mokokos, these things are not in the same league as soft boiled ones.

930206.name: Sweet Sweet Royal Jelly
930206.desc:
Royal jelly taken from the hive of Hybees.
As Hybees are extremely protective of this nutrition-packed substance, only a handful of people get to taste it.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930207.name: Crunch Crunch Fried Shell
930207.desc:
A fried dish made with Eggs of Creation after they are hatched.
It's crispy and crumbly like snacks.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930211.name: Half and Half, Dip and Pour
930211.desc:
Dip the food in the sauce? Pour the sauce onto the food?
This ultimate dish is the answer to the perennial question,
a perfect resolution to the long-standing feud.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930301.name: Fortune Cookie Chest
930301.desc:
A chest containing a fortune cookie.
If you're unlucky, there could be a message inside the cookie that promises misfortunes.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Use it to obtain a Fortune Cookie.</FONT>

930302.name: Lucky Fortune Cookie
930302.desc:
Your luck will affect the people around you, and they will follow you for it. Use the opportunity to expand social networks and befriend everyone in sight, because connection equals power in today's society.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930303.name: Unlucky Fortune Cookie
930303.desc: A cookie that has a worthless message inside it. It might as well just be thrown away.

930304.name: Jeok Clan Miracle Drug
930304.desc:
Special medicine only for the heir of Jeok Family.
Its recipe is kept a complete secret, and there are few people even inside the family who know how it's made.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930305.name: Secret Yeon-Style Marinated Special
930305.desc:
A dish made with a special marinade that has been passed down within the Yeon family in secret.
It contains several different spicy sauces that Pahan likes.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930306.name: Manpo's Mystery Meat Dumpling
930306.desc:
A horrible by-product of Manpo's experiments on his new menus.
Manpo claims that it's packed with nutrition, cooked with the essence of centipedes and other bugs...
but not one person dared to go for the second bite.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930307.name: Deer Hoof Stew
930307.desc:
A stew made with the hooves of deer.
Where they get the hooves is unknown,
but people sometimes find wolf hair in the stew.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930308.name: Sugar Lump
930308.desc:
A lump of high-quality sugar used for sugar craft.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>There is an incredibly small chance that it will turn into a Perfect Sugar Sculpture.</FONT>

930309.name: Questionable Sugar Sculpture
930309.desc:
A sugar sculpture that does not look so artistic.
It's the result of many failed attempts to make the perfect sugar sculpture.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>This is a failure.</FONT>

930310.name: Broken Sugar Sculpture
930310.desc:
A half-broken sugar sculpture.
It's the result of many failed attempts to make the perfect sugar sculpture.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>This is a failure.</FONT>

930311.name: Perfect Sugar Sculpture
930311.desc:
A sugar sculpture crafted with amazing skill.
Only a master craftsman could bring something like this into the world after much trial and error.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930312.name: Soup of Transcendence
930312.desc:
Soup at its best, although the ingredients are indistinguishable as they are all mushy and pulpy.
Boiled for tens of hours, the rich flavors of several hundred ingredients are completely absorbed in the soup. A spoonful of it is said to bring one beyond the boundary of the realm of the living.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930401.name: X-090892
930401.desc:
A popular energy drink of Cykins.
Due to its thick, oil-like texture, it is not popular among other races.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930402.name: Cykin Combat Ration Type A
930402.desc:
A precooked ration pack that Cykin soldiers eat out in the field.
It is highly nutritious but is absolutely flavorless, another fine example of Cykin character.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930403.name: Cykin Combat Ration Type C
930403.desc:
A precooked ration pack that Cykin soldiers eat out in the field.
In response to the previous criticism about its flavorless field ration, the authority decided to include vinegar and ketchup in the package. Of course, the criticism continues.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930404.name: Sceptrumpam 3mg
930404.desc:
A revolutionary drink made to free soldiers from mealtime hassles.
A single sip of this can provide enough energy for soldiers to last a full day without getting hungry.
However, people claim that its terrible taste, not the pharmaceutical ingredients, is what takes the appetite from soldiers.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930405.name: Boosting Fluid Soup
930405.desc:
A soup made of nutritious fluid that Cykins eat when they need an extra boost.
It has absolutely no flavor, which makes it unpopular among other races.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930406.name: Boiling Liquid
930406.desc:
Culinary fluid invented by a scientist who got fed up with flavorless food of Cykins. It's too hot to be consumed at the moment.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Wait until the duration ends.</FONT>

930407.name: Unknown Liquid XD-6353
930407.desc:
Culinary fluid invented by a scientist who got fed up with flavorless food of Cykins. All the flavors in the world are dissolved in it, but sadly, it's just like people say: Too much is as bad as too little.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930408.name: Bergstrom's Invisibility Potion
930408.desc:
A potion found inside Dr. Bergstrom's Laboratory.
It was supposed to have an awakening effect, but somehow its potency is now gone.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>It's an ingredient for Bergstrom's Miracle.</FONT>

930409.name: Bergstrom's Yellow Potion
930409.desc:
A potion found inside Dr. Bergstrom's Laboratory.
It has an incredibly sour flavor.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>It's an ingredient for Bergstrom's Miracle.</FONT>

930410.name: Bergstrom's Miracle
930410.desc:
A potion created by Dr. Bergstrom.
It was supposed to have an awakening effect, but somehow it became an anesthetic strong enough to put one to sleep for three straight days. They say it tastes so sour that it stops a brain from working.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930601.name: Icewing Larva
930601.desc:
A white larva about the size of an index finger.
This larva spews poison from the tip of its legs to protect itself from predators. There were several reported cases of people going blind from eating this carelessly.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930602.name: Wolf Meat
930602.desc:
A slab of wolf meat with a reddish color.
High in fat, wolf meat is what gets people of Shushire through the severe winter. It's supposed to be eaten raw, so outsiders do not enjoy eating it so much.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930603.name: Old Canned Food
930603.desc:
A food can that contains whale meat.
To store whale meat for a long time, they preserve the meat in Yudian salt and process it into canned food. Well-aged whale meat has a unique vinegary, unpleasant smell.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930604.name: Frost Spider Egg
930604.desc:
An egg of a frost spider that looks like a transparent crystal.
Though it looks pretty, it contains deadly poison.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930605.name: Sapphire Sardine
930605.desc:
The wandering merchant in Shushire sells this item.
Its name comes from the glittering scales.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Grilled Sapphire Sardine.</FONT>

930606.name: Grilled Sapphire Sardine
930606.desc:
A grilled Sapphire Sardine.
Its name comes from the glittering scales. Grilling it with nothing but salt is known to be the best way to cook it.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930607.name: Snowflake Shaved Ice
930607.desc:
An ice-based dessert that looks like a snow mountain with a slightly melting top.
It's too cold at the moment. Wait a little while before consuming it.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It tastes best when the ice slightly melts.</FONT>

930608.name: Shushire Snowflake Shaved Ice
930608.desc:
An ice-based dessert that looks like a snow mountain with a slightly melting top.
It might all melt away if not eaten quickly.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930609.name: Sirius's Tears
930609.desc:
A bottle of Vodka from Shushire.
People of Shushire call this liquor the tears shed by Sirius, the God of Ice. It's very expensive due to its complicated distillation process and the rarity of ingredients.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930701.name: Wonderful Rum
930701.desc:
A bottle of rum made with twenty natural ingredients. Its amazing ability to revive the weakest of hair roots has helped countless Umars find joy in their life again.
"Grow, beard!"

A sip of it may grant the <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>ability</font> to see <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930702.name: Coolkur Beer
930702.desc:
Fresh beer brewed by the master brewer Coolkur himself at Wonderful Brewery.
If you drink the beer out of a sweaty boot, you can't help but shout, "By my Umarian beard!"

A sip of it may grant the <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>ability</font> to see <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930703.name: Mine Car Lunchbox
930703.desc:
A lunch to fill a miner's empty stomach.
It's the symbol of a short, sweet break for those working long hours in the mine. The food inside the box is cooked with all kinds of ingredients that boost strength and vitality.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930704.name: Neria's Cheese Snack
930704.desc:
Cheese matured perfectly inside an old boot.
Its flavor is determined by the condition of the boot it was aged in. It's famous for its unique, pungent smell, which Umars find "savory."

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930705.name: Top-Grade Stir-fried Mushroom
930705.desc:
A stir-fried dish made with various kinds of mushrooms growing in Unfinished Garden.
Cooked quickly in high heat, the mushrooms are tender, but still have a decent texture. Although it smells awful, it's famous for the flavor that deepens with a little addition of liquor.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930706.name: Worm Head Jelly
930706.desc:
The ultimate desert made by Bokar, the legendary cook.
It's made by solidifying the broth of a fresh worm head boiled in a huge furnace for over a week. A rare treat that Umars eat on special days.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930707.name: Great Stew
930707.desc:
A stew that has all the delicate flavors of Arkesia melted in its broth.
It's a food with a long history, made by boiling various rare and precious ingredients brought into Yorn through trading. The hot stone inside it keeps the broth warm until the last mouthful.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930801.name: Starsand Cocktail
930801.desc:
Strong alcohol mixed with ground pineapple and other tropic fruits, then shaken into this cocktail.
If mixed by an experienced bartender, this beverage is a pleasure to view and taste.

Drinking it might put me <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>in the right state of mind</font> allowing me to find a <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden area</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930802.name: Kaloa Boar BBQ
930802.desc:
A hunted boar has been filled with Punika pineapples and spices, wrapped with fresh banana leaves,
and then buried in the ground, on top of pebbles heated by hot charcoals underneath them, and left to be cooked all day.
The boar meat, eaten shredded with a unique Punika spice sprinkled on top,
is tender, juicy, and just drop-dead delicious.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930803.name: Flower Salad
930803.desc:
A salad made with edible flowers growing in Punika.
The people of Punika enjoy this salad before the main course to stimulate their palate with the healthy, sweet-tasting flowers.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930804.name: Meat Bug
930804.desc:
A rich source of protein readily available in the wild that the people of Punika use when they run out of their regular food during hunting.
It's usually eaten raw.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930805.name: Wild Banana Bread
930805.desc:
A rare variety of wild banana that can be used to make bread.
First, peel and bake the bananas. Ground them into fine flour.
Mix the flour with water and let it sit for two days.
Shape the dough and bake it in the oven. Now, enjoy your wild banana bread!

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930806.name: Steamed Papu Crab
930806.desc:
Papu crabs that live hiding in between basalt rocks on the beach are smarter than you think, and therefore more difficult to catch.
If you can catch them, then you can simply steam them to enjoy their delectable meat.
Because papu crabs feed on tropical fruits growing in abundance on their island, their flesh smells faintly of the sweet food that they ate.
Their meat has the deliciously chewy texture that's unique to crustaceans, and their innards are not only edible but delicious.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930807.name: Punika Festival Dish
930807.desc:
A plate full of food that the residents of Punika have prepared for their festival.
It's laden with roughly roasted meat that they hunted, tropical fruits that can be found everywhere on their island,
a little bit of vegetables, and strong spices, and served with an alcoholic drink.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930901.name: Ether Essence
930901.desc:
A bottle of liquid created from the fermentation of blue essences found all over Rohendel. The faint sweet smell tickles your nose.
A sip of it may grant the <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>ability</font> to see <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930902.name: Pit-A-Pat Macaron
930902.desc:
A limited-edition macaron of Rothun known to be made with a drop of love potion.
Once you start munching on it, everyone around you starts looking charming and lovable, even the most hideous of monsters.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930903.name: Jelly Chew
930903.desc:
Jellies made with Moldy-mold Spores occasionally found in Rohendel. A bite of it will make your hair stand up and your head dizzy.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930904.name: Sweet Honey Butter Beer
930904.desc:
A stein of beer made by boiling butter and honey with magick for a long time. The sweet flavor that kicks in after the fizziness fades away makes it taste like heaven.
A sip of it may grant the <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>ability</font> to see <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930905.name: Tooki Tooki Soup
930905.desc:
Long ago, a Sylvain mage who was studying the secret of immortality discovered that it was the tears of Tookies that kept death away and made soup out of them. The soup, unfortunately, didn't solve the mystery of immortality, but lived on to this day for its special effect that makes the eater feel very Tooki Tooki.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930906.name: Zechbas
930906.desc:
A magical snack that Sylvains made for Elementals. Enjoying meals was never a thing for elementals, but this snack made them find joy in eating. It's a snack that made all the Elementals grow friendly towards the Sylvains, but making it is extremely difficult due to the rarity of ingredients and complicated cooking process.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930907.name: Snail Roll Cake
930907.desc:
A roll cake that looks exactly like a snail with horns. It's famous for its sweet, refreshing taste. Rumor has it that they make it with the mucus of snails found in Elzowin's Shade, but no one knows for sure how it's made. 

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

930999.name: Snail Transformation Potion
930999.desc:
A transformation potion that people make when they are too bored, or when there are too many snails to play with.
Use to transform into a magical snail that inhabits Rohendel.

931001.name: Avesta's Smoked Beef Jerky
931001.desc:
A beef jerky that is truly the symbol of Feiton's food culture.
The fat and meat from various beasts are ground up and mixed with salt, then spread thinly and smoked until it is fully dry.
Due to the focus being on functionality, there was no consideration for taste or appearance.
Because of this, the beef jerky is exceptionally high in calories while being lightweight due to its small size. It can also be kept for years and not spoil.
Additionally, it is highly effective and can be digested quickly because the ingredients are pulverized during production.
Though it was created as food rations for the Avestas to use it during combat, it soon found favor with civilians.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931002.name: Feiton Blood Sausage
931002.desc:
Animal intestines that have been stuffed with a mixture of congealed animal blood, animal fat, and dried herb powder, and then smoked until dried.
These sausages are known for their exceptionally high animal blood content and unique herb smell.
In Feiton, any available meat is eaten as grilled skewers or Avesta's Smoked Beef Jerky, and not much is left for making sausages.
Their strong coppery flavor and herb smell make them an acquired taste to people from outside Feiton.
They're, however, almost addictive once you get used to their taste.
These sausages are especially popular as a drinking snack. They're also one of the few things that are readily available for the Delains to enjoy.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931003.name: Eel Herb Kholodets
931003.desc:
Flesh of eels, after their roe is removed to make caviar, is mixed with gelatin from ground animal carcasses, boiled in eel and ground animal bone broth, and then left to cool and harden.
Herb powder can be added to mask odor, and the types of herbs used and their mixing ratio vary, depending on the cook.
This food heavily relies on the cook's skills, as it can easily become a sloshing mass of pudding that reeks of eel and ground animal, or firm, chewy jelly with a pleasantly bitter herb taste.
The traditional recipes usually don't include herb powder because it doesn't really extend the shelf life of this food.
Conservative Delains even consider using it a crime against their sanctified food.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931004.name: Ryucrokota Salo
931004.desc:
Ryucrokota's fatty tissue that's been aged whole.
Fatty parts with almost zero meat have been sliced, covered with salt and herbs, and then smoked for a long time.
It combines the savory flavor of fat with the chewy texture of skin that's left intact.
Improperly stored and spoiled salo can be used as a leather waterproofing agent instead.
Salo is a great match for Feiton's specialty spirit, Bloody Fist.
Its fat content minimizes alcohol absorption and its delicious aroma masks the strong alcohol odor.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931005.name: Krakan Chitlins Cream Soup
931005.desc:
Cream made with Krakan offal and Ryucrokota Salo is boiled together with Krakan shell broth until it thickens into soup.
Well-cooked Krakan offal cream soup doesn't have the usual offal odor.
Krakan offal and Ryucrokota Salo are blended and ground into creamy paste first, to prevent congealing while boiling.
Krakan meat is parboiled and added to the soup before it's served, to prevent the meat from becoming tough.
This soup requires more cooking techniques than most food eaten in Feiton.
People either love it or hate it because of its distinctive aroma.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931006.name: Bloody Fist
931006.desc:
A distilled spirit-based cocktail that's balm to the souls of Feiton's Delains.
Its base is a very strong distilled spirit called Wood Blood that's made from fermented tree fruits.
The name, Wood Blood, was coined from its vivid red color derived from the tree barks and herbs added to the filtration device during its distillation process.

Wood Blood in itself is good alcohol, save the pungent herb smell that can be repulsive to some people.
Sweet sap and citrus juice are added to the alcohol to create this Bloody Fist that's loved by everyone on the continent.
Usually poured into a small shot glass and drunken at once, the cocktail was named Bloody Fist because of the strong sensation that it causes that resembles a punch to the solar plexus.
This cocktail is as strong as its name suggests, but Feiton's Delains rarely get drunk
because the fat in salo, the food that they always eat with Bloody Fist, minimizes alcohol absorption.

The cocktail was originally created by a couple of friends who loved Wood Blood.

A sip of it may grant the <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>ability</font> to see <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden places</FONT>.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</font>

931007.name: Eel Caviar Salad
931007.desc:
The most extravagant dish available in Feiton.
Roe from mature eels has been salted and aged into this soft-textured paste with a heavenly aroma.
The eel caviar, even though it's extremely rare and difficult to preserve, is highly praised for its exceptional taste.
Feiton's Delains only eat it on special occasions and sell most of it to the Holy Sacrian Empire,
in which it's sold to the highest bidder.
It's not widespread in Arkesia because its supply can barely meet demand in Sacria, let alone everywhere else.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931101.name: Balankar Ranger's Salad
931101.desc:
A bowl of salad made by mixing fresh-picked vegetables and steamed potatoes from Prideholme.
It's packed with vitamins and carbohydrates; nutrients that are essential, but are often overlooked.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931102.name: Proxima Salad
931102.desc:
A salad dish made with Proxima.
It's a main ingredient used in a course meal, so don't eat it!

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Proxima Course Meal.</FONT>

931103.name: Proxima Root Nugget
931103.desc:
A meatball dish made with Proxima's roots.
It's a main ingredient used in a course meal, so don't eat it!

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Proxima Course Meal. </FONT>

931104.name: Proxima Course Meal
931104.desc:
A course meal cooked with different parts of Proxima.
Proxima's stems lose all of their toxin when they are put in water for a day. This course meal is made by mixing detoxified Proxima's stems with various vegetables.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931105.name: Fresh Cocktail
931105.desc:
Some believe a true cocktail is shaken, not stirred.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>When used, it transforms into one of the many cocktails available.</FONT>

931106.name: Questionable Cocktail
931106.desc:
A cocktail made by Joo Hye in Vern Castle.
It's not mixed well yet.
Collect several of these to make another cocktail.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Harmony Cocktail.</FONT>

931107.name: Pungent Cocktail
931107.desc:
A cocktail made by Joo Hye in Vern Castle.
It tastes rather pungent.
Collect several of these to make another cocktail.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Harmony Cocktail.</FONT>

931108.name: Palatable Cocktail
931108.desc:
A cocktail made by Joo Hye in Vern Castle.
It's an ordinary cocktail
that can be used to make other cocktails.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in the Harmony Cocktail.</FONT>

931109.name: Harmony Cocktail
931109.desc:
A bottle of liquor that represents the peaceful balance between races and nations in Arkesia.
It has a well-balanced flavor that suits all kinds of occasions.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931110.name: Unknown Soup
931110.desc:
Soup found inside Goblin Village in Parna Forest. There are bits of mysterious ingredients floating on it.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Goblin Fish Soup.</FONT>

931111.name: Goblins' Fish
931111.desc:
A slab of meat that Goblins love, found in the Goblin Village in Parna Forest.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's a key ingredient in Goblin Fish Soup.</FONT>

931112.name: Goblin Fish Soup
931112.desc:
A bowl of thick, greenish fish soup.
Goblins eat it on birthdays, coming-of-age ceremonies, and other special occasions, wishing for good health and well-being.

931113.name: Fesnar Poison Mushroom Stew
931113.desc:
A stew made with a detoxified poisonous mushroom.
The main ingredient is the poisonous mushroom that only grows in Fesnar area, which is often found under rotten wood in dark, damp places. The mushroom's essence melted into the vegetable stock has a deep, clean flavor.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931114.name: Long Live the Queen!
931114.desc:
A feasting food cooked by the head chef of Vern Castle.
It contains various crops planted and harvested in Vernese lands.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931115.name: Vern Anniversary Spirit
931115.desc:
A bottle of liquor made in celebration of Vern's foundation.
Distilled to be clear and transparent to the eye, it's commonly found in all over Vern due to its reasonable price.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931201.name: Bowl of Sky Beans
931201.desc:
A bean dish that was made by combining Sky Beans commonly found in Elgacia with alcohol and cooking it over the brazier. It's usually made as a quick meal rather than a dish that's meant to be enjoyed at leisure.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931202.name: Vino Malbec
931202.desc: A premium wine that was thoughtfully made using high-quality fruit from Elgacia. It has a deep purple hue and hints of rich berries, chocolate, and spices with a warm vanilla finish. It pairs well with fresh vegetables. It's often given as a gift for friends in Elgacia. Even though you may argue and part ways, may the love in your heart never change. "It's a great blessing to have somewhere to return to!" Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.

931203.name: Sunset Cloud Cotton Candy
931203.desc:
Cotton candy that looks like the clouds scattered across the sky during sunset. This cotton candy doesn't leave a sticky residue on your hands, and it melts instantly in your mouth.

Many parents bundle up clouds to make cotton candy for their children in the spring.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931204.name: Elavas
931204.desc:
Bread that can only be baked by chosen bakers in Elgacia with a secret recipe that's passed down through generations. It's baked as a quick meal and is compressed and flattened.

One bite and you'll be overcome by the soft texture, sweet grains, and rich butter.

The mysterious ingredients in the leaves that wrap the bread help maintain freshness for long periods of time.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931205.name: Beriberi Salad
931205.desc:
A simple fruit salad made by tossing various berries and herbs. It's one of the most common dishes on the dining table for Lazeniths.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931206.name: Golden Apple Pie
931206.desc:
A pie that was baked by slicing apples and simmering them in cinnamon, then putting the mixture in a pie crust to bake.

The tangy apple flavor and nutty undertones can be enjoyed by everyone.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931207.name: Orpenectar
931207.desc:
An aperitif that is frequently enjoyed by Lazeniths. It has a rich color with the sweet fragrance and taste of peaches, and it goes down like juice instead of alcohol.

Rumor has it that drinking a glass of Orepenectar a day will help you live a long, healthy life.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931301.name: Wishful Cookie
931301.desc: These cookies are a blend of Kurzan rock salt and starch extracted from tree roots. Encapsulate the Delains' desire to survive by eating them when there's nothing else available. They're so dry that just seeing them can make one's throat feel parched, yet the Assars can reportedly eat them without needing water. "Remember, anyone who seeks water while eating these cookies is a spy." Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.

931302.name: Sacrian Stone Bread
931302.desc:
Bread distributed by Sacria to the priests dispatched to Kurzan. It was over-baked to ensure ease of distribution, leading to the priests being unable to consume it and throwing it away, after which it was collected and used as food by the Delains.

When soaked in water for a long time, it becomes just soft enough to chew.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931303.name: Grilled Hanging Piranha
931303.desc:
A preserved food made by salting contaminated piranhas with rock salt and weaving them with twine. Its consumption is rather unconventional, as it involves not actually eating it.

The majority of piranhas caught near Kurzan are contaminated and inedible. However, they emit a delicious aroma when cooked.

The Delains residing in Kurzan tend to quench their hunger by roasting these salted piranhas and savoring the smell.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931304.name: Withered Stem
931304.desc:
Stems of plants native to Kurzan. The stems of these somewhat less contaminated plants are cut and stripped of their bark.

Initially, they are dried in a dark place for a few days to eliminate toxins. Subsequent repeated steaming and drying processes eventually render them suitable for consumption.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931305.name: Millennium Soup
931305.desc: A soup that has been kept boiling continuously without ever putting out the fire. When exactly it was first prepared is unknown. As the contents diminish, whatever ingredients are available are added to keep it boiling. In Kurzan, where food is precious, anything deemed edible is thrown in, and agarwood bark is used to mask the foul odor. The flavor is balanced with rock salt found across the continent. "That pot? Hmm, I can't say for sure how long it's been boiling, but it could well have been for many decades." Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.

931306.name: Mysterious Black Jelly
931306.desc:
A block-shaped jelly used by the Delains of Kurzan as battle rations.

They start with mysterious ingredients, dry them, and grind them into a fine powder. This powder is then suspended in water and compressed to create a soft chunk.

The challenging process of hardening the sediment makes it a food only certain skilled Delains in Kurzan can produce.

While this task is considered honorable in Kurzan, where food is valuable, not many Delains are eager to learn this technique.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931307.name: Glass of Purified Water
931307.desc: A glass of properly purified water. To outsiders visiting Kurzan, it may seem like ordinary water, but for the Delains of Kurzan, who are plagued by polluted water, the significance of purified water is extraordinary. "Remember this thirst. It was our vow." "Remember this hunger. It is our belief." "Remember this death. It shall be our triumph." Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.

931401.name: Boar BBQ
931401.desc:
A BBQ dish made with a boar from Zagoras.
Its texture is what makes it one of the best specialties of West Luterra.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931402.name: Lakebar Freshwater Fish Stew
931402.desc:
A fish stew sold in Lakebar.
It's a popular meal among peddlers passing by Lakebar.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931403.name: Miner's Rum
931403.desc:
Miners working at Grayhammer Mine love to drink this rum on their break.
The liquor is strong enough for the miners to relieve the stress of working in such a suffocating environment.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931404.name: Efferin's Egg Rice
931404.desc:
A special bowl of rice topped with egg. Chief Abbot Efferin of Medrick Monastery came up with the recipe.
This bowl of rice has created countless aspiring monks.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931405.name: Bear Gallbladder Skewer
931405.desc:
A skewer made with the gallbladder of a bear in Bilbrin Forest.
People seeking vengeance would chew on the skewer and rekindle their rage toward their enemies with its bitter taste.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931406.name: Wriggling Tentacle
931406.desc:
A sliced tentacle of Rovlen.
They say it's edible as-is, but it just won't stop wriggling!

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931407.name: Ripening Anti Hair Loss Agent
931407.desc:
An anti-hair-loss agent that still needs some more aging.
Its miraculous effect of reviving dead hair roots has made it the only hope for terminal stage baldies.
"Grow! Grrrooow!"

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>This item has no effect when used before the duration ends.</FONT>

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>This item will become an Adventurer's Tome Specialty when the duration ends.</FONT>

931408.name: Medrick Hair Loss Solution
931408.desc:
An anti-hair-loss agent now ready to be consumed.
Its miraculous effect of reviving dead hair roots has made it the only hope for terminal stage baldies.
"Grow! Grrrooow!"

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>This item must be used before it expires.</FONT>

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931501.name: Dusty Rainbow Candy
931501.desc:
A candy with a rainbow of colors that the wealthy scions of Luterran nobility love.
It's quite expensive, having a wide range of flavors.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931502.name: Foundation Centennial Wine
931502.desc:
A bottle of white wine brewed in Luterra Castle celebrating the 100th anniversary of the nation's foundation.
It has a flavor as deep and complex as the history of Luterra.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931503.name: Luterran Course Meal
931503.desc:
A course meal enjoyed by Luterran nobles.
As one must observe strict table manners to appreciate the quintessence of Luterran cuisine, having a full understanding of Luterran Courtesies is recommended.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931504.name: Top-Grade Seafood Stew
931504.desc:
A seafood stew at its finest, cooked with freshest clams and shrimp caught in the sea near East Luterra.
Having a non-fishy flavor with a hint of sweetness, it is a very popular meal all across the continent.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931505.name: Dry-Aged Meat
931505.desc:
A slab of steak meat that wandering merchants secured for Cook Hyde.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>It's an ingredient in Thirain T-bone Steak.</FONT>

931506.name: Thirain T-Bone Steak
931506.desc:
A dish of T-bone steak that won the cooking competition held at Luterra Castle.
Cook Hyde named the food after Thirain in appreciation of the honor.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931507.name: Bread Crumbs
931507.desc:
Quality flour used to bake handmade donuts.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Use it to make a donut.</FONT>

931508.name: Donut Servant
931508.desc:
A donut made by a novice baker.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>There is a chance that this donut will become a better donut when used.</FONT>

931509.name: Donut Butler
931509.desc:
A donut made by an ordinary baker.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>There is a chance that this donut will become the ultimate donut when used.</FONT>

931510.name: Donut Maiden
931510.desc:
The ultimate donut that a master donut baker made with blood and sweat.
Its slim, elegant shape gave it its name, the Donut Maiden.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931511.name: Gelato
931511.desc:
An ordinary dessert made with milk and spices sold at the shop.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Melted Gelato.</FONT>

931512.name: Hot Chocolate Coffee
931512.desc:
A very hot cup of chocolate coffee
that wandering merchants sell.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>A key ingredient in Melted Gelato.</FONT>

931513.name: Melting Gelato
931513.desc:
An incomplete dessert consisting of cold gelato topped with hot coffee.
It will taste heavenly once the coffee melts the gelato, creating a creamy, sweet coffee float.

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>Wait a little longer to enjoy this dessert at its best.</FONT>

931514.name: Melted Gelato
931514.desc:
A scoop of gelato ice cream drowned in hot coffee.
Its deep flavor is well-loved by noblewomen.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931701.name: Salt-Grilled Saltbug
931701.desc:
A dish of salt-grilled saltbug found in Saland Hill.
By its looks, it doesn't seem that it was salted.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931702.name: Natural Mungka Jerky
931702.desc:
Meat of Mungka naturally jerked by the heat of Yudian desert.
The desert sunlight is absorbed well in the meat.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931703.name: Worm-Filtered Coffee
931703.desc:
A drink made with coffee beans collected from desert worm feces.
Its flavor is world-famous, but the process of making it keeps many people from enjoying it.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931704.name: Age-old Encavian Wine
931704.desc:
A bottle of wine that Encavian royalty used to drink.
Having been untouched for ages, its flavor grew deep and rich.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931705.name: Salted Food Box
931705.desc:
An old food chest from the Encavian age filled with salt.
The salt kept the food inside the chest from going bad,
but there's no doubt that it will taste awful.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931706.name: Rainmaking Ritual Food
931706.desc:
A food cooked with various ingredients to be offered in the rainmaking ritual.
Everyone will go nuts if someone eats it before the ritual ends. 
But really, a tiny spoonful won't make too much of a difference, will it?

<FONT COLOR='#FACC2E'>This item becomes an Adventurer's Tome specialty when used.</FONT>

931707.name: Rainmaking Ritual Leftovers
931707.desc:
Yudian nomads have a tradition where they put all the food offered in rainmaking rituals in a pot and boil them to cook up a stew and share with others.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931708.name: Salt Cracker
931708.desc:
A snack made with finest salt crystals in the desert.
A lot of people are avid to buy the crackers for their beautiful appearance.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931901.name: Steamed Oyster with White Wine
931901.desc:
The water resources of South Vern is clean and abound. And the regions near Punika are popular for their premium grapes, as the regions have the perfect climate to grow grapes. Consequently, the wine is popular in Vern.
Interestingly, in South Vern, one of the major sources of wine, have a tendency to treat a glass of wine and a dish as just a dish. It is because wine is so abound in these regions.
One popular example is Steamed Oyster with White Wine. People from these regions think that steamed oyster themselves are not a dish unless they are accompanied by white wine.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931902.name: Candarian Cold Lager
931902.desc:
On Candarian Cold Lager #7
Regardless of the gourmet's poor reception, Candarian Cold Lager has become an icon of the multicultural characteristics of Vern. It's easily the most popular beer in Vern and a staple of any night on the town.

Drinking it might put me <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>in the right state of mind</font> allowing me to find a <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden area</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931903.name: Bellion Wings
931903.desc:
A chicken dish from Anikka. It is a popular dish for its spicy, sour, sweet, and salty taste. Over the years, versions of the disk that added a crispy breading have become the most popular.
Kung Pao Chicken of Anikka, the home of the original chicken dish, uses the breast and leg meat, but in Vern, chicken wings are mainly used. In the early days of Vern, different races used the breast and leg meat of a chicken in many different dishes, so scarcity dictated for chicken wings to be used as its main ingredient.
Today, not using chicken wings in Kung Pao Chicken is considered sloppy because it's easier to crisp wings than other parts of a chicken.
One more characteristics of this dish is that it uses an ample amount of spices due to its Voldis influences. The use of spices also makes the dish less oily.
The people of Anikka and South Vern consider Vern's Bellion Chicken Wings and Anikka's Kung Pao Chicken different dishes.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931904.name: Vernilaya
931904.desc:
A popular dish made of poultry, meat, seafood, and rich spices. Vegetables, meat, and rice are fried with spices, then added to meat stock and boiled. Finally, roasted or steamed seafood is added.
The dish truly creates a harmony between the ingredients. It is an iconic dish of Vern, a land considered to be a melting pot of cultures.
Although this dish doesn't have an official, fixed recipe, it calls Vern to mind no matter the chef or the ingredients.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931905.name: Crayfish with Vegetables
931905.desc:
The streams and rivers of Vern are full of large crayfish. They are frequently used in many dishes, but the most popular one is Crayfish and Vegetables.
The people of South Vern cook the crayfish with strong spices, corn, potatoes, and sausages in a large batch for families. The larger the batch, the better the taste.
Using a generous amount of strong spices is a Voldis tradition. When compared to Vernilaya, Crayfish and Vegetables is a more Voldisian vibe.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931906.name: Vernese Brisket
931906.desc:
A BBQ dish made of the beef from the premium cows raised on the highlands of South Vern. It takes more than 16 hours to finish the dish, roasted in a metal can on gentle fire.
The breast meat, the key ingredient, has not much flavor, but the spices and sauce soaked into the meat in 16 hours give the dish a rich flavor.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

931907.name: Magical Vernese Brandy
931907.desc:
As strange as it sounds, timber from the Vernese Mountains is actually the secret ingredient of quality brandy.
The timber isn't actually used to make the brandy, but rather the casks that it rests in.
To call it Vernese Brandy, it must be aged at least 2 years in the barrel made out of Vernese Timber. Vernese Brandy that is aged at least 25 years is called Magica.
Needless to say, all of this makes Magica incredibly pricey.
It is not readily available outside South Vern, even for those with deep pockets as few batches are made every year...

Drinking it might put me <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>in the right state of mind</font> allowing me to find a <FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>hidden area</font>.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932101.name: Vine Leaf Rice Wrap
932101.desc:
In Rimeria, vine leaf-based dishes have recently become a major trend, with the following two preparation methods being the most popular.

The first method, [Secret Technique: Steamed Vine Leaf Rice Wraps], involves wrapping a variety of vegetables and grains in fresh vine leaves and steaming them as-is. This approach enhances and preserves the natural aroma of the vine leaves.

The second method, [Secret Technique: Versatile Vine Leaf Rice Wraps], involves filling pre-steamed vine leaves with any desired ingredients, wrapping them carefully, and lightly blanching them. This technique allows for a diverse and customizable harmony of flavors.

Using these cooking methods, the Yoz create vine leaf rice wraps tailored to their preferences, plate them artfully, and enjoy them dipped in a specially fermented sauce.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932102.name: Chargrilled Neobianyi
932102.desc:
A dish made by thinly slicing venison from deer native to the Rimeria region, evenly marinating it in a seasoned sauce, and carefully grilling it over charcoal.

Typically, the tender and mild-flavored loin is used, but the hind leg meat is selected for a chewier texture and a bolder, more robust flavor for those with such preferences.

Perfectly grilling this dish requires masterful heat control, a rare skill mastered by only a few.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932103.name: Salt-Grilled Freshwater Fish
932103.desc:
Skewered freshwater fish from Akasha Lake, generously seasoned with coarse salt and grilled over an open flame, delivers a bold, primal flavor.

The key to this dish lies in how well the salt is applied. A strong, swift sprinkle ensures the salt penetrates the crevices of the prepared fish, resulting in a grilled fish with a rich umami flavor.

On the other hand, improper salting can ruin the fish's flesh and deform its shape, making both high freshness and advanced skill essential for success.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932104.name: Candied Fruit Flower
932104.desc:
Thinly sliced fruits, delicately arranged into flower-shaped confections.

The fruit flesh is shaped into petals, candied in honey, and meticulously assembled piece by piece. Edible flower petals are added during the process, and when expertly crafted, the result resembles a vibrant, blooming flower.

Due to the skill, time, and dedication required to prepare candied fruit flowers, it is a rare treat enjoyed only on special occasions.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932105.name: Corn Tea and Toast With Golden Apple Jam
932105.desc:
The rare golden apple, scarcely found on land, was transformed into jam by the Yoz to be shared widely and preserved longer.

Crispy toast spread with golden apple jam is served alongside a fragrant tea brewed from dried corn.

The pairing of jam made from the heavenly golden apple, plain bread, and nutty corn tea is said to be truly exquisite.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932106.name: Smoked Acorn Mushroom Noodles
932106.desc:
There is a special acorn that can only be found in Rimeria. The squirrels living along Yan's Path dig burrows to hide their acorns, and those left underground for a long time in the ideal humidity become this unique variety.

This acorn, infused with the earth's rich energy, can produce incredible umami flavor when cooked properly.

Smoked over oak charcoal, acorns are transformed into noodles and coated with a savory sauce made from aromatic mushrooms. The unique and exquisite flavor is said to be unforgettable after just one taste.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932107.name: Thousand Year Root Liquor
932107.desc:
This herbal liquor is crafted with thousand-year ginseng from sacred mountains, requires a century of aging for the ginseng's essence to fully infuse into the drink.

The fully matured thousand-year root liquor boasts a delightful sweetness at first, a subtle herbal aroma in the middle, and a rich, slightly bitter nuttiness as its final note.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932401.name: Reindeer Stew
932401.desc:
A family meal often enjoyed by Rowen's nomads in winter. It's a hearty meal made out of fresh reindeer meat and various legumes and potatoes harvested from the plains.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932402.name: Schertstenbalt
932402.desc:
A dish made by skinning and gutting a whole boar, then filling it up with various mushrooms and berries from the forest and cooking it slowly with hot stones.
The long cooking time makes the meat tender, and the various local mushrooms and berries further enhance the flavor.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932403.name: Reindeer Cheese Meal
932403.desc:
Cheese and yogurt made from the reindeer of Rowen's vast plains.
The nomads like to eat this with bread made from the wild rye that grows on the plains.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932404.name: Forest Rabbit BBQ
932404.desc:
Forest rabbits that live in Rowen are large and taste clean thanks to their diet in the Deep Forest.
Place a trap in front of the rabbit's burrow and jump near the rabbit to scare it into the trap. You'll have yourself a fresh rabbit in no time.
The tender yet supple meat also boasts little smell, making it a popular local delicacy. One cannot be said to have visited Rowen if they did not try the Forest Rabbit BBQ.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932405.name: Schertbulle Dish
932405.desc:
Meatballs made from a whole roasted reindeer cooked on a stone plate, wild potatoes sauteed in oil, and fresh wild berry jam.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932406.name: Sour Herring Dish
932406.desc:
The nomads preserve herrings when they reach the seaside in order to secure enough food for the winter. Salt is always in short supply, so fermenting the herring in seawater is their best option. As a result, the dish has a repulsive smell.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932407.name: Rowen-style Schnapps
932407.desc:
Grain is rare in Rowen due to the nomadic lifestyle of the locals, making ingredients for brewing a rarity.
Wild berries serve as a perfect replacement.
The schnapps is made by distilling the fermented wild berries. It serves as a reliable companion to the nomads' tough lifestyle.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932501.name: Grilled Seafood Plate
932501.desc:
This Convenient Meal was made possible by the fusion of seafood cuisine of the scholars who roamed the sea with the culinary culture of the Raiyans. The name of the dish changes depending on what's served with white rice.
It is usually served with a thick sauce. The question of whether to pour or dip the sauce has been debatable for a very long time.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932502.name: Raiyan Liqueur
932502.desc: A liquor produced from the fruit of quanda trees ubiquitous in Voldis. The fruit has a distinctive aroma as it ripens and is a favorite of wildlife in the Great Rainforest. The Raiyans have been using them to make liquor. Its low alcohol content, silky texture, and sweetness make the liquor easy to drink, which can cause overdrinking. "Only fools are shackled by sweet words and sweet alcohol." Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.

932503.name: Salted Meat Roll
932503.desc:
It originates from the preserved food the scholars from Sacria made to endure long voyages. As Voldisian food culture developed and gourmet biscuits and salted meats were created, this food also became gourmet.

The Voldisians compensate for the saltiness of the biscuits and salted meats by pairing them with juicy, sugary fruits.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932504.name: Squid Sausage Platter
932504.desc:
A dish made by adding squid stuffed with minced meat and shrimp into a stew with starchy balls.

Squid, which are not readily available in Voldis, and the bouncy texture of the round starch balls make this dish special. The two ingredients make the stew a flavor bomb. People have different opinions over whether the squid or the starch balls are the most important ingredient.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932505.name: Jella Caviar
932505.desc:
A dish that combines cooking with alchemy.

What at first glance appears to be fish eggs is actually sauce that has been wrapped in very thin membranes. The red stuff on the bottom is gelatin made from the extract of salted meat and is soft enough to melt on the tongue.

The fiber and nutrients of vegetables are masterfully made into noodles, making it a culinary masterpiece.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932506.name: Voldisian Spirits
932506.desc:
A strong, spirituous liquor made from sugar cane. The distillation technique originates from Sacria. After repeated filtering and distillation, unwanted flavors are removed and the alcohol content is increased.

The lighter the fragrance, the more premium the product, for interestingly, the better it is made, the fainter it smells.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932507.name: Milky Crystal
932507.desc:
The pinnacle of Voldis-style alchemy cooking.

Though it melts instantly once it enters your mouth, it explodes with flavor and aroma.

Using Raiyan Liqueur as the base, and depending on the ingredients selected by the chef, you'll savor an intense experience wherein some crystals exhibit the rich taste of beef au jus while other crystals offer the type of umami normally found in scallops.

In short, it is an amazing food that uses advanced technology to balance out its numerous flavors.


<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932601.name: Edible Volcanic Ash Mushroom
932601.desc:
A volcanic ash mushroom that grows near the scorching hot Kurzan volcano.

It possesses remarkable vitality despite harsh volcanic conditions where most crops struggle.

By remaining vigilant and focusing all your senses, you may find this hidden, small, and resilient life form.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932602.name: Flameberry Slime Pickle
932602.desc:
A flameberry pickle made by fermenting it.

To neutralize the toxic flameberries, they must be soaked in animal fluids. After being fully submerged and fermented for about three days in a cool environment, they become an edible dish.

The thick juice that combines the sweet and fiery burst of flameberries is a gourmet delight.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932603.name: Ashwind Herb Tea
932603.desc:
Tea made from the Ashwind Herb that grows naturally in Kurzan.

The herb's leaves scatter with the slightest breath, making them very difficult to harvest.

If you manage to gather them, it is recommended that you simply steep them in hot water.

The tea helps soothe the mind and decongests breathing.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932604.name: Assar-Style Smoked Jerky
932604.desc:
Meat made into Assar-style jerky.

Cut the best parts of the beasts that inhabit Kurzan. Spread the pieces of meat and cook slowly with smoke to make a smoky jerky.

This is the battle ration that the Assar eat to satisfy their warriors' hunger when they train.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932605.name: Soul of Magma
932605.desc:
The ultimate hard liquor made from the lava Sevek Atun puked up.

After cooling the lava, special ingredients are added and the lava is aged for a long period of time, and only then can you taste the newly reborn lava liquor.

It is said to be the favorite drink of the alcohol enthusiasts of Kurzan since it delivers an intense burning sensation upon taking a sip.

Just as lava cannot be stopped, the drink is said to satisfy even those who have lost all appetite.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932606.name: Flame Pudding
932606.desc:
Steaming hot flame pudding.

In a remote part of North Kurzan, there is a special place where the energy of hot fire and the coolness of the air coexist.

If the Sai flower from that region is steeped in water at just the right temperature for a long time, it turns into pudding.

The hot and cool energies don't mix, creating a unique flavor along with the smoke.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>

932607.name: Steamed Vaora Root
932607.desc:
After carefully collecting Vaora roots to avoid spoiling them, use the energy of lava to cook the roots until they are soft.

After the roots cool for a while, they suddenly harden. Serve with lava grapes, which have a tangy taste, and you have the ultimate steamed Vaora root dish.

<FONT COLOR='#FE9A2E'>Right-click to add to the Adventurer's Tome.</FONT>
