3110105.name: Armen Card
3110105.desc: A young priest searching for the lost Arks of legend in hopes of saving the mortal world and healing its people.

3110205.name: Thirain Card
3110205.desc: The righteous and incorruptible prince of Luterra.

3110305.name: Demon Beast Commander Valtan Card
3110305.desc: Archdemon Kazeros's lieutenant, who leads the Demon Beast Legion.

3110405.name: King Thirain Card
3110405.desc: The King of Luterra. The epitome of a good leader, he always thinks of his people.

3110505.name: Shandi Card
3110505.desc: One of the Seven Sidereals. This carefree man wanders the world with his student.

3110605.name: Zinnervale Card
3110605.desc: Sidereal Shandi's student. Cheerful and flippant, he travels the continent with his master, hoping to one day learn all he knows.

3110705.name: Delain Armen Card
3110705.desc: Armen has revealed his hidden power as a Delain. He uses his inner demonic power instead of his holy power.

3110805.name: Mayhem Legion Commander Kakul-Saydon Card
3110805.desc: The commander of the Mayhem Legion. Behind his playful clownish facade, he hides an evil, maddening power.

3110905.name: Wei Card
3110905.desc: A fighter who inherited the name of the Sidereal. Having avenged his master, he is now ready to save the world.

3111005.name: Covetous Legion Commander Vykas Card
3111005.desc: The commander of the Covetous Legion. She manipulates others' desires with sweet words. She is looking for a vessel to accept Kazeros.

3111105.name: Akkan Card
3111105.desc: The commander of the Plague Legion who has the ability to control diseases and corruption. He absorbs everything that breathes, craving for a body for himself.

3111205.name: Kharmine Card
3111205.desc: An insidious Demon who operates with ill intent. He has the ability to absorb the powers of other Demons.

3111305.name: Thaemine Card
3111305.desc: The commander of the Darkness Legion. He is the strongest and most mysterious of Kazeros's commanders.

3111405.name: Brelshaza Card
3111405.desc: The commander of the Phantom Legion. Known as the most cunning and ruthless of all legion commanders, she charms her enemies and inflicts awful hallucinations upon them.

3111505.name: Beatrice Card
3111505.desc: A Lazenith who watches over the world from Trixion, a rift in spacetime, under the order of the god Regulus.

3200104.name: Thanatos Card
3200104.desc: A creature conjured with dark magick. It dwells in the body of the ancient king, nestled in the depths of the Morai Ruins.

3201004.name: Banda Card
3201004.desc: A fiend that rules over the Bleak Edge. It took Sidereal Sien and the leaders of both the Yeon and Jeok clans to seal its body.

3201204.name: Sasha Card
3201204.desc: One of the three leaders of the Republic of Arthetine. She manages her nation's finances with an iron fist.

3201504.name: Lord of Evolution Krause Card
3201504.desc: Krause's final evolutionary form, created by the Sun of Creation. It has the shape of a god with mechanical wings. With this power, Krause tried to stop the Demon.

3210104.name: Thanatos Card
3210104.desc: A creature conjured with dark magick. It dwells in the body of the ancient king, nestled in the depths of the Morai Ruins.

3210204.name: Thunderwings Card
3210204.desc: A demonic beast surrounded by lightning. Its deafening roar can be heard for miles.

3210304.name: Scherrit Card
3210304.desc: The regent of Luterra. He poisoned the former king and colluded with Demons to take the crown for himself.

3210404.name: Allegro Card
3210404.desc: A tranquil bard who spends his days recounting stories of his life in song. He gives the impression that he's learned everything that there is to know about the world.

3210504.name: Nahun Card
3210504.desc: A senior court mage of Luterra who constructed King Luterra's tomb and other buildings across the kingdom. His spirit guards the King's Tomb even after death.

3210604.name: Jagan Card
3210604.desc: A Demon that snuck into King Luterra's tomb. It breathes hellfire at anyone foolish enough to seek the King's Ark.

3210704.name: Blackfang Card
3210704.desc: Captain of the Black Fox. Composed and charismatic. Unlike Bloodclaw, the legendary pirate who mysteriously vanished, Blackfang maintains order while on the high seas.

3210804.name: Mokamoka Card
3210804.desc: A curious Mokoko boy. He's embarked on the greatest adventure of his life to find Tortoyk's Heart.

3210904.name: Habeck Card
3210904.desc: The 1st Sword of Changhun, a taoist who learned illusion jutsu. A disciple of the Sidereals who learned from Wei.

3211004.name: Banda Card
3211004.desc: A fiend that rules over the Bleak Edge. It took Sidereal Sien and the leaders of both the Yeon and Jeok clans to seal its body.

3211104.name: Bastian Card
3211104.desc: One of the three leaders of the Republic of Arthetine. His boyish appearance belies his levelheadedness and charisma as a leader of Arthetine.

3211204.name: Sasha Card
3211204.desc: One of the three leaders of the Republic of Arthetine. She manages her nation's finances with an iron fist.

3211304.name: Technologist Krause Card
3211304.desc: One of the three leaders of the Republic of Arthetine. He wants to lead the Cykins to a higher stage of evolution to protect Arkesia against Demons.

3211404.name: Mari Card
3211404.desc: One of Technologist Krause's Personal Guards. She has an amazing talent for building giant mechanical weaponry. She admires Krause and craves his recognition.

3211504.name: Lord of Evolution Krause Card
3211504.desc: Krause's final evolutionary form, created by the Sun of Creation. It has the shape of a god with mechanical wings. With this power, Krause tried to stop the Demon.

3211604.name: Madnick Card
3211604.desc: A warrior who once dominated the Arena. Leader of the Daybreakers, he fights to abolish prison profiteering and bring a new dawn to Shushire.

3211704.name: Thar Card
3211704.desc: Vern's Knight Commander, who once was called the Silver Spear. He died in a battle against a necromancer a hundred years ago, and something recently brought him back to life.

3211804.name: Anabel Card
3211804.desc: A clerk working at the Adventurer's Guild. Her adventurer parents died on a journey when she was young, and Gideon took her under his wing and raised her with help from the rest of the Guild.

3211904.name: Sigmund Card
3211904.desc: A necromancer who tried to dominate Vern a hundred years ago. He was killed during a battle against the knights, but something recently brought him back, and he's determined to destroy Vern.

3212004.name: Nacrasena Card
3212004.desc: With their gigantic body, strong, hard claws and huge thorns, Nacrasena, the Guardian of the desert, overwhelms those who witness their grandeur.

3212104.name: Levanos Card
3212104.desc: This ancient being, Levanos, has all the natural elements at its command.

3212204.name: Vertus Card
3212204.desc: Vertus, a beast known as the Snow Monarch, is surrounded by icy power that instantly freezes anyone who gets too close to it.

3212304.name: Chromanium Card
3212304.desc: Guardian Chromanium, known for their nigh impenetrable carapace, roars as they bombard their enemies with fiery breath and a volley of magick projectiles.

3212404.name: Helgaia Card
3212404.desc: Helgaia is a massive Guardian with blazing feathers, rumored to rise from the ashes over and over again.

3212504.name: Icy Legoros Card
3212504.desc: Icy Legoros generates extreme cold from its hulking body to freeze enemies solid and then shatter them into bloody shards.

3212604.name: Dark Legoros Card
3212604.desc: Dark Legoros expels dark power from its huge body and blinds its enemies to make them easy prey.

3300503.name: Velkan Card
3300503.desc: Velkan is an ancient beast sealed away by the gods for its endless voracity. After its seal broke, Velkan came back to Arkesia.

3300703.name: Harzal Card
3300703.desc: A bionic weapon consisting of different parts from different creatures. Its gigantic body hosts all kinds of terrible contagions.

3301203.name: Rictus Card
3301203.desc: A Demon in the form of an agile, ferocious wolf. He's the right hand of Valtan, the commander of the Demon Beast Legion.

3301303.name: Cassleford Card
3301303.desc: An experienced and stately knight. Thirain's reliable supporter.

3301703.name: Wili-Wili Card
3301703.desc: An innocent pumpkin on Sunbright Hill that has turned into a manifestation of the anger of the murdered dead.

3301803.name: Seria Card
3301803.desc: A kind, goodhearted member of the Sacrian Order. She takes care of those who have been attacked.

3302503.name: Nox Card
3302503.desc: A Redfin Pirate carrying a big cannon on his shoulder. He's guarding their booty from Stormcry Grotto.

3304003.name: Plague Legion Varto Card
3304003.desc: A Demon serving Akkan, the commander of the Plague Legion. He seeks the Ark to make Akkan's body complete again.

3304903.name: Tarsila Card
3304903.desc: The beautiful queen of the Frost Spiders. She's territorial and has a voracious appetite for living prey.

3305603.name: Gorgon Card
3305603.desc: A Demon Beast created through necromantic experiments. It constantly craves lives to feed on.

3305903.name: Tooki King Card
3305903.desc: The King of Tookies. He resides on Tooki Island and spends his time gloating over the treasures that his subjects have brought for him.

3310103.name: Varut Card
3310103.desc: A gentle priest at the Prideholme Cathedral. A member of the Sacrian Order and one of the Dawn Priests who support Archon Gustaven.

3310203.name: Prideholme Neria Card
3310203.desc: A kind, cheerful girl who works at the Prideholme tavern and likes to cook.

3310303.name: Rudric Card
3310303.desc: The priest who turned to heresy and was corrupted by demonic power. Now that he's dead, he hates and attacks everything that lives.

3310403.name: Ugo Card
3310403.desc: The leader of the Toxiclaw Robbers. He can summon rare beasts and is secretly in league with Kharmine.

3310503.name: Velkan Card
3310503.desc: Velkan is an ancient beast sealed away by the gods for its endless voracity. After its seal broke, Velkan came back to Arkesia.

3310603.name: Plaguebringer Card
3310603.desc: A member of the Plague Legion that snuck into Rethramis who is spreading a plague in Aquilok's Head.

3310703.name: Harzal Card
3310703.desc: A bionic weapon consisting of different parts from different creatures. Its gigantic body hosts all kinds of terrible contagions.

3310803.name: Salt Giant Card
3310803.desc: A giant made of salt. It swings its heavy fists at any who oppose it.

3310903.name: Thunder Card
3310903.desc: A nomad priestess who worships the sky. She can perform a ritual to appeal to the sky and make it rain.

3311003.name: Celedan Card
3311003.desc: Kharmine's henchman, who's conducting dangerous research in Sapira Cave.

3311103.name: Meehan Card
3311103.desc: The lord of Mount Zagoras. He's fiercely loyal to Thirain.

3311203.name: Rictus Card
3311203.desc: A Demon in the form of an agile, ferocious wolf. He's the right hand of Valtan, the commander of the Demon Beast Legion.

3311303.name: Cassleford Card
3311303.desc: An experienced and stately knight. Thirain's reliable supporter.

3311403.name: Rovlen Card
3311403.desc: This plant has been mutated by demonic energy. It devours everything around it.

3311503.name: Alifer Card
3311503.desc: The spirit of a knight. Having completely succumbed to demonic energy, it waylays those who approach the Glorious Wall.

3311603.name: Luterra Castle Neria Card
3311603.desc: The cheerful, friendly mistress of the Luterra tavern. She excels at playing musical instruments and always plays joyful tunes for her customers.

3311703.name: Wili-Wili Card
3311703.desc: An innocent pumpkin on Sunbright Hill that has turned into a manifestation of the anger of the murdered dead.

3311803.name: Seria Card
3311803.desc: A kind, goodhearted member of the Sacrian Order. She takes care of those who have been attacked.

3311903.name: Heretic High Priest Card
3311903.desc: The high priest of the cult worshipping the Mayhem Demons that spread throughout the East Luterra. He's trying to summon the commander of the Mayhem Legion.

3312003.name: Jahia Card
3312003.desc: A Water Elemental that protects the Leyar Terrace. Gracious and generous.

3312103.name: Ligheas Card
3312103.desc: A Water Elemental that protects the Leyar Terrace. Firm and stern.

3312203.name: Halrock Card
3312203.desc: The Lord of Borea Fortress, who fights bravely against the Demons.

3312303.name: Cals Card
3312303.desc: The eldest son of the Moronto Family and the lord of Wavestrand Port. Pretentious and arrogant, having been made lord at a young age.

3312403.name: Hiebike Card
3312403.desc: The violent, hot-tempered staff captain of the Redfin Pirates. He wants to kill Blackfang in Luterra Port for the sake of his own glory.

3312503.name: Nox Card
3312503.desc: A Redfin Pirate carrying a big cannon on his shoulder. He's guarding their booty from Stormcry Grotto.

3312603.name: Setino Card
3312603.desc: The sly, cowardly staff captain of the Redfin Pirates. Other pirates call him a coward for his cautious personality.

3312703.name: Totoma Card
3312703.desc: The benevolent chief of the Mokoko Village. He's trying to protect his village against the pirate invasion.

3312803.name: Hybee Executioner Card
3312803.desc: A Hybee executioner that lives in Sweetwater Forest. It mercilessly attacks anyone who invades their nest.

3312903.name: Guardian Eolh Card
3312903.desc: A Guardian of Tortoyk's Heart. They woke from their slumber within the stone to conduct the Guardian's Test.

3313003.name: Ed the Red Card
3313003.desc: The sly, insidious captain of the Redfin Pirates. He wants Tortoyk's Ark to lift the curse that turned him into a Merpirate.

3313103.name: Guardian Tir Card
3313103.desc: A Guardian of Tortoyk's Heart. They appear as a giant rock and crush those who are unworthy.

3313203.name: Caspiel the Giant God Card
3313203.desc: A divine being who has been protecting Tortoyk's forest for a long time. It mercilessly attacks those who dare throw Tortoyk into chaos.

3313303.name: Ark Guardian Occel Card
3313303.desc: The Guardian who protects the Ark that lies asleep inside Tortoyk. They use the power of waves to test adventurers.

3313403.name: Pahan Card
3313403.desc: The leader of the Yeon Clan. He values humanity and justice, and tries his best to protect them at all costs.

3313503.name: Manpo Card
3313503.desc: The 8th Sword of Changhun. Also the owner of a dumpling store. Uses a martial art called Changhun Dumpling Fist.

3313603.name: Miru Card
3313603.desc: The fiend who killed the martial artist appointed as the 7th Sword of Changhun and took the seat. Kills residents and eats their livers to become a Human.

3313703.name: Wonpho Card
3313703.desc: The 4th Sword of Changhun. He belonged to the Yeon Clan, but crossed a line he should not have in order to cure his wife.

3313803.name: Gildal Card
3313803.desc: The 3rd Sword of Changhun and disciple of Sir Druden. Excels at transforming into a monstrous bird, but he departed before he could learn other skills.

3313903.name: Rekiel of Despair Card
3313903.desc: An underling of Vykas who attacks like she is dancing. She truly believes in her own beauty and is full of confidence.

3314003.name: Plague Legion Varto Card
3314003.desc: A Demon serving Akkan, the commander of the Plague Legion. He seeks the Ark to make Akkan's body complete again.

3314103.name: Dochul Card
3314103.desc: The immortal fiend that once threw Anikka into chaos. Early on, Sidereal Sien sealed the immortal Dochul within his own left arm and used its powers to protect the world.

3314203.name: Chaotic Chuo Card
3314203.desc: The sacred creature that has protected the peace of Anikka and prevented disasters since ancient times. It was devoured by the evil energy that it tried to fight off.

3314303.name: Arthetine Neria Card
3314303.desc: She's called Stern's prima donna. Many people come to Stern just to listen to Neria sing.

3314403.name: Signatus Card
3314403.desc: A massive mechanical weapon created by Arthetine's most cutting-edge technology. It uses its AI to locate enemies and attacks them with absolute ruthlessness.

3314503.name: Scientist S Card
3314503.desc: One of Technologist Krause's Personal Guards. He experimented on himself to study physical augmentation. Most of his body parts have been replaced with mechanical components. He cares about his twin brother, J, more than anything in the world.

3314603.name: Scientist J Card
3314603.desc: One of Technologist Krause's Personal Guards. A colleague of Dr. Bergstrom. Most of his body parts have been replaced with mechanical components. He cares about his twin brother, S, more than anything in the world.

3314703.name: Anton Card
3314703.desc: One of Technologist Krause's Personal Guards. A stubborn, conservative Cykin who became deeply influenced by Krause's plan to activate the Verdantier.

3314803.name: Vrad Card
3314803.desc: A prisoner broker of Shushire. He's amassed an enormous fortune, owns the Red Curtain Arena, and is now colluding with Demons.

3314903.name: Tarsila Card
3314903.desc: The beautiful queen of the Frost Spiders. She's territorial and has a voracious appetite for living prey.

3315003.name: Ruave Card
3315003.desc: A member of the Plague Legion charged with delivering Shushire prisoners to Akkan.

3315103.name: Sian Card
3315103.desc: A servant of Sirius. After receiving an edict from his god, he headed out to the Red Curtain Arena to defend Shushire against Demons.

3315203.name: Maneth Card
3315203.desc: A warrior who fought Demons during the Chain War. In the end, their evil energy encroached upon his spirit and turned him into a mindless specter.

3315303.name: Gideon Card
3315303.desc: The master of the Adventurer's Guild. He was appointed the Guildmaster after solving various quests in North Vern in his younger days. He has a reputation for loyalty and magnanimity among the people of the north.

3315403.name: Garum Card
3315403.desc: A creation of Necromancer Sigmund who destroyed the Knights of Vern a hundred years ago. It woke up from a long slumber alongside its master.

3315503.name: Payla Card
3315503.desc: A member of the Balankar Rangers that protect North Vern. He's after the Demon Beast Gorgon to avenge his fellow rangers.

3315603.name: Gorgon Card
3315603.desc: A Demon Beast created through necromantic experiments. It constantly craves lives to feed on.

3315703.name: Proxima Card
3315703.desc: A plant that fed on dark energy. It developed a taste for Human flesh as it grew big.

3315803.name: Erasmo Card
3315803.desc: A mysterious creature living in the depths of the ocean. Rumor has it that it only reveals itself when certain conditions are met.

3315903.name: Tooki King Card
3315903.desc: The King of Tookies. He resides on Tooki Island and spends his time gloating over the treasures that his subjects have brought for him.

3316003.name: Brealeos Card
3316003.desc: The residue of the powers that clashed between Sirius, the God of Frost, and the Flame Legion thousands of years ago has been given life and form.

3316103.name: Kagros Card
3316103.desc: A beast that broke out of a giant egg. It attacks enemies with hundreds of worms that it grows on its body.

3316203.name: Sea God Aporas Card
3316203.desc: A mysterious creature that guards Oblivion Isle. It uses deep-sea water to attack enemies.

3316303.name: Tarmakum Card
3316303.desc: Dr. Bergstrom tried to secretly create this test subject with the Remnants of Power. Ferocious and aggressive.

3316403.name: Sol Grande Card
3316403.desc: A massive mechanical weapon that can be found in Alteisen. It ruthlessly attacks enemies.

3400102.name: Vengeful Spirit Card
3400102.desc: The angry spirit of a woman. She roams Rethramis, seeking revenge.

3400302.name: Giant Worm Card
3400302.desc: An ancient creature living in a barren land. It absorbs nutrients while wandering through the ground, digging tunnels.

3400402.name: Urr Card
3400402.desc: An Umar blacksmith in Lakebar. Just a touch of his hammer can turn an ordinary weapon into a masterpiece.

3400602.name: Cadogan Card
3400602.desc: The captain of Scherrit's army, a knight who will do anything he is ordered to do.

3400802.name: Bishu Card
3400802.desc: A careful and quiet nobleman. As a descendant of the mage Nahun, he governs the Dyorika Plain.

3400902.name: Berhart Card
3400902.desc: Regent Scherrit's son. He's waiting for a chance to get back at Thirain, who ascended to the throne.

3401002.name: Puruu Warrior Brinewt Card
3401002.desc: A Puruu who has succumbed to the Power of Mayhem. He once was known as the best of all Puruu warriors.

3401102.name: Azaran Card
3401102.desc: The Borea Fortress's archer captain who never misses her target.

3401202.name: Gabrian Card
3401202.desc: The Borea Fortress's charger captain who's magnanimous and easy-going.

3401302.name: Executor Solas Card
3401302.desc: A coldhearted executor of the Sacrian Order. He makes an irreversible mistake, punishing the wrong people for heresy.

3401402.name: Totoiki Card
3401402.desc: A being that raises the Eggs of Creation formed within Tortoyk's body. It runs around constantly, trying to catch the unruly eggs.

3401502.name: Egg of Creation Card
3401502.desc: A mysterious egg created inside Tortoyk's body. All kinds of lives are hatched from them.

3401602.name: Guardian Peroth Card
3401602.desc: A Guardian who protects the inside of Tortoyk. They use their blazing sword to test those who challenge them.

3401702.name: Yuul Card
3401702.desc: A member of the staff in charge of the Changhun Tournament. Because of her interest in martial arts, she's extremely invested in the tournament.

3401802.name: Hari Card
3401802.desc: The 9th Sword of Changhun. She's a skilled fighter who studied under Yahara.

3401902.name: Onehand Card
3401902.desc: The 6th Sword of Changhun. Uses an Arthetine-made mechanical arm to perform destructive attacks.

3402002.name: Hodon Card
3402002.desc: A second son of the Jeok Clan and the 5th Sword of Changhun. He took on the Grand Master's Trial and colluded with Demons to win the title of Grand Master.

3402102.name: Gumga Card
3402102.desc: The 2nd Sword of Changhun. The legendary martial artist once dominated Anikka like he now dominates the martial arts tournament.

3402202.name: Sakkul Card
3402202.desc: An underling of the nine-tailed fox, Miru, and a fiend that's collecting souls to create soul orbs. She commands two snakes.

3402302.name: Sir Druden Card
3402302.desc: A master of Anikka who loves alcohol. Adept at various schools of magick, he's abandoned his body and possessed a painting to fight fiends.

3402402.name: Sir Valleylead Card
3402402.desc: A taciturn Master of Anikka. Skilled with the power of wind, he was the first one in Anikka to notice the energy of the Demons invading the continent.

3402502.name: Seville Card
3402502.desc: One of Technologist Krause's Personal Guards. An extremist who has complete faith in Krause. Knowledgeable in chemistry and good with firearms.

3402602.name: Commander Sol Card
3402602.desc: A giant machine that commands the Machine Legion on Krause's behalf. It tried to stop the Regulators from interfering with the activation of the Verdantier.

3402702.name: Javern Card
3402702.desc: The vice-captain of the prisoner liberation group, the Daybreakers. A coolheaded and meticulous leader.

3402802.name: Ramis Card
3402802.desc: A small, optimistic boy in Shushire. He lost his father to the prison fights early on, and is living only with his mother.

3403002.name: Poppy Card
3403002.desc: A gray wolf from Shushire. He joined Graymoon with his friend, Dietrich, to fight against the Demons.

3403102.name: Butcher Arre Card
3403102.desc: A member of the Plague Legion. His stammering belies his predilection for carnage and Human flesh.

3403302.name: Lena Card
3403302.desc: A lively girl who lives on Starlight Isle. She wants to find her mother's memories for her father, Favreau.

3403402.name: Favreau Card
3403402.desc: The starkeeper on Starlight Isle. He plays the piano to help lost souls find their way to the afterlife.

3403502.name: Zenri Card
3403502.desc: A man desperate to start a nightclub. His odd habits sometimes perplex people.

3410102.name: Vengeful Spirit Card
3410102.desc: The angry spirit of a woman. She roams Rethramis, seeking revenge.

3410202.name: Dadan Card
3410202.desc: The leader of a bandit group. He's taken over the saltern to support his crew by selling salt. He punishes any who oppose him.

3410302.name: Giant Worm Card

3410602.desc: The captain of Scherrit's army, a knight who will do anything he is ordered to do.

3410702.desc: An incorruptible and aggressive nobleman who governs the Dyorika Plain. He's a descendant of mage Nahun.

3412902.desc: A priest that has joined the ranks of the Demons in the Plague Legion. Once a servant of Sirius, he developed resentment toward his god and turned to the Demons.

3413002.desc: A gray wolf from Shushire. He joined Graymoon with his friend, Dietrich, to fight against the Demons.

3413102.desc: A member of the Plague Legion. His stammering belies his predilection for carnage and Human flesh.

3413202.name: Navegal Card
3413202.desc: A knight who died during a battle with Sigmund a hundred years ago. The enemy's necromancy has brought him back to life to wreak havoc on the Fesnar Highland.

3413302.name: Lena Card
3413302.desc: A lively girl who lives on Starlight Isle. She wants to find her mother's memories for her father, Favreau.

3413402.name: Favreau Card
3413402.desc: The starkeeper on Starlight Isle. He plays the piano to help lost souls find their way to the afterlife.

3413502.name: Zenri Card
3413502.desc: A man desperate to start a nightclub. His odd habits sometimes perplex people.

3413602.name: Mikeel and Nomed Card
3413602.desc: Father Mikeel met Nomed when he was young, and they quickly became inseparable.

3500101.name: Riwella Card
3500101.desc: A knight who hails from Freyad Village. Terse but kindhearted, she fights alongside Thirain for Luterra.

3500201.name: Vivian Card
3500201.desc: An employee at Neria's Tavern in Luterra Castle. She wants to be as successful as Neria, someday.

3500301.name: Kranterus Card
3500301.desc: A hulking Demon in the Mayhem Legion. Its body is covered with the scars of mind-wiping experiments and torture inflected on it by the Mayhem Legion.

3500401.name: Mephitious Card
3500401.desc: A mid-level Demon summoned by the Mayhem Legion. The Legion used Mephitious to gain air supremacy during its invasion of Borea's Domain.

3500501.name: Naruni Card
3500501.desc: A cute pet of the Mokokos in Tortoyk. Its name, Naruni, is coined from its mewling sound.

3500601.name: Lion Mask Card
3500601.desc: The Lion Mask used in the Battle of the Lions in Changhun. It represents an animal that defeated disaster long ago.

3500701.name: Goblin Elder Balu Card
3500701.desc: An elder who leads the Goblins in Parna Forest. He lives in a Goblin village while guarding Parna, the holy tree.

3500801.name: Ternark Card
3500801.desc: A knight who died during a battle with Sigmund a hundred years ago. The enemy's necromancy brought him back as a mindless ghost, but he regained his sanity through sheer willpower.

3500901.name: Cadri Card
3500901.desc: A traveler that wants to take photos of every wonderful place he visits.

3510401.desc: A mid-level Demon summoned by the Mayhem Legion. The Legion used Mephitious to gain air supremacy during its invasion of Borea's Domain.

3510501.name: Naruni Card
3510501.desc: A cute pet of the Mokokos in Tortoyk. Its name, Naruni, is coined from its mewling sound.

3510601.name: Lion Mask Card
3510601.desc: The Lion Mask used in the Battle of the Lions in Changhun. It represents an animal that defeated disaster long ago.

3510701.name: Goblin Elder Balu Card
3510701.desc: An elder who leads the Goblins in Parna Forest. He lives in a Goblin village while guarding Parna, the holy tree.

3510801.name: Ternark Card
3510801.desc: A knight who died during a battle with Sigmund a hundred years ago. The enemy's necromancy brought him back as a mindless ghost, but he regained his sanity through sheer willpower.

3510901.name: Cadri Card
3510901.desc: A traveler that wants to take photos of every wonderful place he visits.

3990001.name: Smiling Mari Card
3990001.desc: A genius scientist from Arthetine. In celebration of the grand opening, she has a bright smile, which is a very rare thing to see.

3990002.name: Posh Sasha Card
3990002.desc: The treasurer of Arthetine. She's dressed up for the opening event.

3990003.name: Literary Girl Anabel Card
3990003.desc: A clerk working at the Adventurer's Guild. She greets new adventurers with a welcoming smile on her face.

3990004.name: Uniformed Blackfang Card
3990004.desc: The captain of the ship called the Black Fox. She welcomes beginning adventurers.

3990005.name: Grateful Armen Card
3990005.desc: A special card filled with gratitude. Only obtainable for a limited time. Armen, a young priest searching for the Arks scattered around the world, greets you with a warm smile.

3990006.name: Grateful Thirain Card
3990006.desc: A special card filled with gratitude. Only obtainable for a limited time. Thirain, King of Luterra, greets you with a warm smile.

3990007.name: Joytide Snowflake Reindeer Card
3990007.desc: A special card released only around Joytide. The Snowflake Reindeer helps Father Joytide bring presents and joy to people all across Arkesia.

6831700.desc: A chest that contains a treasure map of Voldis.

6831800.desc: A chest that contains a treasure map of South Kurzan.

6836001.name: Secret Pouch: Mysterious Green Pouch
6836001.desc:
A green pouch woven with blades of fresh grass.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force surrounds the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836002.name: Akam Wood Block
6836002.desc:
A block of Akam wood, a Punika specialty.
Supposedly, a merchant who recognizes its value often appears somewhere in Punika.

6836003.name: Secret Pouch: Soft Pouch
6836003.desc:
A soft pouch made from the fibers of an Akam's bark.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force surrounds the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836004.name: Crystallized Platinum
6836004.desc:
A crystal mined from platinum ore.
Supposedly, a merchant who recognizes its value often appears somewhere in Punika.

6836005.name: Secret Pouch: Splendid Platinum Pouch
6836005.desc:
A very expensive looking pouch gilded with a thin layer of platinum.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force surrounds the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836006.name: Full-Colored Leather
6836006.desc:
The hide of a rabbit from Candaria Territory.
Supposedly, a merchant who recognizes its value often appears somewhere in South Vern.

6836007.name: Secret Pouch: Tough Leather Pouch
6836007.desc:
A pouch made of high-quality leather.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force surrounds the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836008.name: Paunchy Fish
6836008.desc:
A voracious fish that devours everything it sees.
No one can tell what's in its bulging belly.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Use it to see what the fish swallowed. Maybe there's something valuable?"</FONT>

6836009.name: Elegant Ring
6836009.desc:
A ring found in the belly of a fish.
Supposedly, a merchant who recognizes its value often appears somewhere in South Vern.

6836010.name: Secret Pouch: Marvelous Magick Pouch
6836010.desc:
A pouch with an interesting enchantment.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force surrounds the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836011.name: Completed Stone Tablet
6836011.desc:
A complete stone tablet put together from scattered fragments.
Supposedly, a merchant who recognizes its value often appears somewhere in South Vern.

6836012.name: Secret Pouch: Gem-Studded Pouch
6836012.desc:
A pouch adorned with gems of archaeological value.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force surrounds the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836013.name: Sky Wind Flower Petal
6836013.desc:
A Sky Wind Flower Petal, known to only grow on Mount Phylantos.
Supposedly, a merchant who collects petals often appears somewhere in Elgacia.

6836014.name: Secret Pouch: Scented Pouch
6836014.desc:
A pouch with the aroma of Sky Wind Flowers.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>A warm life force surrounds the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836015.name: Crystallized Red Bauble
6836015.desc:
A mysterious crystal collected from a red ore.
According to a recipe sold by a Stronghold merchant, it can be used to make an interesting chest.

6836016.name: Helpful Gift Chest
6836016.desc:
A chest containing a variety of useful objects.
Something special might be in it.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"It's unclear what's inside, but it feels like it contains something very useful."</FONT>

6836017.name: Lazenith's Pendant
6836017.desc:
A Lazenith's pendant of unknown origin.
Supposedly, a merchant who recognizes its value often appears somewhere in Elgacia.

6836018.name: Secret Pouch: Shiny Pouch
6836018.desc:
A pouch that glitters very brightly.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>A warm life force surrounds the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836019.name: Completely Processed Top-Grade Leather
6836019.desc: Top-grade leather that has been processed. The leather has been imbued with magick. Take it to a certain alchemist, along with a Precise Facet Needle, and they can craft a Processed Top-Grade Leather Armor.

6836020.name:
Secret Pouch: Pouch Seeping
With Magick
6836020.desc:
A pouch made of top-grade leather that has been processed.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force surrounds the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836021.name: Daring Fish
6836021.desc:
A rare fish from Voldis. After being captured, it quickly becomes demoralized and turns into an ordinary fish.
It is said that merchants who recognize its value often appear somewhere in Voldis.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"There's not much time... Let's find a merchant who's interested in it!"</FONT>

6836022.name: Rainbow Fish
6836022.desc:
A giant, legendary fish that can only be caught in Voldis. It's rumored to get its rainbow scales from the World Tree Leaves.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Upon use, you can see what the fish is carrying. Maybe I can get something extremely valuable?"</FONT>

6836023.name: Dry World Tree Leaves
6836023.desc:
A faintly glowing World Tree Leaf. It has been forgotten for so long that it doesn't seem to have much power. It may never return to its past glory.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"If I dismantle it and get some of the buds, maybe I can make it bloom again."</FONT>

6836024.name: World Tree Small Leaf Bud
6836024.desc:
A young leaf bud found while rummaging through dried leaves from the World Tree. Even this small bud is warm with lively energy.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"If I take it to an alchemist in Voldis together with some rainbow-colored items, maybe they can make it bloom again?"</FONT>

6836025.name: Re-blossoming Bud
6836025.desc:
Tiny flower petals blooming with the power of the World Tree's leaf buds and rainbows. A small but brilliant light shines within.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm energy envelops the bud. I wonder why..."</FONT>

6836026.name: Uncommon Leatherworking Chest
6836026.desc:
A box for leatherworking. Contains high quality leather. Occasionally contains a special leatherworking tool.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"It contains items needed for leatherworking. Maybe I can get a special leatherworking tool?"</FONT>

6836027.name: Precise Facet Needle
6836027.desc: A special tool found in an uncommon leatherworking chest. If you look closely, you can see the detailed markings of the Golden Path. Even the most difficult leathers will be easy to work with.

6836028.name: Rainbow Leather
6836028.desc:
Top-grade leather from an uncommon leatherworking chest. It doesn't seem like it can be processed by normal means. It shimmers in a rainbow of colors in the light.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"If used this as an alchemy material... it could make something amazing!"</FONT>

6836029.name: Processed Top-Grade Leather Armor
6836029.desc:
Armor made from the processed top-grade leather. A specialty of Voldis.
Supposedly, a merchant who recognizes its value often appears somewhere in Voldis.

6836030.name: Pudgy Fish
6836030.desc:
A fish that swallows everything it sees. Given its plump appearance, it must be a voracious eater.
Who knows what this fish has eaten.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force envelops the fish. Let's find out why that is..."</FONT>

6836031.name: Rainbow Scale
6836031.desc:
One of the items that the Pudgy Fish swallowed. It looks like the scale of a Rainbow Fish. It shimmers in every color when it catches light.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"If used this as an alchemy material... it could make something amazing!"</FONT>

6836032.name: Rainbow Essence
6836032.desc:
A rare essence with a mystical glow. Its mysterious origin means it trades at a high price. It shimmers in every color when it catches light.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"If used this as an alchemy material... it could make something amazing!"</FONT>

6836033.name: Dispirited Fish
6836033.desc: A captured Elated Fish that has been transformed into an ordinary fish. Dismantle to obtain fish.

6836034.name: Secret Pouch: Melancholy Pouch
6836034.desc:
A pouch with a sad story to it.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force emanates from the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836035.name: Weathered Ore
6836035.desc: It is streaked with dirt after being in the ground for many years. A merchant who understands its value appears somewhere in South Kurzan from time to time.

6836036.name: Weathered Log
6836036.desc: The wood looks as if it was neglected for years. However, it looks like it could be used somewhere else if it's touched up.

6836037.name: Wooden Gift Box
6836037.desc:
A gift box created with ore and timber neglected for years. It looks great for storing ornaments.

<FONT color="#FFD200">"Don't blame yourself, it's not your fault."</FONT>

6836038.name: Copper Ring
6836038.desc:
A ring faded from age.
The faded appearance gives it a melancholic feel.

<FONT color="#FFD200">"May our child live in a world without blades and blood."</FONT>

6836039.name: Faded Stem
6836039.desc: It looks quite withered after being in the ground for many years. A merchant who understands its value appears somewhere in South Kurzan from time to time.

6836040.name: Vine Woven Tiara
6836040.desc:
A tiara woven with withered vines.
There's still a faint life energy inside the stem.

<FONT color="#FFD200">"I believe that even this barren land will become a lush forest one day."</FONT>

6836041.name: Sooty Ore
6836041.desc:
A rare ore found only in South Kurzan.
It's said you can find a rare shard if it's refined.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Use to refine the ore. You may find something valuable?"</FONT>

6836042.name: Blue Colored Shard
6836042.desc: A valuable looking shard refined from a sooty ore. A merchant who understands its value appears somewhere in South Kurzan from time to time.

6836043.name: Sooty Shard
6836043.desc: A small shard found while refining the sooty ore.

6836044.name: Secret Pouch: Sooty Pouch
6836044.desc:
A pouch which looks worn and dirty because of the soot and dust.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force emanates from the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836045.name: Melancholy Gift Chest
6836045.desc:
A gift chest restored to its original state.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force emanates from the chest. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836046.name: Melancholy Ring
6836046.desc:
A ring with its former glory restored.
It once again shines, but somehow feels melancholic.

<FONT color="#FFD200">"I shall protect my daughter."</FONT>

6836048.name: Sticky Gland
6836048.desc: An unidentified chunk of meat from North Kurzan rabbits. On closer inspection, it seems to have some sticky mucus that could be useful in crafting.

6836049.name: Sticky Slime
6836049.desc: A peculiar sticky slime from a North Kurzan rabbit's gland. It gives off a subtle, naturally smoky scent. It would make tempting bait for a fish.

6836050.name: Wild Tough Leather
6836050.desc: The special hide of a rabbit from North Kurzan. Supposedly, a merchant who recognizes its value often appears somewhere in North Kurzan.

6836051.name: Black-Striped Fish
6836051.desc: A black-striped fish that appears in North Kurzan. Supposedly, a merchant who recognizes its value often appears somewhere in North Kurzan.

6836052.name: Secret Pouch: Black Bait Pouch
6836052.desc:
A black leather pouch crafted to conceal its contents. It features the emblem of ancient fishing masters.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A pouch that seems to contain a mysterious bait. What could be inside?"</FONT>

6836053.name: Action Lure
6836053.desc: An old lure with multiple joints, once used by ancient fishing masters. Great action is expected.

6836055.name: Mysterious Ancient Volcano Fish
6836055.desc:
A mysterious fish that has survived the harsh environment of Kurzan. The mysterious energy of the World Tree is palpable.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"The volcano fish is enveloped in a warm life energy. What might be inside its stomach?"</FONT>

6836056.name: Burning Scale
6836056.desc:
With mysterious flame-colored scales resembling lava, the ancient volcano fish's characteristics are clearly imprinted. This fiery hue, symbolizing nature, cannot be artificially reproduced.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"The scales, with an enigmatic quality akin to flowing lava, seem destined to command a high price from collectors"</FONT>

6836057.name: Broken Old Chest
6836057.desc: An ancient chest that could be filled with old treasures. The lock is heavily damaged and can't be opened.

6836058.name: Fragmented Metal Shard
6836058.desc: Fragments of metal crafted with ancient technology. With proper processing, they seem suitable for use as quality materials.

6836059.name: Ancient Inscribed Chest
6836059.desc:
A golden chest with inscriptions in ancient languages, possessing great archaeological significance.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"The radiant gold color proves the chest's value. What might be inside?"</FONT>

6836060.name: Volcano Fish Activity Record
6836060.desc:
An ancient journal by master anglers, covering a range of fishing techniques and observations of the ancient volcano fish.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"There is fishing bait that can produce actions more spirited than those of a live fish."</FONT>

6836061.name: Old Herbalist's Bag
6836061.desc: A herbalist's shabby old bag that seems to have a sad story behind it.

6836062.name: Illusion Cookie Cake
6836062.desc:
A special cake made with rare ingredients found only in Rimeria. It is characterized by its sweetness, aroma, and the savory flavor of cookies that are reddened with a special power that leaves a lingering taste in the mouth.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"The perfect combination of sweet and savory. A luxury cookie cake that melts like an illusion."</FONT>

6836063.name: Old Chest
6836063.desc: An old worn-out chest that once held a daughter's favorite doll.

6836064.name: Red Sowing Seed
6836064.desc: A type of red seed found only in Rimeria. It has a pulpy texture with a refreshing flavor and aroma when chewed.

6836065.name: Flour
6836065.desc: A fine flour made from harvested wheat that has been nourished by the good soil of Rimeria. It is used as a basic ingredient for making food.

6836066.name: Well-Baked Cookie
6836066.desc:
A moist, golden brown, well-baked snack. It can be eaten with milk or broken up and used as an ingredient in desserts.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>It is the ingredient for Illusion Cookie Cake.</FONT>

6836067.name: Ragged Doll
6836067.desc: An old, worn-out doll that Lucille used to carry around when she was younger.

6836068.name: Juniper Fragment
6836068.desc: A rare wood found only in Rimeria. Supposedly, a merchant who recognizes its value often appears somewhere in Rimeria.

6836069.name: Honeycomb
6836069.desc:
A rare honeycomb that can only be found in Rimeria. After several stages of refining, the honey is said to have a unique aroma and taste.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Use to refine the honeycomb to obtain clean honeycomb."</FONT>

6836070.name: Refined Honeycomb
6836070.desc:
Successfully refined honeycomb after careful refinement. After careful refining, the honey is said to have a unique aroma and taste.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Use to refine the honeycomb even more to obtain graded honey."</FONT>

6836071.name: Premium Honey
6836071.desc:
The best quality honey selected from a refined honeycomb. After even more refining, you can obtain a finished honey with a unique aroma and taste.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Use to refine the graded honey to obtain sweet honey."</FONT>

6836072.name: Sweet Honey
6836072.desc: This popular and fragrant honey can only be found in Rimeria. It is very rare and has a unique sweetness and floral flavor unique to the region.

6836073.name: Secret Pouch: Secret Pouch
6836073.desc:
A precious pouch with a secretive energy.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A warm life force surrounds the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836074.name: Secret Powder
6836074.desc: A mysterious powder created in Rimeria by condensing various ingredients. It is said that even rotten food can taste like food prepared by a world famous chef with a pinch of this secret powder.

6836075.name: Reddish Ore
6836075.desc:
A rare ore found only in Rimeria. It's said you can find a rare shard if it's refined.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Use to refine the ore. You may find something valuable?"</FONT>

6836076.name: Rock Salt
6836076.desc: A rare crystallized salt found while refining the reddish ore.

6836077.name: Red Colored Shard
6836077.desc: A valuable looking shard refined from a reddish ore. A merchant who understands its value appears somewhere in Rimeria from time to time.

6836078.name: Secret Pouch: Ruddy Pouch
6836078.desc: A precious pouch made of red organic materials.

6836079.name: Small Shiny Gem
6836079.desc: A luminous little gem that aristocrats of old commissioned artisans to create to adorn their toy dolls.

6836080.name: Fancy Outfit
6836080.desc:
A small dress that aristocrats from times past commissioned artisans to create to adorn their toy dolls.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>It is the core material for the Lovely Little Doll.</FONT>

6836081.name: Lovely Little Doll
6836081.desc: A tiny doll with a luminous gem and a soft, colorful dress. Lucille's old favorite doll has been reborn in the hands of an artisan. The artisan's delicate touch and pure, warm feelings are evident.

6836082.name: Lucille's Small Chest
6836082.desc:
A mysterious little chest containing some of Lucille's most precious things.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>A warm life force surrounds the pouch. What's inside it?"</FONT>

6836083.name: Happy Family Photo
6836083.desc:
A happy photo of sisters Saya and Lucille and their mother.
It appears to be a picture of the sisters when they were younger.
The family's expressions are happy, but there's a sense of wistfulness as you keep looking at it.

<FONT color="#FFD200">"I hope our children are healthy and always happy together..."</FONT>

6836101.name: Prime Trade Skill Supplies Chest
6836101.desc: Contains various items that aid in Trade Skill activities.

6836103.name: Master of Trade Skills Emote Chest
6836103.desc: Contains special emotes associated with Trade Skills.

6836104.name: Great Trade Skill Master's Chest
6836104.desc: A special chest to honor the great one, blessed by the World Tree.

6836111.name: Faint Ore Charm Chest
6836111.desc: A chest that contains a Faint Ore Charm.

6836112.name: Luminous Gem Charm Chest
6836112.desc: A chest that contains a Luminous Gem Charm.

6836113.name: Luminous Elemental Stone Charm Chest
6836113.desc: A chest that contains a Luminous Elemental Stone Charm.

6836114.name: Brilliant Star Charm Chest
6836114.desc: A chest that contains a Brilliant Star Charm.

6836120.name: Nahun's Domain Chest
6836120.desc: Open to obtain Foraging, Logging, and Mining Trade Skill Materials.

6836121.name: Yudia Canal Chest
6836121.desc: Open to obtain Hunting, Fishing, and Excavating Trade Skill Materials.

6836130.name: Torn Ancient Record
6836130.desc:
An ancient record, now only partially remaining after many long years.
One of the fragments needed to restore a Forgotten Tome.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"I heard there's an alchemist in Rimeria who can restore ancient records. Could it be true?"</FONT>

6836131.name: Faded Ancient Record
6836131.desc:
An ancient record, old and faded after many long years.
One of the fragments needed to restore a Forgotten Tome.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"I heard there's an alchemist in Rimeria who can restore ancient records. Could it be true?"</FONT>

6836134.name: Emerging Essence
6836134.desc:
The Star of Life, a rare gem condensed with the energy of Arkesia. Beautiful Life Energy surrounded by light stirs within it.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Supposedly, a merchant who recognizes its value often appears somewhere in Anikka."</FONT>

6836135.name: Secret Pouch: Primal Pouch
6836135.desc:
A pouch made of leather with a mysterious texture.
The mysterious presence of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Primordial life force surrounds the pouch. What could be inside?"</FONT>

6836136.name: Ancient Seed
6836136.desc: A seed with a mysterious aura. The infinite Life Energy of Arkesia lies dormant within.

6836137.name: Golden Essence
6836137.desc:
Golden tree sap flowing with ancient life force.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"They say an alchemist in Rohendel uses this material in a very unique way."</FONT>

6836138.name: Entwined Tome of Wisdom
6836138.desc:
A mysterious book containing the wisdom of a forgotten civilization.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"I heard Mr. Shin is looking for this book at the Stronghold."</FONT>

6836139.name: Shin's Crystallized Earth
6836139.desc:
A soil core that promotes growth even in barren lands.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"To maximize the effects, essence flowing with ancient life force might be the key?"</FONT>

6836140.name: Vibrant Soil
6836140.desc:
A special soil created by combining golden essence with Mr. Shin's soil crystals. Its overflowing life force makes sprouts grow even in barren land.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"The soil to grow new life has already been prepared."</FONT>

6836141.name: Life-Imbued Pollen
6836141.desc:
A very rare pollen from flowers, brimming with Life Energy.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"They say an alchemist in Feiton uses this material in a very unique way."</FONT>

6836142.name: Fine Pearly Powder
6836142.desc:
A mysterious powder created through alchemy by mixing a Primordial Seed with pollen imbued with life.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Let us breathe eternal life into the small bloom that has just awakened."</FONT>

6836143.name: Condensed Life Crystal
6836143.desc:
A very rare Ore crystallized from the accumulation of Life Energy flowing throughout Arkesia over many years. 

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"They say an alchemist at the Great Castle uses this material in a very unique way."</FONT>

6836144.name: Intact Beast's Molar
6836144.desc:
The molar of a beast living on barren land. Imbued with powerful Life Energy from surviving in harsh environments.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Could this help refine Crystals of Life?"</FONT>

6836145.name: Small Life Orb
6836145.desc:
A small orb created by fusing a Condensed Life Crystal and Intact Beast's Molars.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Said to be used as a rare material that can contain Intact Life Force."</FONT>

6836146.name: Mandarin
6836146.desc:
A rare fish found only in the currents of certain areas of Arkesia. It has a special organ that converts Life Force into energy.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>To avoid damaging this special organ, it must be dismantled slowly and carefully.</FONT>

6836147.name: Mandarium
6836147.desc:
A special organ of the rare Mandarin fish. The Life Force absorbed by the Mandarin circulates and is converted into energy. A special glass bottle is needed to properly preserve this organ.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"They say an alchemist in Arthetine uses this material in a very unique way."</FONT>

6836148.name: Flask Containing the Energy of Life
6836148.desc:
A special flask crafted by fusing a small Life Orb and Iron Ore. It can safely store a Mandarium.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"A flask that can store a Mandarium intact. Let's handle it with care."</FONT>

6836149.name: Full Life Flask
6836149.desc:
A flask full of Life Force.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Infuse a newly born creature with the breath of life to guide its growth."</FONT>

6836150.name: Longing Leather Necklace
6836150.desc:
A small necklace crafted from Top-Grade Leather. The warmth of the person who once wore it still seems to linger.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Every time I touch the necklace, warm memories of the times we shared come flooding back."</FONT>

6836151.name: Warm Footprint Chest
6836151.desc:
An old chest filled with items that were loved by a small cat.
The mysterious energy of the World Tree can be felt.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>"Warm echoes of memories come from the small chest. What could be inside?"</FONT>

6836152.name: Torn Ancient Record Chest
6836152.desc: A chest containing ancient records that only partially remain after the passage of time.

6836153.name: Faded Ancient Record Chest
6836153.desc: A chest containing ancient records that only partially remain after the passage of time.

6836600.name: Jar Pufferfish
6836600.desc: A rare species of fish caught only on Island of Time. It is shaped like a bell and makes a clear ringing sound when flicked.

6836601.name: Whispering Butterflyfish
6836601.desc: A rare species of fish caught only in the Lost City. Its transparent body makes it impossible for predators to see it. Bring your ear close to it, and it might tell you a secret.

6836602.name: Tin Hermit Crab
6836602.desc: A rare species of fish caught only in Arthetine. Its solid alloy shell is proof of its evolution.

6836603.name: Candlefish
6836603.desc: A rare species of fish caught only in Shushire when the water temperature is extremely low. It tastes even better after a long wait.

6836604.name: Ancient Civilization Vestige
6836604.desc:
An ancient and rare relic whose origins are too old to trace.
Bringing it to Mr. Shin, the Wholesaler at the Stronghold, could reveal its use.

63020000.name: Adventure: Mokoko Mushroom
63020000.desc: A mushroom that only grows around Tortoyk. Noted for its distinctive flavor. It can sometimes be found among the small mushrooms around Giant Mushroom Island.

63020001.name: Adventure: Llama
63020001.desc: A camelid that mainly lives on plateaus. It can usually be seen on high ground.

63020002.name: Adventure: Red Sea Turtle
63020002.desc: A sea turtle with a red carapace. No one knows where exactly it lives, but it's usually seen near the seaside.

63020003.name: Adventure: Stardust
63020003.desc: Glowing dust dropped from falling stars.

63020004.name: Adventure: Sea Flower
63020004.desc: A floating flower that lives in the sea. Used for magical purposes.

63020005.name: Adventure: Starfruit
63020005.desc: A star-shaped tropical fruit. Mainly used for medicinal purposes.

63020006.name: Adventure: Dragonfruit
63020006.desc: A fruit that grows on a cactus. Its name was coined from its shape, which resembles the ball that the mythical dragon carries in its mouth.

63020007.name: Adventure: Mandrill
63020007.desc: A guenon with a colorful face.

63020008.name: Adventure: Ghost Lizard
63020008.desc: A lizard with a transparent body. It springs up out of nowhere, startling people.

63020009.name: Adventure: 5-Colored Parrot
63020009.desc:
A parrot with colorful feathers. It's a popular pet among pirates.
In the wild, it's often seen flying low above beaches fringed with trees.

63020010.name: Adventure: Tablet of Wind
63020010.desc: An old stone slab with a wind-like pattern and ancient letters engraved on it. The letters are weathered beyond recognition.

63020011.name: Adventure: Halfmoon Mask
63020011.desc: A crescent-shaped mask that seems to have a ceremonial purpose.

63020012.name: Adventure: Ancient Rod
63020012.desc: An old rod that is snapped in half.

63020013.name: Adventure: Ancient Gold Coin
63020013.desc: An old gold coin with an eagle shape imprinted on it.

63020015.name: Discover Adventures: Crevasse
63020015.desc: A crack in a glacier. Crevasses vary in depth and width, and the ones covered by snow are especially dangerous.

63020016.name: Adventure: Smoldering Ice
63020016.desc: Marvelous ice discovered in the polar regions. It's blazing endlessly.

63020017.name: Adventure: Dolmen
63020017.desc: An ancient graveyard consisting of piles of stones. It's believed to have been created before civilization appeared in Vern. The stones are placed across the cliff.

63020018.name: Adventure: Magick Circle
63020018.desc: A massive magick circle written in an ancient language. It's believed to be for summoning. Magick circles have been seen drawn onto the continents themselves.

63020019.name: Adventure: Shipwreck
63020019.desc: A ship that crashed where there was no wind, the result of sailing unprepared. Only a part of it is visible above the water.

63020020.name: Adventure: Common Dolphin
63020020.desc: A dolphin that's sometimes seen around Vern. Meeting dolphins is said to bring good luck.

63020021.name: Adventure: Polar Mammoth
63020021.desc: An elephant-like mammal that lived in the polar regions a long time ago. They can sometimes be found well-preserved in glaciers.

63020022.name: Adventure: Red Camel
63020022.desc: A red-haired camel that lives near Yudia. Noted for the two big humps on its back.

63020023.name: Adventure: Unicorn
63020023.desc: A mythical creature that's believed to come from the moon's shadow reflected on a lake in a deep forest. It looks like a white horse with a long, beautiful horn on its forehead.

63020024.name: Adventure: Ghost Stingray
63020024.desc: A huge stingray believed to be the patron god of the southern sea. Its shadow under the surface of the water is the only indication of its size and existence, for no one has actually seen or encountered it.

63020025.name: Adventure: Siren
63020025.desc: A mermaid seen on small coral reefs. Sailors often disappear overnight, enthralled by the Siren's beautiful singing voice.

63020026.name: Adventure: Moonkeep
63020026.desc: A tower erected by the exiled Sylvains in memory of their queen. Its design is inspired by Sunkeep in Rohendel.

63020027.name: Adventure: Godsent Spear
63020027.desc: A stone pillar that stands erect in the middle of the deep sea. It's believed to be a remnant of an ancient war among the gods.

63020028.name: Adventure: Statue of Gienah
63020028.desc: A statue of the goddess of the sea, who is famous among adventurers. There is an old legend that those who have been recognized by the goddess for their valor and wisdom will be blessed by her.

63020029.name: Adventure: Aurora
63020029.desc: A beautiful aurora rarely seen at the ends of Shushire.

63020030.name: Adventure: Whirlpool
63020030.desc: An area that only magical ships can pass though. It's filled with many spinning vortexes, big and small.

63020031.name: Adventure: Mute Island
63020031.desc: An island whose inhabitants are believed to have preyed on each other. Numerous skeletons were discovered centuries later.

63020032.name: Adventure: Totoiki Boat
63020032.desc: A small boat of Totoikis. Even the tinniest ripples could flip it over.

63020033.name: Adventure: Eye of the North Sea
63020033.desc: A lagoon formed in the Credos Ocean. It's such a deep and dark place that sometimes people who dive in don't come back out again.

63020034.name: Adventure: Eye of the South Sea
63020034.desc: A big lagoon located in the Acheron Sea. It's seemingly endless.

63020035.name: Adventure: Eye of the Dead
63020035.desc: A lagoon formed in the Sea of Death. Its deep colors makes me shiver. Its name, Eye of the Dead, was coined after countless ships and sailors went missing in the area.

63020036.name: Adventure: Mysterious Chest
63020036.desc: A chest decorated with colorful gemstones that is believed to contain important documents.

63020037.name: Adventure: Pirate's Peg Leg
63020037.desc: An exquisitely made prosthetic leg. It's believed to have been worn by a notorious pirate captain.

63020038.name: Adventure: Pirate Flag
63020038.desc: The flag of Bloodclaw the Great Pirate. A great many pirates carry it as their lucky charm.

63020039.name: Adventure: The Hestia
63020039.desc: A shipwreck on a coral reef. It was one of the ships that belonged to Bloodclaw the Great Pirate.

63020040.name: Adventure: Phantomwing
63020040.desc: A mysteriously colored luminous body that's sometimes discovered in the coastal waters off the Rohendel continent. It's said to be the spirit of a Sylvain.

63020041.name: Adventure: King Shellfish
63020041.desc: A clam found only in tropical waters. Old ones are rare and considered sacred.

63020042.name: Adventure: Covered Figurehead
63020042.desc: A figurehead and art masterpiece commissioned by a rich man. Its existence, originally kept secret, was revealed to the public through theft.

63020043.name: Adventure: Ice Statue of a Woman
63020043.desc: An ice statue that has retained its shape for generations. Situated in a steep area, it hasn't been seen by many people and is considered an exaggerated story told by seamen.

63020044.name: Adventure: Snow Sled
63020044.desc: A snow sled that is thought to have been used in the early days of Vern's Adventurer's Guild. It was left as a waymark for the day that they set out to explore again.

63020045.name: Adventure: Lost Merchant Ship
63020045.desc: A long-lost merchant ship that belonged to the Tea and Libra Guild. Although the ship is undamaged, there is no trace of its sailors nor the goods it was carrying.

63020046.name: Adventure: Deep Sea Boulder
63020046.desc: A boulder that was swept onto the shore by a rough storm. The scholars in Vern concluded that the boulder was formed in the depths of the sea, but failed to find out how it arrived at the beach.

63020047.name: Adventure: Shattered Chain
63020047.desc: A fragment of the giant chain that came from the huge Chaos Gate that appeared in South Vern. Although it was deflected by the Sylvain Queen, it still spews out an Aura of Chaos, affecting the surroundings.

63020048.name: Adventure: Guardian's Scar
63020048.desc: A gaping wound left behind by a Chaos Guardian who regained their strength. An unknown power is eroding the earth.

63020050.name: Adventure: Sacrian Censer
63020050.desc: A giant censer being transported to Sacria. It was swept from the transport ship after encountering violent waves in the ocean and vanished.

63060001.desc: A chart that once belonged to the great pirate Bloodclaw. It is said to contain records of rare treasures scattered across Arkesia.
