63200000.name: Armen Card
63200000.desc: A young priest searching for the lost Arks of legend in hopes of saving the mortal world and healing its people.

63200001.name: Thirain Card
63200001.desc: The righteous and incorruptible prince of Luterra.

63200002.name: Valtan Card
63200002.desc: The Demon Beast Commander, who leads the Demon Beasts of Petrania. His unstoppable charge inspires terror in his enemies.

63200003.name: King Thirain Card
63200003.desc: The King of Luterra. The epitome of a good leader, he always thinks of his people.

63200004.name: Shandi Card
63200004.desc: One of the Seven Sidereals. This carefree man wanders the world with his student.

63200005.name: Zinnervale Card
63200005.desc: Sidereal Shandi's student. Cheerful and flippant, he travels the continent with his master, hoping to one day learn all he knows.

63200006.name: Delain Armen Card
63200006.desc: Armen has revealed his hidden power as a Delain. He uses his inner demonic power instead of his holy power.

63200007.name: Kakul-Saydon Card
63200007.desc: The commander of the Mayhem Legion. Behind his playful facade, he hides an evil, maddening power.

63200008.name: Wei Card
63200008.desc: A fighter who inherited the name of the Sidereal. Having avenged his master, he is now ready to save the world.

63200009.name: Vykas Card
63200009.desc: The commander of the Covetous Legion. She manipulates others' desires with sweet words. She is looking for a vessel to accept Kazeros.

63200010.name: Akkan Card
63200010.desc: The commander of the Plague Legion who has the ability to control diseases and corruption. He absorbs everything that breathes, craving for a body for himself.

63200011.name: Kharmine Card
63200011.desc: An insidious Demon who operates with ill intent. He has the ability to absorb the powers of other Demons.

63200012.name: Thaemine Card
63200012.desc: The commander of the Darkness Legion. He is the strongest and most mysterious of Kazeros's commanders.

63200013.name: Brelshaza Card
63200013.desc: The commander of the Phantom Legion. Known as the most cunning and ruthless of all legion commanders, she charms her enemies and inflicts awful hallucinations upon them.

63200014.name: Beatrice Card
63200014.desc: A Lazenith who watches over the world from Trixion, a rift in spacetime, under the order of the god Regulus.

63200015.name: Azena and Inanna Card
63200015.desc: A member of the Sidereals and queen of the Sylvains. She has two souls in one body.

63200016.name: Balthorr Card
63200016.desc: The Sidereal Galatur's descendant. He's pleasant and boastful, but very loyal.

63200017.name: Guardian Luen Card
63200017.desc: A neutral Guardian that belongs to neither light nor darkness. They watch Arkesia through the eyes of a prophet.

63200018.name: Luterra Card
63200018.desc: The leader of the Sidereals, a hero who fought against Kazeros during the Chain War.

63200019.name: Sien Card
63200019.desc: A heroic member of the Sidereals who fought against Kazeros during the Chain War. He was a master of the Sihwa School and took on the Immortal Dochul.

63200020.name: Galatur Card
63200020.desc: A heroic member of the Sidereals who fought against Kazeros during the Chain War. His exemplary skills crafted the Sidereals' armaments.

63200021.name: Nineveh Card
63200021.desc: A Lazenith who is a member of the Sidereals. She can communicate with every object.

63200022.name: Kadan Card
63200022.desc: A member of the Sidereals who remains veiled in mystery. He is known as the first Guardian Slayer.

63200023.name: Thanatos Card
63200023.desc: A creature conjured with dark magick. It dwells in the body of the ancient king, nestled in the depths of the Morai Ruins.

63200024.name: Thunderwings Card
63200024.desc: A demonic beast surrounded by lightning. Its deafening roar can be heard for miles.

63200025.name: Scherrit Card
63200025.desc: The regent of Luterra. He poisoned the former king and colluded with Demons to take the crown for himself.

63200026.name: Allegro Card
63200026.desc: A tranquil bard who spends his days recounting stories of his life in song. He gives the impression that he's learned everything that there is to know about the world.

63200027.name: Mage Nahun Card
63200027.desc: A senior court mage of Luterra who constructed King Luterra's tomb and other buildings across the kingdom. His spirit keeps the King's Tomb guarded even after death.

63200028.name: Jagan Card
63200028.desc: A Demon that snuck into King Luterra's tomb. It breathes hellfire at anyone foolish enough to seek the King's Ark.

63200029.name: Blackfang Card
63200029.desc: Captain of the Black Fox. Composed and charismatic. Unlike Bloodclaw, the legendary pirate who mysteriously vanished, Blackfang maintains order while on the high seas.

63200030.name: Mokamoka Card
63200030.desc: A curious Mokoko boy. He's embarked on the greatest adventure of his life to find Tortoyk's Heart.

63200031.name: Habeck Card
63200031.desc: The 1st Sword of Changhun, a taoist who learned illusion jutsu. A disciple of the Sidereals who learned from Wei.

63200032.name: Banda Card
63200032.desc: A fiend that rules over the Bleak Edge. It took Sidereal Sien and both leaders of the Yeon and Jeok clans to seal its body.

63200033.name: Bastian Card
63200033.desc: One of the three leaders of the Republic of Arthetine. His boyish appearance belies his levelheadedness and charisma as a leader of Arthetine.

63200034.name: Sasha Card
63200034.desc: One of the three leaders of the Republic of Arthetine. She manages her nation's finances with an iron fist.

63200035.name: Krause Card
63200035.desc: One of the three leaders of the Republic of Arthetine. He wants to lead the Cykins to a higher stage of evolution to protect Arkesia against Demons.

63200036.name: Mari Card
63200036.desc: One of Technologist Krause's Personal Guards. She has an amazing talent for building giant mechanical weaponry. She admires Krause and craves his recognition.

63200037.name: Lord of Evolution Krause Card
63200037.desc: Krause's final evolutionary form, created by the Sun of Creation. It has the shape of a god with mechanical wings. With this power, Krause tried to stop the Demons.

63200038.name: Madnick Card
63200038.desc: A warrior who once dominated the Arena. Leader of the Daybreakers, he fights to abolish prison profiteering and bring a new dawn to Shushire.

63200039.name: Thar Card
63200039.desc: Vern's Knight Commander, who once was called the Silver Spear. He died in a battle against a necromancer a hundred years ago, and something recently brought him back to life.

63200040.name: Anabel Card
63200040.desc: A clerk working at the Adventurer's Guild. Her adventurer parents died on a journey when she was young, and Gideon took her under his wing and raised her with help from the rest of the Guild.

63200041.name: Sigmund Card
63200041.desc: A necromancer who tried to dominate Vern a hundred years ago. He was killed during a battle against the knights, but something recently brought him back, and he's determined to destroy Vern.

63200042.name: Nacrasena Card
63200042.desc: With their gigantic body, strong, hard claws and huge thorns, Nacrasena, the Guardian of the desert, overwhelms those who witness their grandeur.

63200043.name: Levanos Card
63200043.desc: This ancient being, Levanos, has all the natural elements at its command.

63200044.name: Vertus Card
63200044.desc: Vertus, a beast known as the Snow Monarch, is surrounded by icy power that instantly freezes anyone who gets too close to it.

63200045.name: Chromanium Card
63200045.desc: Guardian Chromanium, known for their nigh impenetrable carapace, roars as they bombard their enemies with fiery breath and a volley of magick projectiles.

63200046.name: Helgaia Card
63200046.desc: Helgaia is a massive Guardian with blazing feathers, rumored to rise from the ashes over and over again.

63200047.name: Icy Legoros Card
63200047.desc: Icy Legoros generates extreme cold from its hulking body to freeze enemies solid and then shatter them into bloody shards.

63200048.name: Dark Legoros Card
63200048.desc: Dark Legoros expels dark power from its huge body and blinds its enemies to make them easy prey.

63200049.name: Ephernia Card
63200049.desc: An ancient Flame Elemental, violent and aggressive.

63200050.name: Gnosis Card
63200050.desc: An ancient Earthen Elemental, calm and composed.

63200051.name: Undart Card
63200051.desc: An ancient Water Elemental, reticent and harsh.

63200052.name: Sylperion Card
63200052.desc: An ancient Thunder Elemental, amiable and kind.

63200053.name: Kaysarr Card
63200053.desc: The king who rules Yorn. Calm and very charismatic.

63200054.name: Velcruze Card
63200054.desc: A demonic sword made in the Ark of Arrogance. It seeks to absorb a host to complete its evolution.

63200055.name: Kaishur Card
63200055.desc: A Darkness Legion Demon led into Yorn by Velcruze. Aggressive and vicious.

63200056.name: Zaika Card
63200056.desc: The head of Avesta, Feiton's Order of Assassins. He is cool and charismatic.

63200057.name: Kaldor Card
63200057.desc: A member of Avesta, Feiton's Order of Assassins. Taciturn and heartless.

63200058.name: Jederico Card
63200058.desc: A Dawn Priest who was sent to Feiton to monitor the area.

63200059.name: Kalmaris Card
63200059.desc: A high-ranking Demon of the Darkness Legion. He commands the Darkness Legion under Thaemine's orders.

63200060.name: Chaotic Zaika Card
63200060.desc: Zaika, corrupted by the darkness of Thaemine.

63200061.name: Avele Card
63200061.desc: The Knight Commander of Vern. Free-spirited and popular with everyone.

63200062.name: Ealyn Card
63200062.desc: The Queen of Vern. She is regal, gracious, and merciful, but is less self-assured than she pretends.

63200063.name: Enviska Card
63200063.desc: A Sylvain who prevented Rohendel's Magick Eruption long ago. Infused with powerful magick.

63200064.name: Lumerus Card
63200064.desc: Guardian Luen stays in the thick fog and tests the adventurers who appear before them with a brilliant light.

63200065.name: Ur'nil Card
63200065.desc: Ur'nil, fortified by sturdy armor, ravages the enemy with its relentless front paws.

63200067.name: Calventus Card
63200067.desc: The fierce frenzy of Calventus covers the whole area in darkness, threatening the existence of all.

63200068.name: Lava Chromanium Card
63200068.desc: There is a crack in the back of a Lava Chromanium where hot lava flows. Smoke and flames leak from the gap.

63200069.name: Armored Nacrasena Card
63200069.desc: Armored Nacrasena transforms its tail into a deadly mace and uses it for attacks. It has the power to destroy everything around it in an instant.

63200070.name: Flame Fox Yoho Card
63200070.desc: The breath of fire emanating from Flame Fox Yoho burns everything in its path.

63200071.name: Frost Helgaia Card
63200071.desc: Frost Helgaia, covered with flame so cold it burns, uses a powerful icy breath to steal away the warmth of all living things.

63200072.name: Tytalos Card
63200072.desc: The fierce and enormous Tytalos, with its Sandstone Claws, appears among the sands of the desert and strikes fear into the hearts of those who see it.

63200073.name: Night Fox Yoho Card
63200073.desc: If a person is seduced by the mysterious light from a starlight-covered tail, they will be attacked by the cruel claws hidden in it.

63200074.name: Velganos Card
63200074.desc: Velganos, who wields the power of light and darkness, judges the enemy with righteous fury.

63200075.name: Caliligos Card
63200075.desc: Caliligos is the master of lightning. This ancient being commands blue lightning bolts and uses them to bring his enemies to their knees.

63200076.name: Achates Card
63200076.desc: After the war, Achates, who was still asleep in the land beyond the clouds, awakened again after feeling dimensional vibrations echo across Arkesia.

63200077.name: Igrexion Card
63200077.desc: Igrexion, the Doom Predator, rapidly destroys everything they perceive as an enemy.

63200078.name: Mystic Card
63200078.desc: Guardian Mystic, known as the Ark Carrier and the Herald of Vairgrys, became overwhelmed by the power of chaos, creating mists that seethed with hatred.

63200079.name: Kaishuter Card
63200079.desc: Kaishuter, the Hellfire Annihilator that commanded the Chaos Guardians, tore through the sky of Arkesia, alight with wild flames.

63200080.name: Alberhastic Card
63200080.desc: Alberhastic appeared in Arkesia with the Spear of Agony, to serve as fate's arbiter.

63200081.name: Alaric Card
63200081.desc: A neutral Guardian who guards the Gate of Paradise. After the war ended, it made a great sanctuary in the sea and has protected the Final Truth of the Light.

63200082.name: Fjorgin Card
63200082.desc: The all-purpose magick hammer used by Sidereal Galatur. Now Balthorr, his successor, has begun to follow in his footsteps.

63200083.name: Perkunas Card
63200083.desc: The bow given to the greatest Lazenith warrior of each generation. Its name means god's fury.

63200084.name: Navinos Card
63200084.desc: The sword of Kadan, the first Guardian Slayer. No matter how many foes you cut down, the blade remains sharp and deadly.

63200085.name: Ark of Trust Asta Card
63200085.desc: The Ark of Trust, hidden by Sidereal Luterra.

63200086.name: Ark of Creation Ortuus Card
63200086.desc: The Ark of Creation, hidden by Sidereal Nineveh.

63200087.name: Ark of Prescience Agaton Card
63200087.desc: The Ark of Prescience, hidden by Sidereal Galatur.

63200088.name: Ark of Hope Elpon Card
63200088.desc: The Ark of Hope, hidden by Sidereal Shandi.

63200089.name: Ark of Wisdom Ratik Card
63200089.desc: The Ark of Wisdom, hidden by Sidereal Azena and Inanna.

63200090.name: Ark of Devotion Karta Card
63200090.desc: The Ark of Devotion, hidden by Sidereal Sien.

63200091.name: Ezrebet Card
63200091.desc: The mistress of Atalanta Keep, built on Sublime Isle. She's throwing a party that hides many secrets.

63200092.name: Krissa Card
63200092.desc: A Specialist of Arthetine who was hired to infiltrate Sublime Isle. Currently keeping an eye on Ezrebet.

63200093.name: Calvasus Card
63200093.desc: One of the four pirates who reigns over the seas. He is a broad-minded, middle-aged man.

63200094.name: Varut Card
63200094.desc: A gentle priest at the Prideholme Cathedral. A member of the Sacrian Order and one of the Dawn Priests who support Archon Gustaven.

63200095.name: Prideholme Neria Card
63200095.desc: A kind, cheerful girl who works at the Prideholme tavern and likes to cook.

63200096.name: Rudric Card
63200096.desc: The priest who turned to heresy and was corrupted by demonic power. Now that he's dead, he hates and attacks everything that lives.

63200097.name: Ugo Card
63200097.desc: The leader of the Toxiclaw Robbers. He can summon rare beasts and is secretly in league with Kharmine.

63200098.name: Velkan Card
63200098.desc: Velkan is an ancient beast that was sealed away by the gods for its endless voracity. After the seal keeping it at bay broke, Velkan returned to Arkesia.

63200099.name: Plaguebringer Card
63200099.desc: A member of the Plague Legion that snuck into Rethramis who is spreading a plague in Aquilok's Head.

63200100.name: Harzal Card
63200100.desc: A bionic weapon consisting of different parts from different creatures. Its gigantic body hosts all kinds of terrible contagions.

63200101.name: Salt Giant Card
63200101.desc: A giant made of salt. It swings its heavy fists at any who oppose it.

63200102.name: Thunder Card
63200102.desc: A nomad priestess who worships the sky. She can perform a ritual to appeal to the sky and make it rain.

63200103.name: Celedan Card
63200103.desc: Kharmine's henchman, who's conducting dangerous research in Sapira Cave.

63200104.name: Meehan Card
63200104.desc: The lord of Mount Zagoras. He's fiercely loyal to Thirain.

63200105.name: Rictus Card
63200105.desc: A Demon in the form of an agile, ferocious wolf. He's the right hand of Valtan, the commander of the Demon Beast Legion.

63200106.name: Cassleford Card
63200106.desc: An experienced and stately knight. Thirain's reliable supporter.

63200107.name: Rovlen Card
63200107.desc: This plant has been mutated by demonic energy. It devours everything around it.

63200108.name: Alifer Card
63200108.desc: An easygoing spirit that lives near Elzowin. It is always hungry and loves to eat delicious things.

63200109.name: Luterra Castle Neria Card
63200109.desc: The cheerful, friendly mistress of the Luterra tavern. She excels at playing musical instruments and always plays joyful tunes for her customers.

63200110.name: Wili-Wili Card
63200110.desc: An innocent pumpkin on Sunbright Hill that has turned into a manifestation of the anger of the murdered dead.

63200111.name: Seria Card
63200111.desc: A kind, goodhearted member of the Sacrian Order. She takes care of those who have been attacked.

63200112.name: Heretic High Priest Card
63200112.desc: The high priest of the cult worshipping the Mayhem Demons that spread throughout the East Luterra. He's trying to summon the commander of the Mayhem Legion.

63200113.name: Jahia Card
63200113.desc: A Water Elemental that protects the Leyar Terrace. Gracious and generous.

63200114.name: Ligheas Card
63200114.desc: A Water Elemental that protects the Leyar Terrace. Firm and stern.

63200115.name: Halrock Card
63200115.desc: The Lord of Borea Fortress, who fights bravely against the Demons.

63200116.name: Cals Card
63200116.desc: The eldest son of the Moronto Family and the lord of Wavestrand Port. Pretentious and arrogant, having been made lord at a young age.

63200117.name: Hiebike Card
63200117.desc: The violent, hot-tempered staff captain of the Redfin Pirates. He wants to kill Blackfang in Luterra Port for the sake of his own glory.

63200118.name: Nox Card
63200118.desc: A Redfin Pirate carrying a big cannon on his shoulder. He's guarding their booty from Stormcry Grotto.

63200119.name: Setino Card
63200119.desc: The sly, cowardly staff captain of the Redfin Pirates. Other pirates call him a coward for his cautious personality.

63200120.name: Totoma Card
63200120.desc: The benevolent chief of Mokoko Village. He struggles to protect his people against the pirate invasion.

63200121.name: Hybee Executioner Card
63200121.desc: A Hybee executioner that lives in Sweetwater Forest. It mercilessly attacks anyone who invades their nest.

63200122.name: Guardian Eolh Card
63200122.desc: A Guardian of Tortoyk's Heart. They woke from their slumber within the stone to conduct the Guardian's Test.

63200123.name: Ed the Red Card
63200123.desc: The sly, insidious captain of the Redfin Pirates. He wants Tortoyk's Ark to lift the curse that turned him into a Merpirate.

63200124.name: Guardian Tir Card
63200124.desc: A Guardian of Tortoyk's Heart. They appear as a giant rock and crush those who are unworthy.

63200125.name: Caspiel the Giant God Card
63200125.desc: A divine being who has been protecting Tortoyk's forest for a long time. It mercilessly attacks those who dare throw Tortoyk into chaos.

63200126.name: Ark Guardian Occel Card
63200126.desc: The Guardian who protects the Ark that lies asleep inside Tortoyk. They use the power of waves to test adventurers.

63200127.name: Pahan Card
63200127.desc: The leader of the Yeon Clan. He values humanity and justice, and tries his best to protect them at all costs.

63200128.name: Manpo Card
63200128.desc: The 8th Sword of Changhun. Also the owner of a dumpling store. Uses a martial art called Changhun Dumpling Fist.

63200129.name: Miru Card
63200129.desc: The fiend who killed the martial artist appointed as the 7th Sword of Changhun and took the seat. Kills residents and eats their livers to become a Human.

63200130.name: Wonpho Card
63200130.desc: The 4th Sword of Changhun. He belonged to the Yeon Clan, but crossed a line he should not have in order to cure his wife.

63200131.name: Gildal Card
63200131.desc: The 3rd Sword of Changhun in the Changhun Tournament and disciple of Sir Druden. Excels at transforming into a monstrous bird, but he departed before he could learn other skills.

63200132.name: Rekiel of Despair Card
63200132.desc: An underling of Vykas who attacks like she is dancing. She truly believes in her own beauty and is full of confidence.

63200133.name: Plague Legion Varto Card
63200133.desc: A Demon serving Akkan, the commander of the Plague Legion. He seeks the Ark to make Akkan's body complete again.

63200134.name: Dochul Card
63200134.desc: The immortal fiend that once threw Anikka into chaos. Early on, Sidereal Sien sealed the immortal Dochul within his own left arm and used its powers to protect the world.

63200135.name: Chaotic Chuo Card
63200135.desc: The sacred creature that has protected the peace of Anikka and prevented disasters since ancient times. It was devoured by the evil energy that it tried to fight off.

63200136.name: Stern Neria Card
63200136.desc: She's called Stern's prima donna. Many people come to Stern just to listen to Neria sing.

63200137.name: Signatus Card
63200137.desc: A massive mechanical weapon created by Arthetine's most cutting-edge technology. It uses its AI to locate enemies and attacks them with absolute ruthlessness.

63200138.name: S Card
63200138.desc: One of Technologist Krause's Personal Guards. He experimented on himself to study physical augmentation. Most of his body parts have been replaced with mechanical components. He cares about his twin brother, J, more than anything in the world.

63200139.name: J Card
63200139.desc: One of Technologist Krause's Personal Guards. A colleague of Dr. Bergstrom. Most of his body parts have been replaced with mechanical components. He cares about his twin brother, S, more than anything in the world.

63200140.name: Anton Card
63200140.desc: One of Technologist Krause's Personal Guards. A stubborn, conservative Cykin who became deeply influenced by Krause's plan to activate the Verdantier.

63200141.name: Vrad Card
63200141.desc: A prisoner broker of Shushire. He's amassed an enormous fortune, owns the Red Curtain Arena, and is now colluding with Demons.

63200142.name: Tarsila Card
63200142.desc: The beautiful queen of the Frost Spiders. She's territorial and has a voracious appetite for living prey.

63200143.name: Ruave Card
63200143.desc: A member of the Plague Legion charged with delivering Shushire prisoners to Akkan.

63200144.name: Sian Card
63200144.desc: A servant of Sirius. After receiving an edict from his god, he headed out to the Red Curtain Arena to defend Shushire against Demons.

63200145.name: Maneth Card
63200145.desc: A warrior who fought Demons during the Chain War. In the end, their evil energy encroached upon his spirit and turned him into a mindless specter.

63200146.name: Gideon Card
63200146.desc: The master of the Adventurer's Guild. He was appointed the Guildmaster after solving various quests in North Vern in his younger days. He has a reputation for loyalty and magnanimity among the people of the north.

63200147.name: Garum Card
63200147.desc: A creation of Necromancer Sigmund, who destroyed the Knights of Vern a hundred years ago. It woke up from a long slumber alongside its master.

63200148.name: Payla Card
63200148.desc: A member of the Balankar Rangers that protect North Vern. He's after the Demon Beast Gorgon to avenge his fellow rangers.

63200149.name: Gorgon Card
63200149.desc: A Demon beast created through necromantic experiments. It constantly craves lives to feed on.

63200150.name: Proxima Card
63200150.desc: A plant that fed on dark energy. It developed a taste for Human flesh as it grew.

63200151.name: Erasmo Card
63200151.desc: A mysterious creature living in the depths of the ocean. Rumor has it that it only reveals itself when certain conditions are met.

63200152.name: Tooki King Card
63200152.desc: The King of the Tookies. He resides on Tooki Island and spends his time gloating over the treasures that his subjects have gathered.

63200153.name: Brealeos Card
63200153.desc: The energy residue of the historical clash between Sirius, the God of Frost, and the Flame Legion, now given life and form.

63200154.name: Kagros Card
63200154.desc: A beast that broke out of a giant egg. It attacks enemies with hundreds of worms that grow on its body.

63200155.name: Sea God Aporas Card
63200155.desc: A mysterious creature that guards Oblivion Isle. It uses deep-sea water to attack enemies.

63200156.name: Tarmakum Card
63200156.desc: Dr. Bergstrom tried to secretly create this test subject with the Remnants of Power. It is ferocious and aggressive.

63200157.name: Sol Grande Card
63200157.desc: A massive mechanical weapon that can be found in Alteisen. It ruthlessly attacks enemies.

63200158.name: Lenora Card
63200158.desc: A mage who wanders Rohendel. She has the power to read Memories of Earth.

63200159.name: Aven Card
63200159.desc: A weird wizard who got kicked out of Dawnkeep. Curious and cheerful.

63200161.name: Orelda Card
63200161.desc: A clever young mage from Rohendel.

63200162.name: Phantom Queen Card
63200162.desc: A creature created by Brelshaza in the Phantom Palace. It looks like a chess queen.

63200163.name: Phantom King Card
63200163.desc: A creature created by Brelshaza in the Phantom Palace. It looks like a chess king.

63200164.name: Great Castle Neria Card
63200164.desc: The most beautiful Umar woman. She can shatter a glass with her voice.

63200165.name: Piyer Card
63200165.desc: An Umar who like bombs. Confident and full of himself.

63200166.name: Nazan Card
63200166.desc: A Plague Legion Demon that was led by Velcruze to Yorn. Greedy and cruel.

63200167.name: Kyzra Card
63200167.desc: A Covetous Legion Demon that was led by Velcruze to Yorn. Glamorous and sexy.

63200168.name: Eikerr Card
63200168.desc: An ancestral Umar with great abilities. Appears in the form of a soul and helps in pursuing the Demonic Sword Velcruze.

63200169.name: Naber Card
63200169.desc: An ancestral Umar with great abilities. Appears in the form of a soul and helps in pursuing the Demonic Sword Velcruze.

63200170.name: Levi Card
63200170.desc: A new member of Avesta, Feiton's Order of Assassins. Bright and cheerful.

63200171.name: Goulding Card
63200171.desc: An acerbic Avesta member who complains a lot. A good person, though.

63200172.name: Geppetto Card
63200172.desc: An Avesta member corrupted by darkness.

63200173.name: Admos Card
63200173.desc: A Demon of the Darkness Legion.

63200174.name: Bergstrom Card
63200174.desc: A scientist who was driven to madness by the Ruby Eye.

63200175.name: Vanquisher Card
63200175.desc: A mysterious sword that responds only to those with the qualities of a king. It has the ability to augment the blade with the fighting spirit of the wielder.

63200176.name: Spear of Annihilation Card
63200176.desc: A weapon made from transforming Shandi's Sidereal weapon "Annihilation" into a spear. It is said that the shape changes according to the ability of the wielder.

63200177.name: Wavestrand Port Neria Card
63200177.desc: A woman who works at a tavern in Wavestrand Port. She's absolutely unforgettable.

63200178.name: Abyssina Card
63200178.desc: The last queen of Encavia. Her husband Kisar's addiction to dark magick forever troubled her, but she was unable to stop what befell him.

63200179.name: Puppa Card
63200179.desc: A giant panda that lives on an island. He likes bamboo and can roll like a ball.

63200180.name: Samly Card
63200180.desc: A polar bear that lives on a glacier. She met Orzo while grieving her lost mother.

63200181.name: Knut Card
63200181.desc: A giant monster, known long ago as the Nightmare of the Sea. Necromantic power has restored it to life, and it follows the orders of the pirate Narkiel.

63200182.name: Adrinne Card
63200182.desc: The commander that led the knights of Rohendel through the Chain War. Despite her prowess and honor, she was robbed of her memories by Brelshaza and is cursed to wander as a Demon through Phantomwing Island.

63200183.name: Vengeful Spirit Card
63200183.desc: The angry spirit of a woman. She roams Rethramis, seeking revenge.

63200184.name: Dadan Card
63200184.desc: The leader of a bandit group. He's taken over the saltern to support his crew by selling salt. He punishes any who oppose him.

63200185.name: Giant Worm Card
63200185.desc: An ancient creature living in a barren land. It absorbs nutrients while wandering through the ground, digging tunnels.

63200186.name: Urr Card
63200186.desc: An Umar blacksmith in Lakebar. Just a touch of his hammer can turn an ordinary weapon into a masterpiece.

63200187.name: Benard Card
63200187.desc: A nobleman who has served Luterra's Royal Family for a long time. As Thirain's uncle, he's stood against Regent Scherrit since he was young.

63200188.name: Cadogan Card
63200188.desc: The captain of Scherrit's army, a knight who will do anything he is ordered to do.

63200189.name: Monterque Card
63200189.desc: An incorruptible and aggressive nobleman who governs the Dyorika Plain. He's a descendant of the mage Nahun.

63200190.name: Bishu Card
63200190.desc: A careful and quiet nobleman. As a descendant of the mage Nahun, he governs the Dyorika Plain.

63200191.name: Berhart Card
63200191.desc: Regent Scherrit's son. He's waiting for a chance to get back at Thirain, who ascended to the throne.

63200192.name: Brinewt Card
63200192.desc: A Puruu who has succumbed to the Power of Mayhem. He once was known as the best of all Puruu warriors.

63200193.name: Azaran Card
63200193.desc: The Borea Fortress's archer captain who never misses her target.

63200194.name: Gabrian Card
63200194.desc: The Borea Fortress's charger captain who's magnanimous and easy-going.

63200195.name: Executor Solas Card
63200195.desc: A coldhearted executioner from the Sacrian Order. He made an irreversible mistake, punishing the wrong people for heresy.

63200196.name: Totoiki Card
63200196.desc: A being that raises the Eggs of Creation formed within Tortoyk's body. It runs around constantly, trying to catch the unruly eggs.

63200197.name: Egg of Creation Card
63200197.desc: A mysterious egg created inside Tortoyk's body. All kinds of lives are hatched from them.

63200198.name: Guardian Peroth Card
63200198.desc: A Guardian who protects the inside of Tortoyk. They use their blazing sword to test those who challenge them.

63200199.name: Yuul Card
63200199.desc: A member of the staff in charge of the Changhun Tournament. Because of her interest in martial arts, she's extremely invested in the tournament.

63200200.name: Hari Card
63200200.desc: The 9th Sword of Changhun. She's a skilled fighter who studied under Yahara.

63200201.name: Onehand Card
63200201.desc: The 6th Sword of Changhun. Uses an Arthetine-made mechanical arm to perform destructive attacks.

63200202.name: Hodon Card
63200202.desc: A second son of the Jeok Clan and the 5th Sword of Changhun. He took on the Grand Master's Trial and colluded with Demons to win the title of Grand Master.

63200203.name: Gumga Card
63200203.desc: The 2nd Sword of Changhun. The legendary martial artist once dominated Anikka like he now dominates the martial arts tournament.

63200204.name: Sakkul Card
63200204.desc: An underling of the nine-tailed fox, Miru, and a fiend that's collecting souls to create soul orbs. She commands two snakes.

63200205.name: Sir Druden Card
63200205.desc: A master of Anikka who loves alcohol. Adept at various schools of magick, he's abandoned his body and possessed a painting to fight fiends.

63200206.name: Sir Valleylead Card
63200206.desc: A taciturn Master of Anikka. Skilled with the power of wind, he was the first one in Anikka to notice the energy of the Demons invading the continent.

63200207.name: Seville Card
63200207.desc: One of Technologist Krause's Personal Guards. An extremist who has complete faith in Krause. Knowledgeable in chemistry and good with firearms.

63200208.name: Commander Sol Card
63200208.desc: A giant machine that commands the Machine Legion on Krause's behalf. It tried to stop the Regulators from interfering with the activation of the Verdantier.

63200209.name: Javern Card
63200209.desc: The vice-captain of the prisoner liberation group, the Daybreakers. A coolheaded and meticulous leader.

63200210.name: Ramis Card
63200210.desc: A small, optimistic boy in Shushire. He lost his father to the prison fights early on, and is living only with his mother.

63200211.name: Nakshun Card
63200211.desc: A priest who joined the ranks of the Demons in the Plague Legion. Once a servant of Sirius, he became resentful of his god and turned to the Demons.

63200212.name: Poppy Card
63200212.desc: A gray wolf from Shushire. He joined Graymoon with his friend, Dietrich, to fight against the Demons.

63200213.name: Butcher Arre Card
63200213.desc: A member of the Plague Legion. His stammering belies his predilection for carnage and Human flesh.

63200214.name: Navegal Card
63200214.desc: A knight who died during a battle with Sigmund a hundred years ago. The enemy's necromancy has brought him back to life to wreak havoc on the Fesnar Highland.

63200215.name: Lena Card
63200215.desc: A lively girl who lives on Starlight Isle. She wants to find her mother's memories for her father, Favreau.

63200216.name: Favreau Card
63200216.desc: The starkeeper on Starlight Isle. He plays the piano to help lost souls find their way to the afterlife.

63200217.name: Zenri Card
63200217.desc: A man desperate to start a nightclub. His odd habits sometimes perplex people.

63200218.name: Mikeel and Nomed Card
63200218.desc: Father Mikeel met Nomed when he was young, and they quickly became inseparable.

63200219.name: Phantom Knight Card
63200219.desc: A creature created by Brelshaza in the Phantom Palace. It looks like a chess knight.

63200220.name: Phantom Rook Card
63200220.desc: A creature created by Brelshaza in the Phantom Palace. It looks like a chess rook.

63200221.name: Phantom Bishop Card
63200221.desc: A creature created by Brelshaza in the Phantom Palace. It looks like a chess bishop.

63200222.name: Siera Card
63200222.desc: A bard who lives in Prideholme.

63200223.name: Rubenstein del Orzo Card
63200223.desc: A musician who plays the piano on Glacier Isle. Calm and quiet.

63200224.name: Imar Card
63200224.desc: A lively Umar who serves as a dancer for Neria.

63200225.name: Lutia Card
63200225.desc: A Firekeeper that burns Chaos Shards and appeases the spirits of fallen Delains.

63200226.name: Morpheo Card
63200226.desc: An old woman who lives in an orchard of pear trees. She has a warm heart.

63200227.name: Morina Card
63200227.desc: A young woman in Yudia who is trying to become a shaman.

63200228.name: Madam Moonscent Card
63200228.desc: One of the three masters of Anikka. She leads the Scrollmaidens.

63200229.name: Dakudaku Card
63200229.desc: A Mokoko with a strong sense of responsibility who lives in Mokoko Village. He loves his family.

63200230.name: Temma Card
63200230.desc: A treasure seeker who remained on an island after her ship was wrecked.

63200231.name: Tanay Card
63200231.desc: A girl who performs a magic show on the Peyto. She loves a standing ovation.

63200232.name: Gobius XXIV Card
63200232.desc: The dethroned king of Goblins, renowned for his merciful reign. He lives for excitement and opulent things.

63200233.name: Zeira Card
63200233.desc: A writer who crafts covert novels based on rumors.

63200234.name: Riwella Card
63200234.desc: A knight who hails from Freyad Village. Terse but kindhearted, she fights alongside Thirain for Luterra.

63200235.name: Vivian Card
63200235.desc: An employee at Neria's Tavern in Luterra Castle. She wants to be as successful as Neria, someday.

63200236.name: Kranterus Card
63200236.desc: A hulking Demon in the Mayhem Legion. Its body is covered with the scars of mind-wiping experiments and torture inflected on it by the Mayhem Legion.

63200237.name: Mephitious Card
63200237.desc: A mid-level Demon summoned by the Mayhem Legion. The Legion used Mephitious to gain air supremacy during its invasion of Borea's Domain.

63200238.name: Naruni Card
63200238.desc: A cute pet of the Mokokos in Tortoyk. Its name, Naruni, is coined from its mewling sound.

63200239.name: Lion Mask Card
63200239.desc: The Lion Mask used in the Battle of the Lions in Changhun. It represents an animal that defeated disaster long ago.

63200240.name: Goblin Elder Balu Card
63200240.desc: An elder who leads the Goblins in Parna Forest. He lives in a Goblin village while guarding Parna, the holy tree.

63200241.name: Ternark Card
63200241.desc: A knight who died during a battle with Sigmund a hundred years ago. The enemy's necromancy brought him back as a mindless ghost, but he regained his sanity through sheer willpower.

63200242.name: Cadri Card
63200242.desc: A traveler that wants to take photos of every wonderful place he visits.

63200243.name: Turan Card
63200243.desc: A Bambiri girl who's clever and cute.

63200244.name: Chamkuri Card
63200244.desc: A cute animal used as a mount in Rohendel.

63200245.name: Phantom Pawn Card
63200245.desc: A creature created by Brelshaza in the Phantom Palace. It looks like a chess pawn.

63200246.name: Telpa Card
63200246.desc: A race that lives in Yorn. They like shiny things, so they often quarrel with Umars.

63200247.name: Indar Card
63200247.desc: An Umar who manages the Wonderful Brewery. Funny and loves to drink.

63200248.name: Chella Card
63200248.desc: A young Delain girl who lives apart from her brother, Levi.

63200249.name: Nabi Card
63200249.desc: A street cat living in Kalaja.

63200250.name: Demetar Card
63200250.desc: A Sacrian priest. He is a stern and responsible leader.

63200251.name: Tookalibur Card
63200251.desc: The legendary sacred sword that was handed down to Tookies since ancient times. The one who pulls this sword will be the Tookiest Tooki.

63200252.name: Bellita Card
63200252.desc: A whalekeeper who is very generous and cares a great deal about those around her.

63200253.name: Neth Card
63200253.desc: A bright and straightforward Goblin woman.

63200254.name: Pamil Card
63200254.desc: A woman who teaches the children on Runaways Island. She came to the village due to Scherrit's tyranny.

63200255.name: Yom Card
63200255.desc: A charming squirrel from Whispering Islet. He likes to sing and is active in the choir.

63200256.name: Sapiano Card
63200256.desc: A red fox from Whispering Islet. They have a bold personality and lovely purple hair.

63200257.name: Mathias Card
63200257.desc: A reporter in Arthetine. He has an amiable personality and is always looking for a scoop.

63200300.name: Nia Card
63200300.desc: A bright, cheerful Punikan girl who works hard to be a good chief.

63200301.name: Shana Card
63200301.desc: A mysterious girl who was raised by the previous chief. Like a sister to Nia.

63200302.name: Jahara Card
63200302.desc: A historian in Punika. Not very good with new people.

63200303.name: Liru Card
63200303.desc: The militia leader whose stunning combat skills make her renowned in Punika.

63200304.name: Nagi Card
63200304.desc: A kind-hearted and gentle healer who lives in Punika.

63200305.name: Albion Card
63200305.desc: The Solar Guardian, who led the Sidereals to Elgacia in the past.

63200306.name: Berver Card
63200306.desc: A free spirit who wanders the world with nothing but an instrument.

63200307.name: Hariya Card
63200307.desc: A kind woman who takes care of Nia.

63200308.name: Seto Card
63200308.desc: An insidious and grotesque Demon of the Mayhem Legion. He's seeking the hidden treasure in Punika.

63200309.name: Cicerra Card
63200309.desc: A cruel and violent Mayhem Legion Demon who invaded Punika.

63200310.name: Stella Card
63200310.desc: A dismal and bewitching Demon of the Mayhem Legion. Has the ability to disturb others.

63200311.name: Weakened Kakul-Saydon Card
63200311.desc: Kakul-Saydon, who lost most of his power after the events in East Luterra.

63200312.name: Argos Card
63200312.desc: The Chaos Guardian that attempted to destroy Punika long ago.

63200400.name: Deskaluda Card
63200400.desc: Deskaluda, the Guardian who chases death, soars into the sky on its magnificent wings and annihilates everything.

63200401.name: Haiger Card
63200401.desc: Grand Secretary of Vern's Senate. He rules over Candaria Territory, a rich area of land in the south.

63200402.name: Lujean Card
63200402.desc: Commander of the Black Knights in South Vern. He is ominous and always armed.

63200403.name: Xereon Card
63200403.desc: A former mage of the Solar Knights. He was in the Adventurer's Guild until just recently.

63200404.name: Vern Zenlord Card
63200404.desc: One of Carpus's Zenlords. She is in charge of Vern. Cold and calculating, she is famous for turning debt into profit.

63200405.name: Candaria Neria Card
63200405.desc: Neria from South Vern. She collects antiques as a hobby.

63200406.name: Cindy Card
63200406.desc: A charming child who adores Sidereal Kadan. Recently moved to Vern from a small island called Isteri.

63200407.name: Satra Card
63200407.desc: Deputy Speaker of Vern's Senate. She hails from Voldis and is known for her brilliance.

63200408.name: Killian Card
63200408.desc: A Black Knight. He serves as Commander Lujean's adjutant and favors a scythe in battle.

63200409.name: Gillock Card
63200409.desc: One of the elders who lead the Orcs in Vern. Recently migrated to South Vern with his followers.

63200410.name: Ludwig Card
63200410.desc: Head mage of the Solar Knights. He has been living quietly ever since they disbanded.

63200411.name: Alberto Card
63200411.desc: President of Vern's Senate. He played a large role in expanding the south's influence through trade.

63200412.name: Kiessa Card
63200412.desc: A former Sylvain of the Solar Knights. Excels at providing ranged support to her allies with her archery skills.

63200413.name: Hartem Card
63200413.desc: A former Sylvain of the Solar Knights. Employs a sword-fighting style that makes use of his great strength.

63200414.name: Kungelanium Card
63200414.desc: Kungelanium, the frost predator, wields the frost winds at will, mercilessly destroying everything around him.

63200415.name: Papa Card
63200415.desc: Sidereal Nineveh's eagle. It can hear Nineveh's voice from miles away.

63200416.name: Hanumatan Card
63200416.desc: Solar Guardian Hanumatan, who is hallowed in Anikka. The martial artists of Anikka followed Hanumatan's movements to develop a martial art.

63200500.name: Myun Hidaka Card
63200500.desc: The leader of the Wolves of Vengeance. Hidaka's enormous axe crushes anything that stands in their way.

63200501.name: Osphere Card
63200501.desc: A Sacrian Holy Knight dispatched to Rowen. He has been steeped in Sacrian doctrine since his youth.

63200502.name: Danika Card
63200502.desc: The Boulder Warrior, one of the strongest Tarunian warriors. She fires a bow as long as she is tall.

63200503.name: Arno Card
63200503.desc: A legendary mercenary from Vern. He founded the Ironblood Mercenaries, one of Eliyabeck's major factions, and still leads it to this day.

63200504.name: Baskia Card
63200504.desc: The fierce and charismatic captain of the Violetblade Pirates. He does not easily forgive those who cross him.

63200505.name: Sylus Card
63200505.desc: A renowned Arkesian archaeologist and treasure hunter. He wanders the world, exploring its many mysteries.

63200506.name: Rowen Zenlord Card
63200506.desc: One of Carpus' Zenlords. A bold, meticulous strategist in charge of Rowen.

63200507.name: Anke Card
63200507.desc: Top researcher of Arthetine's secret organization, Aris. With her genius mind, she leads the Rowen branch.

63200508.name: Piela Card
63200508.desc: Waning Moonkeep Vice Tower Keeper. She settled in Rowen following the Xeneela tragedy during the Chain War.

63200509.name: Wilhelm Card
63200509.desc: Sacrian Archbishop. He is widely acclaimed for his vast knowledge and understanding of both doctrine and faith.

63200510.name: Revellos Card
63200510.desc: Sacrian Dispatch Commander, currently residing in Rowen. A renowned and diligent Holy Knight.

63200511.name: Hanun Card
63200511.desc: One of the Wolves of Vengeance and Marinna's younger sibling. Never forgets a betrayal.

63200512.name: Marinna Card
63200512.desc: One of the Wolves of Vengeance and Hanun's older sister. Always maintains a calm disposition and analyzes the situation.

63200600.name: Lauriel Card
63200600.desc: The leader of the Swords of the Lazeniths in Elgacia. He has a gentle and benevolent personality and is respected by all of the Lazeniths.

63200601.name: Azakiel Card
63200601.desc: One of the Swords of the Lazeniths. They are in charge of record-keeping and education, and manage the Library of Honor.

63200602.name: Belomet Card
63200602.desc: One of the three Prophets who receive divine messages, capable of weaving prophecies and seeing into the near future.

63200603.name: Diogenes Card
63200603.desc: One of the Swords of the Lazeniths in Elgacia. They disappeared while investigating an incident long ago. Their whereabouts are still unknown.

63200604.name: Dyna Card
63200604.desc: An ancient being who has finally awakened. They are known to travel with the gentle breeze.

63200605.name: Prunya Card
63200605.desc: One of the Swords of the Lazeniths in Elgacia. They are in charge of order and regulations, and they have a cool and tranquil charisma.

63200606.name: Tienis Card
63200606.desc: One of the Swords of the Lazeniths in Elgacia. They have a serious personality and are skilled with a giant greatsword.

63200607.name: Euclid Card
63200607.desc: One of the three Prophets who receive divine messages, capable of weaving prophecies and seeing into the present.

63200608.name: Kirke Card
63200608.desc: One of the three Prophets who receive divine messages, capable of weaving prophecies and seeing into the past.

63200609.name: Sky Whale Card
63200609.desc: A giant whale that flies through the sky. Witnessing it even once is thought to bring great fortune.

63200610.name: Great Celestial Serpent Card
63200610.desc: A mysterious creature of the heavens. The Lazeniths read the flow of the winds by observing its movements.

63200611.name: Cahni Card
63200611.desc: A mysterious animal that is commonly seen in Elgacia. It lives on flowers and has cute little horns.

63200612.name: Ark of Eternity Kayangel Card
63200612.desc: The Ark that was hidden by Sidereal Kadan. It symbolizes eternity.

63200613.name: Vairgrys Card
63200613.desc: The first Guardian and leader of the Solar Guardians. They were born by combining the order of Regulus and the chaos of Zosma.

63200620.name: Sonavel Card
63200620.desc: An ancient creature, Sonavel is adept at harnessing powers of all elements.

63200621.name: Gargadeth Card
63200621.desc: A voracious predator that devours all life. It harnesses the power of thunder through the floating artifact above its head.

63200700.name: Young Armen Card
63200700.desc: Armen in his childhood. He looks happy to be with his loving mother.

63200701.name: Claudia Card
63200701.desc: Benevolent Priest of Sacria. She serves the light, and became a priest to save the sick and weary.

63200702.name: Alfonso Vediche Card
63200702.desc: The head of the Pleccia family and patron of the arts. He has an excellent eye for art.

63200703.name: Zakra Card
63200703.desc: An elder from Rimeria and a renowned master of illusion skills. She may be eccentric, but she is extremely skilled.

63200704.name: Bishop Antonio Card
63200704.desc: A priest under the jurisdiction of Sacria, dispatched to Pleccia. He contributed greatly to the completion of the Ignis Cathedral.

63200705.name: Rosaline Vediche Card
63200705.desc: The granddaughter of Alfonso Vediche and one of Armen's oldest friends. She's as beautiful as she is kind.

63200800.name: Varkan Card
63200800.desc: A Guardian that leads Chaos Guardians. In the past, they abandoned Vairgrys and left for Petrania.

63200801.name: Zeherade Card
63200801.desc: A mysterious figure you encountered in Kalinar. Takes a special interest in homunculi.

63200802.name: Mariu Card
63200802.desc: An aspiring sage from Raiya. Highly talented at crafting homunculi.

63200803.name: Behemoth Card
63200803.desc: A Chaos Guardian who follows Varkan. They were an infamous symbol of terror during the Chain War.

63200804.name: Isaac Card
63200804.desc: A High Sage of Voldis. As head of the sages, he led the development of Voldis alongside the great sage.

63200805.name: Marega Card
63200805.desc: A High Sage of Voldis. As the Guardian Lab Director, he has spent many years defending the Sage's Tower.

63200806.name: Kalinar Neria Card
63200806.desc: Neria of Kalinar. With her natural charisma and business acumen, she's a force to reckon with in the Kalinar Market District.

63200807.name: Lazaram Card
63200807.desc: A mysterious Guardian sealed in Area 81 of the Sage's Tower. They seem to harbor unfathomable powers.

63200808.name: Rakathus Card
63200808.desc: A Chaos Guardian awakened from its seal. Dormant since the Chain War, they were roused by someone's call.

63200809.name: Verad Card
63200809.desc: A sage of Voldis. Despite their gruff exterior, they are warm-hearted and knowledgeable.

63200810.name: Nilai Card
63200810.desc: A sage of Voldis. Once a renowned sage, he returned to his hometown to train his students.

63200811.name: Kaltaya Card
63200811.desc: A Chaos Guardian who follows Varkan. They maintain the cycle of life and death on a blooming bud.

63200812.name: Firehorn Card
63200812.desc: A Chaos Guardian who follows Varkan. They crush everything in its path with their devastating horns.

63200813.name: Veskal Card
63200813.desc: A Chaos Guardian who controls sonic waves. They loom in the shadows, waiting to ambush their prey.

63200900.name: Gemet Card
63200900.desc: An Assar Delain living in Kurzan. He appears indifferent, but is actually intelligent and prudent.

63200901.name: Nefer Card
63200901.desc: An Assar Delain living in Kurzan. He leads the remaining survivors, seeking opportunities.

63200902.name: Pehta Card
63200902.desc: An Assar Delain living in Kurzan. Her resolve remains unbroken even in the face of danger.

63200903.name: Kami Card
63200903.desc: A stray dog living in Elnead. Although scared and timid, it shows much affection towards those it becomes fond of.

63200904.name: Echidna Card
63200904.desc: Long thought to be dead, this individual concealed their whereabouts only to unexpectedly show up again.

63200905.name: Narkiel Card
63200905.desc: One of the four pirates who reigns over the seas. With a reputation for cruelty and a sinister demeanor, this pirate is adept in various magicks and curses.

63200906.name: Behemoth of Storm Card
63200906.desc: A Chaos Guardian who controls storms appeared in Kurzan, far more brutal and fierce than the one faced during the Chain War.

63201000.name: Resurrecting Kazeros Card
63201000.desc: The Archdemon who rules Petrania. Also known as the Abyss Lord.

63201001.name: Torn Valtan Card
63201001.desc: The soul of Valtan who lost himself. His body, which was mended by Akkan, has disintegrated and his inner being is consumed by a fierce rage.

63201002.name: Covetous Vykas Card
63201002.desc: The Covetous Legion Commander, who revealed her desires. A seductress to all, Vykas's mere presence causes eternal craving.

63201003.name: Dancing Kakul-Saydon Card
63201003.desc: Kakul-Saydon dressed as a clown. His nonstop jokes hide a sharp punch.

63201004.name: Rotten Akkan Card
63201004.desc: The Plague Legion Commander who rules the spirits. He used the power of corruption to spread the roots of the decaying Pandemonium in Arkesia.

63201005.name: Thaemine of Despair Card
63201005.desc: The Darkness Legion Commander of despair. He used his power to create Baratron which disrupts order and spreads darkness.

63201006.name: Nightmare Brelshaza Card
63201006.desc: The Phantom Legion Commander who removed the witch's horn that bound her. She gathered all the nightmares of the world and created Astalgia, the vast world of hallucinations.

63201007.name: Cunning Kharmine Card
63201007.desc: Kharmine, who wields the magick sword Velcruze. He acts cunningly with a hidden agenda.

63201008.name: Abyss Wanderer Card
63201008.desc: A vagabond in the abyss. He waits for someone to step into the darkness.

63201009.name: Gustaven Card
63201009.desc: The benevolent Archon of Sacria. He leads the Dawn Priests.

63201010.name: Valicio Card
63201010.desc: The hidden Archbishop of Sacria. A shrouded figure, records of him do not exist anywhere.

63201011.name: Awakened Zinnervale Card
63201011.desc: Zinnervale, who has finally perfected his illusions. He can now create countless clones.

63201012.name: Battle Commander Azena Card
63201012.desc: Azena, who has unleashed her full power and dominates the battlefield against countless Demons.

63201013.name: Nineveh, the Lazenith Leader Card
63201013.desc: Nineveh riding Albion. She leads the Lazeniths who have made their choice.

63201014.name: Kadan, the Relic Finder Card
63201014.desc: Kadan, who came to visit Kurzan. He has found the long-sought ruins of the Haals.

63201015.name: Supreme General Thirain Card
63201015.desc: Thirain, leader of the Allied Forces. He personally commands the coalition army gathered in Kurzan against the Demons.

63201016.name: Mission Captain Shandi Card
63201016.desc: Shandi, who is standing in front of the Kurzan operations board. He directs operations of the Allied Forces from the Field Command Office.

63201017.name: Balthorr, Wielder of Fjorgin Card
63201017.desc: Balthorr, who wields Fjorgin. He sweeps through Demons on the battlefield.

63201018.name: Dochul Wielder Wei Card
63201018.desc: Wei, who gained full mastery of Dochul. He learned the Esoteric Skills of the Sihwa School.

63201019.name: Chosen Armen Card
63201019.desc: Armen, who is determined to stop Kazeros. He's trying to unlock the power of the Lost Ark.

63201020.name: Dark Mountain Predator Card
63201020.desc: The assault leader of the Demon Beast Legion. He guards the Black Mountain of Petrania, the domain of the Demon Beast Legion.

63201021.name: Morphe Card
63201021.desc: A follower of Vykas. She charms the lost and sucks away their energy.

63201022.name: Mocking Kakul Card
63201022.desc: Kakul dressed as a clown. His novel weapons intimidate his opponents.

63201023.name: Sardonic Saydon Card
63201023.desc: Saydon dressed as a clown. His elaborate dance skills bewilder his opponents.

63201024.name: Primordial Nightmare Card
63201024.desc: A Nightmare that's been around since the beginning of time. It feeds on negative emotions to conceive the seeds of chaos.

63201025.name: Ashtarot Card
63201025.desc: A knight who protects Brelshaza. With her memories wiped, she blindly guards Phantom Astalgia.

63201026.name: Forbidden Disciple Valinak Card
63201026.desc: A Knight of Darkness who follows Thaemine. He is a powerful commander and a devastating vanguard.

63201027.name: Killineza the Dark Worshipper Card
63201027.desc: A Knight of Darkness who follows Thaemine. She blindly worships Thaemine for sharing her darkness.

63201028.name: Griefbringer Maurug Card
63201028.desc: A minion of the Plague Legion Commander. He spreads the energy of the Lord of Degradation and Decay around him.

63201029.name: Ren Card
63201029.desc: A Delain who has mastered controlling Sylmael. She is the daughter of Tamut, the leader of the Assar.

63201030.name: Argeos Card
63201030.desc: A Guardian who chose Chaos in the fated moment. The decision would change them forever.

63201031.name: Skolakia Card
63201031.desc: A Guardian who chose Chaos in the fated moment. The decision would change them forever.

63201032.name: Leader Lugaru Card
63201032.desc: A Demon who guards the Black Mountain of Petrania. He commands the Demon Beasts with cold judgment.

63201033.name: Destroyer Lucas Card
63201033.desc: A Demon who guards the Black Mountain of Petrania. He crushes his enemies with attacks that utilize his speed to pulverize them.

63201034.name: Nightmare Gehenna Card
63201034.desc: The twin Demons of the Phantom Legion. Trusting no one, only Gehenna and Helkasirs have each other's backs.

63201035.name: Nightmare Helkasirs Card
63201035.desc: The twin Demons of the Phantom Legion. Trusting no one, only Gehenna and Helkasirs have each other's backs.

63201036.name: Sett Card
63201036.desc: Leader of the Vinus Delains who lives in Kurzan. She embraced the power of chaos and follows Kazeros.

63201037.name: Tamut Card
63201037.desc: Leader of the Assar Delains who lives in Kurzan. He awaits the time to confront Kazeros to save the Assar.

63201038.name: Agris Card
63201038.desc: A giant white snake that serves Echidna as its master. It brands its targets and launches vicious attacks.

63201039.name: Alcaone Card
63201039.desc: A giant black snake that serves Echidna as its master. Those caught in its crimson eyes become immobilized.

63201100.name: Yonfay Card
63201100.desc: One of the four elders of Rimeria. A disciple of Zakra, she is currently the youngest elder in Rimeria.

63201101.name: Heanu Card
63201101.desc: The Pitch Dark Night that enveloped Rimeria thousands of years ago. It harnesses the power of the Abyss and is sealed beyond Narr's Door.

63201102.name: Ghin Card
63201102.desc: A disciple of Pahu, one of the elders of Rimeria. A native of North Rimeria, he has a cheerful personality.

63201103.name: Tarakolum Card
63201103.desc: One of the fiends that lurk beyond the rift. It unleashes its inner power to destroy its surroundings.

63201104.name: Lynn Card
63201104.desc: A Fallen One, touched by the darkness beyond the rift. In the past, he was the successor to Yaruz, an elder of Rimeria.

63201105.name: Drextalas Card
63201105.desc: A Guardian who chose Chaos in a fateful moment. Wielding horns of blue flame and a tail of thorns, they destroy everything in their path.

63201106.name: Pahu Card
63201106.desc: One of the four elders of Rimeria. He is a master of illusions involving umbrella knives.

63201107.name: Yaruz Card
63201107.desc: One of the four elders of Rimeria. A native of North Rimeria, she is a master of illusions involving scrolls.

63201108.name: Krathios Card
63201108.desc: A Guardian who rejected destiny in favor of chaos. They carve an explosive path through the waters, staining the battlefield with fear.

63201109.name: Abyss Lord Kazeros Card
63201109.desc: Kazeros finally reveals himself. Even death bows under his rule.

63201110.name: Primal Shadow Saydon Card
63201110.desc: Saydon revealed an ancient plan. He awaits the downfall of death.

63201111.name: Zakra and Sarta Card
63201111.desc: Two Yoz researching Nukman's Illusion Stones. Their aim is to gather the scattered Illusion Stones and float them to bring courage and hope to Rimeria.

63201112.name: Four Legendary Elders Card
63201112.desc: The founding elders of Rimeria. Skilled in illusion magick, they sealed the Rift and saved the Yoz when Rimeria was in crisis long ago.

63201113.name: Illusion Moon Card
63201113.desc: A moon created by weaving together various Illusion Stones, each containing a different emotion. It inspires courage and hope in those who gaze upon it.

63201114.name: Lumencaligo Card
63201114.desc: A Guardian who embodies both Light and Dark. It wields these opposing forces at will, bringing ruin to everything in its sight.

63201115.name: Witch of Agony, Serca Card
63201115.desc: A Witch who transforms pain into pleasure. She manipulates thorns, roots, and various torture devices, reveling in the ecstasy that blossoms from her victims' suffering.

63201116.name: Belgardin, Arbiter of Death Card
63201116.desc: An arbiter who executes death. Commands the souls of the dead to break the boundary between life and death, guiding all living things to eternal rest.

63202000.desc: NPC Popularity Vote's 1st place card. In commemoration of the opening of season 2.

63202001.desc: NPC Popularity Vote's 2nd place card. In commemoration of the opening of season 2.

63202002.desc: NPC Popularity Vote's 3rd place card. In commemoration of the opening of season 2.

63210000.name: Soul Leaf
63210000.desc:
A sacred leaf that blooms when a soul soaks into the earth.
It shines brightly even after being picked.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Gives 500 Card XP Enhancement Points when consumed.</FONT>

63210001.name: Eternity Essence
63210001.desc:
A mysterious material made of concentrated eons of time.
It is said to be one of the last traces of an ancient race that vanished.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Gives 1,500 Card XP Enhancement Points when consumed.</FONT>

63210002.name: Creation Fragment
63210002.desc:
A fragment from when Arkesia was first created.
The Power of Order still envelops it.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Gives 3,000 Card XP Enhancement Points when consumed.</FONT>

63210003.name: Menelik's Tome
63210003.desc:
An ancient book left by the pilgrim Menelik.
It is said that the book contains all the world's knowledge.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Gives 9,000 Card XP Enhancement Points when consumed.</FONT>

63220000.name: Destiny Orb
63220000.desc:
A brilliantly shining globe. It is said that all who look upon it can see who is bound by fate. 
<FONT COLOR='#FFFFFFAC'>[Season 1: Card & Sailor Exchange] You can exchange it with Iaru for a card.</FONT>

Use to obtain 3 pieces of <FONT COLOR='#CE43FC'>Epic Gear</FONT>, 1 <FONT COLOR='#CE43FC'>Epic Accessory</FONT>, the <FONT COLOR='#00B5FF'>Stone of Soaring</FONT>, a <FONT COLOR='#CE43FC'>Secret Map</FONT>, an <FONT COLOR='#00B5FF'>Eternity Essence</FONT>, and a <FONT COLOR='#00B5FF'>Velkan Card</FONT>.
