70100180.name: Defeat Maneth
70100180.desc:
Contains rewards for defeating Maneth for the first time.
Use to obtain 3 pieces of <FONT COLOR='#CE43FC'>Epic Gear</FONT>, 3 <FONT COLOR='#CE43FC'>Epic Accessories</FONT>, a <FONT COLOR='#00B5FF'>Stone of Soaring</FONT>, 3 Healing Potions, <FONT COLOR='#00B5FF'>Eternity Essence</FONT>, and a <FONT COLOR='#00B5FF'>Maneth Card</FONT>.

70500000.name: Fancier Bouquet
70500000.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A delicately-made bouquet of rare flowers from around Prideholme.
Some would find it too expensive and overly luxurious.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Luterra Castle's Neria would love this.

70500001.name: Prideholme Potato
70500001.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A small, sweet-tasting potato grown in Prideholme. It is used in many different recipes.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Prideholme's Neria and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 51996/> would love this.

70500002.name: Rethramis Holy Water
70500002.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
An item only found in the monastery in Rethramis. You can cast evil away carrying it around or by spraying it.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 22057/> would love this.

70500003.name: Yudia Natural Salt
70500003.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The salt desert of Yudia, also known as the Mirror of Arkesia, is a rich repository of edible salt. People all around the world consider Yudian salt as the best of its kind, and it makes that salt a spice of great value.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19656/> would love this.

70500004.name: Encavian Relic
70500004.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Archaeologists and historians have great interest in studying the relics of old Encavia, which makes for great business for some merchants.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19803/> would love this.

70500005.name: Hawk Claws
70500005.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A sharp claw of a hawk. Yudians are famous for their craft in taming hawks. When their companion hawks die, the Yudians keep their claws as a charms.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 11656/> would love this.

70500006.name: Stalwart Cage
70500006.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A bird cage made for messenger pigeons in Mount Zagoras. Rich people in Lakebar who have pet birds also buy these at high prices for their simple but sturdy quality.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19767/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 46071/> would love this.</FONT>

70500007.name: Dyorika Straw Hat
70500007.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A hat that the farmers in Dyorika Plain wear to avoid the blazing sun. Its unique design makes it a popular souvenir that those visiting Luterra buy to remember their journey.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 22036/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 46559/> would love this.</FONT>

70500008.name: Model of Luterra's Sword
70500008.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
This replica of the sword that Luterra used in his younger days is a popular souvenir for foreign visitors, especially youths and the knights that look up to the great king.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 14010/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 13001/> would love this.

70500009.name: Transparent Pearl
70500009.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The transparent pearls of Wavestrand Port were used as a currency among those that didn't have actual money. Now that the pearls are rare, most of them are used to craft accessories for rich people.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 14009/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 47434/> would love this.</FONT>

70500010.name: Zagoras Ice Cap
70500010.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The snow taken from the peak of Mount Zagoras. Please keep in mind that this is heat-resistant, not heat-proof.

70500011.name: Lakebar Tomato Juice
70500011.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A juice made of fresh-picked tomatoes with clean water from Iron Lake. It's very refreshing.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Wavestrand Port's Neria would love this.</FONT>

70500012.name: Azenaporium Brooch
70500012.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A brooch that exudes the beauty of Azenaporium in East Luterra. Though it's expensive, it's very popular among noblewomen for its radiant colors and delicate craftsmanship.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 13030/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 46558/> would love this.</FONT>

70500013.name: Black Rose
70500013.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
An abnormally dark-colored rose. The rose first appeared after a priest planted the seeds in order to prevent the spread of a contagious disease in East Luterra. It withers quickly unless it's handled with care.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 22026/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19666/> would love this.</FONT>

70500014.name: Round Glass Fragment
70500014.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A piece of glass rounded out by the waves on the shore. It glitters like a gemstone under the sun. Unlike others, Mokokos find it very fascinating.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 21162/> would love this.</FONT>

70500015.name: Mokoko Carrot
70500015.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A small, but nutritious carrot. The Mokokos only need a couple of carrots to make soup that lasts them a whole year. This carrot, still wet with morning dew, smells fresh and delicious.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 21161/> would love this.</FONT>

70500016.name: Oversized Ladybug Doll
70500016.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A triple-sized doll of a ladybug made in Mokoko Village. Kids will love it.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 21133/> would love this.</FONT>

70500017.name: Tournament Entrance Certificate
70500017.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A certificate of participation in the Changhun Tournament in Anikka, a world-famous testing ground for combat skills. The participants in the Changhun tournament often put their certificates up for auction, where merchants make a bid for them to resell them at higher prices. Many young martial arts fans would love to get their hands on this piece of paper.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 14012/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 51500/> would love this.</FONT>

70500018.name: Anikka Lute
70500018.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A lute made in Anikka that is known to have the clearest sound in the world. It's a little bit expensive, but it would win a great amount of affection if given to the right romantic.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 11353/> would love this.</FONT>

70500019.name: Fragrant Peach
70500019.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A rare peach from Twilight Mists that takes more than a hundred years to be in fruit. Its sweet, fresh smell travels very far.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 10101/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19312/> would love this.</FONT>

70500020.name: Machine Repair Set
70500020.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A must-buy machine repair set made in Stern. It comes in handy when you have an Arthetinean machine at home.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 18030/> would love this.</FONT>

70500021.name: Stern Scrap Iron
70500021.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A piece of scrap metal processed in Stern. Though not as hard as the steel from Yorn which is every blacksmith's dream, its strength lies instead in reasonable pricing made possible through mass production in Stern.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 18031/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 18266/> would love this.</FONT>

70500022.name: Stamina Recovery Formula
70500022.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A potion that is known to boost the energy of the drinker. Formulated by the chemists in Arthetine, it was released after years of clinical trials. Although its effect is unquestionably strong, its undisclosed ingredients and foul smell make it hard to gulp down.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19325/> would love this.</FONT>

70500023.name: Hoyte 100-year Anniversary Bookmark
70500023.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A bookmark produced in celebration of Hoyte's centenary. The history of the company is written on its surface.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 18156/> would love this.</FONT>

70500024.name: Magick Cloth
70500024.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Sylvains in Vern often make their own clothes with magical cloth. These clothes are known to have beautiful colors and otherworldly smoothness, and grant the Sylvain peace of mind because of the magical protection they provide.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19600/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 25001/> would love this.</FONT>

70500025.name: Crystallized Magick
70500025.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Crystallized magick found in the Balankar Mountains in Vern. After special processing, it emits bright light and serves as a good substitute for a torch. The energy stored in it makes it useful for magical experiments, too.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 24207/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 43032/> would love this.</FONT>

70500026.name: Exquisite Music Box
70500026.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A richly decorated music box with flamboyant colors popular among the noblemen in Vern. If you wind it, the doll inside dances to a beautiful waltz.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'> Stern's Neria and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 47243/> would love this.</FONT>

70500027.name: Queen's Knights Application
70500027.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
An application to the Queen's Knights, also known as the Vern's Spears. For many years, the knights have encouraged worthy warriors to join them by sending a letter of recommendation with this form enclosed. Warriors in Vern take great pride in receiving it.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 20308/> would love this.</FONT>

70500028.name: Goblin Yam
70500028.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A yam grown by the Goblins in Parna Forest. It has red pulp and develops a clear ring in the center when cooked. It's all the more delicious when eaten with salt.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19383/> would love this.</FONT>

70500029.name: Glacial Beer
70500029.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A special beer only found in the Shushire area. It was made with iceberg water from Shushire that is high in oxygen, so it has a cool, refreshing quality that is second to none. It is best served with bits of the iceberg still floating on the surface.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 26027/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 16401/> would love this.</FONT>

70500030.name: Bruug Steak
70500030.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A quality Bruug meat that melts in your mouth. The flavor changes depending on how you cook it, but a true gourmet would eat it raw, slightly frozen.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19625/> would love this.</FONT>

70500031.name: Top-Grade Liquor
70500031.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
An expensive liquor containing gold dust that millionaires in Shushire like to drink. A bottle of this is worth dozens of prisoners.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 26452/> would love this.</FONT>

70500032.name: Top-Grade Fur
70500032.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Wild Bruug fur of the highest quality. The smoothness is beyond comparison with the fur of farm-bred animals. It is water-resistant and exceptional for keeping warm.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 16013/> and Kalinar's Neria would love this.</FONT>

70500033.name: Soundstone of Dawn
70500033.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A Soundstone that mages in Dawnkeep created after years of painstaking research.
There still are many studies ongoing to utilize the magick contained in the stone.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 24514/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 28050/> would love this.</FONT>

70500034.name: Elemental's Feather
70500034.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A soft feather that emits a luminous light.
It's said that Elemental tail and wing feathers can keep an entire house warm when hung on the door.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 25002/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 24101/> would love this.</FONT>

70500035.name: Shining Ore
70500035.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
An ore commonly found in Yorn mines.
It's beautiful, but too weak to have any value.
Often mistaken for a much more valuable mineral, Arkesium, it once was popular among swindlers.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 12026/> would love this.</FONT>

70500036.name: Truth Mushroom
70500036.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A mysterious mushroom believed to work similarly to truth serums.
Anyone who eats this mushroom is compelled to speak nothing but the truth.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'> Great Castle Neria and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 44103/> would love this.</FONT>

70500037.name: Fargar's Beer
70500037.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
One of the three best beers in the world, brewed by the greatest Umar brewer Fargar himself. Thick-headed and with the rich aroma of coffee, this beer prides itself in its deep flavors.

70500038.name: Broken Dagger
70500038.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The Delains of Feiton grow up swinging weapons. In that forsaken land where it's kill or be killed, broken blades like this only mean one thing.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 41130/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 28124/> would love this.</FONT>

70500039.name: Book of Survival
70500039.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A book containing advice on how to survive in the harsh environment of Feiton. It's the first textbook that young Delains master after joining the Shadow Monastery. The survival methods written in this book are beyond the imagination of anyone living outside Feiton.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 41003/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 43051/> would love this.</FONT>

70500040.name: Desiccated Wooden Statue
70500040.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A crude wooden statue shaped like a Delain. Those who succumbed to Chaos carved wooden statues like this while waiting for their execution in an isolated area, in an effort to maintain their sanity through repetitive, seemingly meaningless movements of the hand.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 40157/> would love this.</FONT>

70500041.name: Raccoontaurus Milk
70500041.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Fine quality milk of Raccoontaurus that lives in the Island of Ice Maze. The strong, sweet scent tickles your palate.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 16514/> would love this.</FONT>

70500042.name: Torso Sculpture
70500042.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A carved stone sculpture of a torso without limbs or head. The absence of its neck and limbs does not come from laziness but from the deliberate intention of the maker to maximize the masculine beauty by ridding it of the unnecessary.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19804/> would love this.</FONT>

70500043.name: Educational Chart
70500043.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A nautical map made for the education of youngsters. The scale of the map is inaccurate, so it's more decoration than of real use to sailors.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 41034/> would love this.</FONT>

70500044.name: Ghost Photography
70500044.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A photo of a ghost taken from a manor on the Metus Islands. The photographer that took this picture sold it, saying that it was lucky that he survived, but no one believes that this is an authentic photo of a ghost.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 20381/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 28099/> would love this.</FONT>

70500045.name: Lobster Dish
70500045.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A special lobster dish only made in Peyto. It's highly praised by gourmets from all over the world. They do take-outs, but it won't taste the same unless it's delivered quickly.

70500046.name: Small Music Box
70500046.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
If you wind up the box and open it, it plays a song of the ancient bards.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19743/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 28031/> would love this.</FONT>

70500047.name: Halite Statue
70500047.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A collectible piece of naturally shaped rock salt. It's sold at a high price to collectors. It needs to be kept with care, however, as there were more than a few reported cases where kids licked it for its weird sweet flavor and destroyed its value as a collectible.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 16105/> would love this.</FONT>

70500048.name: Old Bone
70500048.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Old bone that can be found all across Arkesia. There is a theory that it belonged to a Guardian that died in Chain War, but it's not very likely to be verified.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 11624/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 28141/> would love this.</FONT>

70500049.name: Paradise Parfait
70500049.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The most popular seasonal menu in Peyto! It's made with layers of fruits that are rare around the ocean area. The special syrup in the dish lingers in your mouth, reminding you why Peyto is called paradise.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19324/> would love this.</FONT>

70500050.name: Divine Tear Orpeggio
70500050.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A bottle of vodka produced by a master distiller in Peyto. Made with orange peels, you can smell the distinctive sweet orange scent when you drink it.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 22025/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 51385/> would love this.</FONT>

70500051.name: Moonlight Butterfly
70500051.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A mysterious butterfly that emits light only at night. It's famous for the dance it does when good music is played, as if recognizing the sweetness of the melody.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 20372/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 28131/> would love this.</FONT>

70500052.name: Mysterious Mouth
70500052.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The jaws of a fish. The rest of this fish has never been caught. No one knows why the fish casts off its jaws or what it looks like whole.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 15002/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19112/> would love this.</FONT>

70500053.name: Colorful Claw Toy
70500053.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
This item was mass-produced by a toy company that expected it to be a hot seller. Soon, however, the company started to struggle with the massively piled-up inventory and eventually ended up going broke. It's hard to say that it's likable.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19669/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 28140/> would love this.</FONT>

70500054.name: Perfect Beer Stein
70500054.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A super-size beer stein for pirates! Only those able to drink beer out of this in a competitive manner can be considered real pirates.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 19118/> would love this.</FONT>

70500055.name: Liebeheim's Rose
70500055.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A rose occasionally found on Liebeheim Island. Its sweet scent is known to have the power to move the heart of its recipient. This rose withers quickly when picked, so don't delay if you want to give it to someone as a gift!

70500056.name: Danube's Earrings
70500056.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Earrings worn by Danube, the Knight Commander who protected Rohendel a long time ago. They're also known as the Oath of Blue Eyes for the vivid blue gemstones in them.

70500057.name: Piyernamite
70500057.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>A handmade bomb by the master artisan, Piyer. According to him, it's the greatest masterpiece in history, powerful enough to blow up an entire mine by itself.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 51500/> would love this.</FONT>

70500058.name: Liquor of Arrogance
70500058.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Liquor brewed in the Ark of Arrogance. Its brewing recipe was lost after the Ark was shut down. Its rich, yet clean taste has earned a legendary reputation among alcohol enthusiasts.

70500059.name: Hollowfruit
70500059.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The fruit of the Hollow tree indigenous to Punika and the Rimeria continent. It looks luscious at first, but it's actually hollow on the inside.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 28122/> would love this.</FONT>

70500060.name: Piñata Crafting Set
70500060.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A box containing piñata materials. Different piñatas can be created, depending on the wishes of the creator. It's even easy to use for children, and makes a good present for everyone.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 28123/> would love this.</FONT>

70500061.name: Rainbow Tikatika Flower
70500061.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A rare flower in rainbow colors. Its mixed color makes it unsuitable for dye-making purposes, but the flower's nectar tastes and smells just like heaven. 
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 28100/> would love this.</FONT>

70500062.name: Febre Potion
70500062.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>A potion used to wash clothes, loved by the knights of Vern. It's the secret of the knights who always wear spotless, white armor. Even the most sweaty knight doesn't have to worry about the odor if he uses this potion.

<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 43049/> would love this.</FONT>

70500063.name: Feather Fan
70500063.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The noblewomen of Vern use their fans to reveal their heart. They are used to deliver the words that are too brazen or shameful to be uttered.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>Candaria Territory's Neria would love this.</FONT>

70500064.name: Mockup Firefly
70500064.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A model firefly crafted to congratulate the adventurers who start a new life. It's a customary gift among the members of the Adventurer's Guild.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 43052/> would love this.</FONT>

70500065.name: Wolf Fang Necklace
70500065.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The Tarunians carry wolf teeth as charms to keep from losing their way.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 44100/> would love this.</FONT>

70500066.name: Enya Balm
70500066.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A balm made of smashed Enya moss. Its fresh and sweet scent treats headaches and relaxes the mind.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 44102/> would love this.</FONT>

70500067.name: Prime Beef Jerky
70500067.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Jerky made of reindeer meat. Prepared with special techniques that give it a unique flavor.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 44101/> would love this.</FONT>

70500068.name: Light-infused Wine
70500068.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
This was the first Lazenith alcoholic beverage and used to be enjoyed by the gods during banquets. Made with rare flower honey and fruit juice, it is fragrant and sweet. It is often gifted to new couples for its aphrodisiac effect, and rumors say it'll grant great beauty to the drinker and return them to their youth.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 46522/> would love this.</FONT>

70500069.name: Great Celestial Serpent Skin
70500069.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The Great Celestial Serpent molts and hibernates when the constellation appears, and this is the resulting shell. It is hard and contains magick, so it is often used as material for special cloth.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 46613/> would like this.</FONT>

70500070.name: Credoff's Glass Magnifier
70500070.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A tool that was invented by Lazenith Technician Credoff. The glass at the center gathers light to create a beautiful rainbow. It was initially made as a children's toy, but it has gained popularity among adults all across Elgacia.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 46070/> would love this.</FONT>

70500071.name: Mysterious Tail
70500071.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The tail of a mystery fish that is very rarely caught in the Great Rainforest rivers. No one knows why it's only the tail that is caught.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 45703/> would love this.</FONT>

70500072.name: Kuriguri Potion
70500072.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A health drink made from a mixture of various medicinal ingredients. It was originally concocted to treat the weak, but once rumors of its effect of temporarily improving focus spread, many people started using it before taking the Sage Test.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 45702/> would love this.</FONT>

70500073.name: Whispering Whispy
70500073.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A lesser Homunculus that can record sound for a short period of time. It's used to record one's voice and give it to someone close. The recorded sound can be played back by pressing the button near the core. The most common phrase recorded is "I love you." It comes in a variety of designs, but the most popular is the basic design that can be customized to look like the person giving it.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 45700/> would love this.</FONT>

70500074.name: Press-Grilled Sulfur Mushroom
70500074.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A culinary creation of grilled sulfur mushrooms, cooked thoroughly. These mushrooms thrive on volcanic sulfur, imparting a natural spiciness and saltiness to them. They emit a strong, off-putting odor, yet have an addictive quality that makes them irresistibly appealing after the first taste.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 47620/>, <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 47623/> would love this.</FONT>

70500075.name: Tuketooth Whale Oil
70500075.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The oil of the Tuketooth whale, a species found near Kurzan's coast. Harvested from whales that wash up on Kurzan's beaches, it's predominantly used in weapon maintenance. It's believed that weapons treated with Tuketooth oil do not rust for several decades.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 47621/> would love this.</FONT>

70500076.name: Obsidian Mirror
70500076.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A mirror made from obsidian found in volcanic regions. It requires an extended period of polishing to become functional as a mirror. This usually involves months of gentle smoothing with a soft textile, after which the mirror achieves a clear, brilliant polish, reflecting everything.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 47622/> would love this.</FONT>

70500077.name: Combat Rations
70500077.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A combat ration invented in Arthetine. It heats up and inflates when water is poured inside it. It is a revolutionary invention that provides soldiers with a warm meal while out in the field, but the taste could use some improvement.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 49106/> would love this.</FONT>

70500078.name: Round Tree Tea
70500078.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Tea made from an edible tree root. The root, washed multiple times to rid it of toxins and light-roasted in an iron pot, is known to warm you up and calm you down with its pleasant smell.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 49107/> would love this.</FONT>

70500079.name: Assar Mask
70500079.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A broken mask of the Assar. The Assar who have unleashed the Demon within them wear this mask to hide their fear of losing themselves.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 47632/> would love this.</FONT>

70500080.name: Eerie Teapot
70500080.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A bizarre creation created by illusion. The imagination of the Yoz sometimes creates things that don't exist. The creator must have an impressive imagination to come up with such a unique piece.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 27357/> would love this.</FONT>

70500081.name: Weather Box
70500081.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A chest that allows you to create a one-time weather phenomenon. Contains illusions that allow training Yoz to create weather phenomena. Depending on the user's emotional state, various weather phenomena will occur.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 27358/> and <$NPC_NAME_HIDE 27356/> would love this.</FONT>

70500082.name: Illusion Ink
70500082.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The go-to item the Yoz use to record secret information. Only the people who are allowed can see the information written in ink. This is a great way for couples to communicate with each other, making it a popular choice for those just starting out in a relationship.
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'><$NPC_NAME_HIDE 27359/> would love this.</FONT>

70501000.name: Pit-a-Pat Chest
70501000.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A limited edition gift chest produced in celebration of the holy festival of the Rethramis Brotherhood. In some strange way, the stuff in the chest never fails to catch the fancy of the one who opens the chest.

70501001.name: Sky Reflection Oil
70501001.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A liquid solution containing Mungka oil, salttree seed and solar salt. It is what Yudians use to protect their skin from burning under the blazing sun, so a lot of people consult Yudian merchants to get hold of this.

70501002.name: Chain War Chronicles
70501002.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A record of the Chain War published by the Termia Library. It's already in its fourteenth edition.

70501003.name: Shy Wind Flower Pollen
70501003.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Pollen taken from a Shy Wind Flower only found in Mokoko Village. The unique color that can't be produced with science makes it something every painter in this world craves to get hold of.

70501004.name: Angler's Fishing Pole
70501004.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A fishing pole believed to have been used by a legendary angler of Anikka. It radiates special, almost solemn, energy.

70501005.name: Fine Gramophone
70501005.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A portable gramophone created by the Cykins. Arthetine's technology has enabled it to reproduce crystal clear sounds.

70501006.name: Vern's Founding Coin
70501006.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A coin created in celebration of Vern's establishment five hundred years ago. Now, it's so rare that it's only traded to the highest bidder. It's imprinted with Vern's founding principles, exchange and harmony.

70501007.name: Sirius's Holy Book
70501007.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The holy book of Sirius, the God of Ice. The priests of Sirius carry this book around with them everywhere they go until they die.

70501008.name: Red Moon Tears
70501008.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A red gemstone often found in the Cave of Sin. Its seductive red color looks dangerously captivating.

70501009.name: Festival of Fire and Ice
70501009.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The ultimate gift. There is no heart that this beautiful crystal cannot impress. Even a Demon will be your bud if you give this to it.

70501010.name: Sylvain Queens' Blessing
70501010.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A glass bottle filled with the holy magick of the Sylvain queens, Azena and Inanna. The magick inside the bottle glows like thousands of stars. It's said that only those chosen by the queens can receive their blessings.

70501011.name: Oreha Viewing Stone
70501011.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Punika's finest decoration, known to be more valuable than any gemstone at the same weight. Extremely rare volcanic rock from the volcano in Oreha, it looks strange and mysterious. Can't be used as a weapon.

70501012.name: Necromancer's Records
70501012.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The records of a necromancer who wanted to defy the natural laws of Arkesia and conquer death. Someone in South Vern wanted to delve into their knowledge and call together the necromancers to learn the secrets of immortality, but knew that the results must be kept secret lest they reach beings that should remain ignorant.

70501013.name: Warm Earmuffs
70501013.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Earmuffs to protect the ears from the cold. A must-have item when climbing snowy mountains.

70501014.name: Lucky Starflower
70501014.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
This flower lies hidden underground for 700 years near a temple with the power of light, and then blooms for a mere 7 days. The light given off by the blooming flower shines very far, and the sound made by the swaying petals has a purifying effect that can heal any disease. Anyone who finds this flower is sure to receive great fortune.

70501015.name: Voldisian Stone
70501015.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A stone orb commemorating the unity of the Raiya Sect and scholars who settled in Voldis. It is decorated with a blue gem and metal ornaments. The blue gem symbolizes science, medicine, and magick. The metal ornaments represent the Golden Path. Through this stone orb, the scholars and Raiyas developed a deep bond, and the two groups became Voldisians who dreamt of completion.

70501016.name: Undying Flame
70501016.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Many seeds rooted in Kurzan wither and die before they can even sprout, but occasionally, some endure the harsh environment and bloom. Such flowers, once bloomed, do not wilt even when plucked and emit heat like a flame. It is said that their extract can alleviate pain when applied to the body.

70501017.name: Broken Clay Doll
70501017.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A lump of clay fashioned into a doll and baked in the flames. Of unknown origin, these dolls are often discovered in abandoned ruins and the vestiges of old civilizations in Kurzan.

70501018.name: Glass Butterfly
70501018.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Glass art created by the master glassmaker Sargal. This glass art is particularly expensive and in short supply, and those who manage to obtain one of his pieces rejoice more for it than any other treasure in the world. His glass butterflies are among the most prized of his creations.

70502000.name: Gustaven's Holy Water
70502000.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Holy water blessed by Gustaven, the legendary Archbishop of Rethramis. It has the power to prevent misfortunes and cure diseases.

70502001.name: Encavian Crown
70502001.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
An ancient relic of Encavia, a kingdom that prospered in Yudia ages ago. It's a Rapport item that all young men would love to have. You cannot give this item as a gift more than once, so think carefully before deciding who you want to give it to.

70502002.name: Medrick Centennial Wine
70502002.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A fragrant wine made by the priests in Medrick Monastery. The bottles of wine made a hundred years ago are very rare and valuable because the drought prevented the priests from making them in large numbers.

70502003.name: Honey Toast
70502003.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A toast with honey and butter on top, a Wavestrand Port exclusive. People travel from far away to have a bite of this toast after it was given the highest score by Food Connoisseurs of Luterra.

70502004.name: Living Stone
70502004.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A living, breathing stone that is said to have fallen off a giant's body. Like any other living thing, they say that it moves around when you put enough time, love and effort into taking care of it. It's so rare that it doesn't have a standard price.

70502005.name: Endless Bottle
70502005.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
This gourd bottle crafted by the master craftsman Hao in Anikka has infinite space for liquor. As its crafting involves Sir Druden's spells, Hao wasn't able to craft more than a few.

70502006.name: Hoyte Issue No. 289
70502006.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The 289th issue of Hoyte created a huge stir with its fierce criticism of the Stern Times, but it soon became a rare find for an unknown, but obvious reason.

70502007.name: Linderte Goblet
70502007.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A goblet deigned by Linderte, a renowned wine expert in Vern. Its simple but delicate design makes it a very popular product among the people in and outside of Vern.

70502008.name: Azure Gem
70502008.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A beautiful gem that is as transparent as ice and as blue as the ocean. It's only found on the steep cliffside of Icewing Heights. You will have to put your life on the line to get a hold of this.

70502009.name: Millennial Lotus Essence
70502009.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A drop of water taken from the petals of the Millennial Lotus in Rohendel, which is known to form only once in decades. Its highly condensed magick energy makes it a valuable material used in advanced sorcery.

70502010.name: Mask of the Oath
70502010.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A mask said to have been worn by a hero who tried to protect Feiton. It has a message scribbled in small letters on the back. "For the future..."

70502011.name: Blessings of the Lazeniths
70502011.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Holy water of the ancient Lazeniths that was blessed by Regulus. Sprinkling it over one's head is believed to ward off disaster and misfortune.

70502012.name: Gienah's Protection
70502012.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A rough stone with a mystic blue color occasionally found in steep terrain. It's harder than crystal and gives off warmth when held in the hand. It's said to bring the blessing of the goddess Gienah to whoever holds it.

70502013.name: Azure Heart Fruit
70502013.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A blue-ish fruit that resembles a heart. Although it may look awful and smell foul, its flavor is so great that it's called fruit from the heavens. All the gourmets in the world are craving to get hold of it as its tree only produces a handful of fruits a year.

70502014.name: Haal Coin
70502014.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A gold coin of the Haals, who went extinct a long time ago. Imprinted with the image of the fire god, Antares, this gold coin has artistic and archaeological value.

70502015.name: Crystal Necklace
70502015.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A beautiful necklace made with crystals. It's an item that all young ladies love. You cannot give this item as a gift more than once, so think carefully before deciding who you want to give it to.

70502016.name: Albion's Scale
70502016.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A silver scale that came off of Albion the Solar Guardian when it fought Argos the Chaos Guardian during the Chain War. It's rarely found in Punika, and shines as brightly as it did five hundred years ago.

70502017.name: Lunar Knights Token
70502017.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The token of the knightly order led by Avele, the knight commander in Vern. This token is given to only the best of their knights, making it rare and valuable. The motto of the order is engraved on its back: "The moon never wanes!"

70502018.name: Tiroc Fruit
70502018.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
Tarunian Warriors turn Tiroc Fruit into a facepaint with courage-boosting Awakening Effects.

70502019.name: Light Codex
70502019.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The Swords of the Lazeniths who protect Elgacia are in charge of different duties. They have each recorded their roles and duties in the Codex of the Lazeniths to avoid confusion as they govern the community. There are 5 volumes in total.

Volume 1: Prophecy and Tithes
Volume 2: Astrology and Weather
Volume 3: Records and Education
Volume 4: Order and Regulation
Volume 5: Administration and Protection

70502020.name: Homunculus Core
70502020.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The beginning and end of Homunculus. Even with all the other parts, a Homunculus cannot move without a core to give it life. Furthermore, it doesn't take long for a normal Homunculus to break if its core is out of balance. As a result, the core ranks among the most valuable and costly goods for the Sages of Voldis.

70502021.name: Assar Charm
70502021.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
The Assar Delains place a small charm with a circular ring on the forehead of the another and then breathe into the ring. They do this believing it can temporarily chase away the looming presence of death.

70502022.name: Gem Lizard
70502022.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A rare lizard found in the volcano. It feeds on flames and rocks instead of insects, growing scales that glimmer like tiny gems.

70502023.name: Ursali Amber
70502023.desc:
<FONT COLOR='#FFD200'>An item used to increase Rapport with NPCs.</FONT>
A pumpkin that is worn like a charm by the Yoz. It's made of wood sap and hardened with Ursali, a flower from Rimeria. It takes a great deal of time and effort to make. The Yoz carry this pumpkin to ward off foul energy.

70503000.name: Tournament Entrance Stamp
70503000.desc: A stamp used to certify one's participation in Anikka's internationally famous fighting tournament. It authenticates the tournament entrance documents and increases their value as collectibles.

70503001.name: Yudia Spellbook
70503001.desc: A book containing a spell that appeases the spirits of the dead. The Yudians sing a song when people and animals die, praying for their rebirth.

70503002.name: Lobster Dish Order Ticket
70503002.desc: A ticket to claim Peyto's special lobster meal.

70503003.name: Perfect Log
70503003.desc: A gigantic log that's the perfect size to carve a Perfect Beer Stein out of it. It never cracks or rot, and always smells fresh, no matter how old it becomes.

70503004.name: Dyorika Straw String
70503004.desc: A string woven from well-dried Dyorika straw. It has various purposes including making sun hats.

70503005.name: Splendid Essence
70503005.desc: Water drawn from a secret well with mysterious power. It's believed to make the world's finest liquor.

70503006.name: Energy X7 Capsule
70503006.desc: An energy capsule developed by Arthetine chemists. It immediately boosts blood flow and metabolism when ingested.

70503007.name: Changhun Lute String
70503007.desc: Lute strings made from Changhun's finest silk. They create clear and sharp sounds.

70503008.name: Piyer's Secret Textbook
70503008.desc: A book containing master craftsman Piyer's crafting tricks. It helps build Piyernamite at home.

70503100.name: Rethramis Rapport Chest
70503100.desc: A chest containing Legendary – Epic Rethramis Rapport items.

70503101.name: Yudia Rapport Chest
70503101.desc: A chest containing Legendary – Epic Yudia Rapport items.

70503102.name: West Luterra Rapport Chest
70503102.desc: A chest containing Legendary – Epic West Luterra Rapport items.

70503103.name: East Luterra Rapport Chest
70503103.desc: A chest containing Legendary – Epic East Luterra Rapport items.

70503104.name: Tortoyk Rapport Chest
70503104.desc: A chest containing Legendary – Epic Tortoyk Rapport items.

70503105.name: Anikka Rapport Chest
